chapters.title: Chapter 2401 Corpse Mountain
paragraphs: "You know where we can find the Abyssal Council?" Yuan looked at Supreme Ruler Dena with a raised eyebrow, wondering what sort of connection she had with this shady organization.
"I had a run-in with them before," she said, almost as if she could read his mind. "However, I don't know if they'll still be at the same place."
"We'll know once we get there," said Yuan. "Where can we go to find them?"
"Corpse Mountain," she said.
"Oh?" Yuan was familiar with this location, but he'd never personally visited it before.
"I wanted to visit that place in the past but never got the chance," he remarked.
"Corpse Mountain, huh? Fortunately it's not far." Lev sighed. "But it's as dangerous as the Deprived Crimson Valley since the Forsaken like to hide there."

Yuan knew this. When Tian Chenyu had visited last time he'd heard that many Forsaken favored the mountain's vast, treacherous terrain that made it easier for them to remain hidden, and he had planned to visit to hunt them. But alas, he never got the chance.
"Let's go."
Yuan and his group left the city shortly after and began their journey to the Corpse Mountain.
Meanwhile, a large group of demons gathered at the Demise Ravine.
"The Supreme Ruler was right! There are signs of her power being used here! That woman has really escaped the Deprived Crimson Valley!"
"Oh my god... to think that crazy bitch is out of the Deprived Crimson Valley again... this is a total nightmare."
Suddenly, these demons felt a powerful presence descending on them, and it was none other than the Queen Wraith of Demise.
"What are the Supreme Ruler's lackeys doing in my territory?" Queen Wraith of Demise questioned them with an army of Nether Wraiths by her side.

"Queen Wraith of Demise! We are not here to cause trouble! We are here under the Supreme Ruler's command to investigate a certain individual, and I am certain that you have information that will help us!"
"And how are you so certain that I have such information?" Queen Wraith of Demise inquired.
"As the ruler of this land, there's no way you wouldn't notice someone causing such a disturbance here! Please help us! We just want to know about the individual who was here!"
The Queen Wraith of Demise sneered, "Let's say I have such information. Why the hell should I help you? I have no obligation to assist the Supreme Ruler, either.
"Of course, we're not asking you to help for free. If you help us, the Supreme Ruler will definitely reward you handsomely."

The Queen Wraith of Demise fell silent for a minute before responding, "If I recall correctly, the Supreme Ruler has a certain treasure in his possession called the Spectral Jewel. If he gives me that treasure, I'll tell you everything I know."
"That... we will relay your demands to the Supreme Ruler."
Some time later...

"Queen Wraith of Demise, the Supreme Ruler has agreed to your demands! If you tell us everything you know, he'll give you the Spectral Jewel! However, your information must actually be helpful and real!"
"In that case, ask away. I'll answer to the best of my knowledge," she said.
"Did a petite woman about this height with crimson hair and eyes appear here in the last few years?"
"Yes, there was someone like that."

The group of demons trembled after hearing the Queen Wraith of Demise confirm Supreme Ruler Dena's presence. Even though they were already certain that she'd escaped the Deprived Crimson Valley, having it confirmed was a different story.
"Was... she alone? Or did she have company?"
"There were two other individuals with her."
"Can you describe them?"
The Queen Wraith of Demise proceeded to describe Lev and Yuan's appearance.
"She's being followed by two first-level False Gods?" The demons were puzzled by this information.
"That's not correct," the Queen Wraith of Demise suddenly said. "From how I saw it, she was the one following them—or more precisely, that noble-looking one."
"That woman following someone? That doesn't sound right at all. You must've been mistaken."

The Queen Wraith of Demise didn't say anything else and allowed them to believe whatever they wanted. "Is there anything else you can tell us about these two people with her? Tell us everything you know about them."
"There was nothing notable about the red-skinned one. He was a coward and a weakling. The other one, however..." The Queen Wraith of Demise shuddered just recalling Yuan's prowess.
"I don't know why you're looking for them, but I wouldn't mess with that man if I were you."
The demons were bewildered at the Queen Wraith of Demise's random remark, as it sounded like she was fearful of this individual.
The Queen Wraith of Demise continued to reveal some information on Yuan without going into depth or telling them everything, only doing the bare minimum.
"Anyway, that's all I know about them."
"One last thing. Which direction did they go?"
"Towards the Bloody Expanse."
"Thank you, Queen Wraith of Demise. We will have the Spectral Jewel delivered to you as soon as possible once we verify your information."
The group of demons left the Demise Ravine shortly after and chased after their lead.
A few months later, Yuan and his group arrived at Corpse Mountain.

Despite its ominous name, the place was not formed from actual corpses. Rather, the mountains bore grotesque, unnatural shapes that, from a distance, resembled piles of bodies heaped upon one another.
Their surfaces were a pale, bone-like white, while their peaks were stained a deep crimson, giving the chilling impression that they had been drenched in fresh blood.
"This is actually my first time coming here, too," Lev commented.
Yuan then asked Supreme Ruler Dena, "So, how do we find these people now?"
"Follow me."
Without any explanation, Supreme Ruler Dena entered the region. Yuan and Lev quickly followed.
The moment they entered the Corpse Mountain territory, Yuan could sense several gazes watching them from afar.

chapters.title: Chapter 2402 Abyssal Council
paragraphs: "We're being watched already? We just entered..." Lev shook his head when he sensed the gazes as well.
"Let them watch," said Yuan. "We won't have a problem unless they attack us."
A few days later, they were attacked for the first time. Unsurprisingly, it was a Forsaken, one at the 7th level False God.
"Devour."
Yuan wasted no time retrieving the Demon Devouring Sword and feeding the Forsaken to it.
"That sword's ability terrifies me no matter how many times I see it," Lev commented as his body trembled. "Where the hell did you acquire that sword, anyway?"
"This used to be an ordinary sword, but after being soaked in demon blood for so long, it evolved into a treasure."
"What? Is such a thing possible? We barely use weapons, so I had no idea."
He also wanted to ask how many demons Yuan killed in order for the sword to transform, but he was too afraid to do so and decided against it.
After traveling for another two days without any incident, Yuan and his group were suddenly ambushed by a group of eight Forsakens.
"How foolish of you to enter this domain with your puny cultivation!"
"Three first-level False Gods? Talk about a free meal!"
"Hahaha! That woman is mine!"
Supreme Ruler Dena had suppressed her cultivation to the first-level False God, so the Forsaken were unaware of her true cultivation, not that it really mattered in any way.
Yuan retrieved the Demon Devouring Sword, but before he could make a move, Supreme Ruler Dena spoke, "Let me handle them."
In the next instant, her hair lashed out with terrifying speed, piercing through every demon like a volley of spears in the blink of an eye.
Though caught off guard by her sudden assault, the demons showed no signs of panic.
However, in the very next moment, their bodies began to contort and coil unnaturally, as though being drawn in—being devoured by Supreme Ruler Dena's hair.
"W-What is this?!"
"She's devouring us!"

The demons struggled and tried to cut her hair, but their efforts were futile. Within mere seconds, their bodies withered, shriveling into wrinkled husks, as though all their blood and bones had been drained from them, looking like dried raisins.
Lev swallowed nervously at their horrific state. It was also at this moment that he recalled Supreme Ruler Dena's second name—Crimson Goddess of Gluttony.
"Ugh. Disgusting." Supreme Ruler Dena stuck her tongue out and complained with a deep frown on her face, looking like someone who accidentally ate rotten food.
"I need some of your blood to cleanse this bad taste in my mouth," she turned to Yuan and said, her eyes glistening with anticipation.
Yuan had a faint suspicion that this had been her intention all along, but he chose to play along nonetheless and fed her some of his blood.
"I'll take care of the trash from now on. You need to reserve your strength for when we really need it," he then said.
"That took as much effort as breathing," she replied with a shrug.
"You can keep killing them if you want, but don't expect me to feed you blood every time."
"...Fine, you can take care of them."
A few weeks later, Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly came to a halt.
"We've arrived," she said.
She pointed toward a concealed valley nestled between two mountains and continued, "They should be there."
"I don't sense any presence," Lev remarked.
"That's because there's a powerful concealment formation enveloping that entire area," Yuan said.

He turned to Supreme Ruler Dena and asked, "How should we approach them?" "They're an annoying bunch that will try to intimidate you at any opportunity. However, they're also prone to it. In simpler terms, just act like you own the place and they'll listen."
"Sounds simple enough." A cold smile tugged at Yuan's lips.
"I'll lead the way."
In the next moment, Yuan shot forward, flying straight toward the concealed area and entering the formation without a hint of hesitation.
The instant he passed through it, the illusion unraveled, revealing rows of towering structures that seemed to materialize out of thin air before his eyes.
Then, he unleashed both his Chaotic Essence and Demon Sealing Aura, their oppressive might sweeping across the entire valley like a storm.
Almost instantly, hundreds of silhouettes poured out from the buildings, converging toward him, and within moments, Yuan found himself completely surrounded.
"Who the fuck are you?! And what are you trying to pull with such an offensive announcement?!"
Yuan looked at the demon who just spoke and said in a cold voice, "My identity does not matter. All you need to know is that I am here to buy information."
"Then you can screw right off! We don't do business with—"
Before the demon could even finish his sentence, Yuan appeared before him like a ghost, his movement imperceptible.
In the next instant, he seized the demon by the throat and infused just enough Demon Sealing Aura into his body to seal half of his body.
"My hearing hasn't been the best lately, so can you repeat that?" Yuan said, exuding real killing intent.
"T-That power! He's a Sealer?!"
"What?! That's impossible! They were all executed long ago!"
Some of the demons there recognized Yuan's power and exclaimed, alerting the others.
"So what if he's a Sealer?! He dared to attack us, the Abyssal Council! Let's get him!"
"That's right! There's no way he can handle all of us! He's just a first-level False God, too!"
Just as some of the demons prepared to attack, a loud voice boomed, echoing throughout the entire valley.
"Enough! None of you will move a single muscle from this point forth, unless you want to die!"
The next moment, a lone figure emerged from one of the buildings and flew toward Yuan, stopping just before him.
Yuan narrowed his eyes at the newcomer. He was a tall man with short white hair, bearing no visible demonic traits and appearing entirely human.
The demon then spoke in a somewhat nervous voice, "You... Does your name, by any chance, start with 'Tian'?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2403 Crimson City's Massacre
paragraphs: Hearing the white-haired demon's question, Yuan raised an eyebrow and spoke with an amused smile on his face, "Oh? You recognize me?"
The next second, he removed his disguise, revealing his true appearance.
Several gasps of shock could be heard throughout the group of demons there. It clearly wasn't just the white-haired demon that recognized Yuan.
"Heavens! Tian—!" The white-haired demons exclaimed in shock, his entire being trembling in disbelief, but he hastily covered his mouth before he could finish Tian Chenyu's name for some reason.
"How do you know me?" Yuan removed the seal and released the demon in his grasp before asking.
A nervous smile appeared on the white-haired demon's face as he responded in a somewhat hesitant voice, "I... I was at the Crimson City's Massacre. In fact, I was nearly killed there."
"Cimson City's Massacre?" Yuan mumbled, finding this term to be quite familiar but couldn't pinpoint where he'd heard it.
"That's the day you first appeared in our world and started massacring everyone without mercy like a madman," Supreme Ruler Dena's voice resounded as she and Lev finally made an appearance.
"Oh, right." Yuan muttered with a stiff smile on his face.

The massacre had occurred in the Crimson City, one of the largest and most populated areas in the Demonic Realm, and Tian Chenyu had caused so much destruction that the entire city was dyed in blood and reduced to ruin by the end.
Yuan looked at the white-haired demon and said, "So I almost killed you back then, huh?"
"It's not just him! A lot of us were there that day!" Someone in the crowd suddenly remarked.
"Let's not reminisce about the past, unless you want to take revenge or something," Yuan's gaze shifted to the demon who just spoke, causing their body to shake in terror.
"No, we don't want to fight you." The white-haired demon hastily said. "It happened long ago, and you had a fair reason behind your actions..."
He took a deep breath before continuing, "Please, follow me. I'll tell you whatever you want to know."
Yuan nodded and followed the white-haired demon to one of the buildings in the distance.
As they traveled, Yuan asked, "How did you know it was me?"
"It was a guess based on how powerful your Demon Sealing Aura was, as well as the fact that every other Sealer should be dead by now.
"...Why are they dead?" Yuan asked with a slight frown.
"They were hunted, of course."
"By whom?"
"The previous Supreme Ruler."
"I see..."
Yuan fell silent.

Though Tian Chenyu had never formed any deep attachment to the Demon Sealers, having taught them on a mere whim to test whether demons could wield Demon Sealing Aura, it still left a faint bitterness in his heart to learn they had been hunted to extinction.

As for the results of his experiment, a small number of demons had indeed managed to wield Demon Sealing Aura, albeit only in trace amounts, comparable to a human who had just begun learning it. Moreover, only those demons whose appearance closely resembled humans—those of so-called noble bloodlines—were capable of using it at all.
Once they were inside the building and seated in a private room, the white-haired demon spoke, "What information are you looking for?"
"Everything you know about Dena—Supreme Ruler Dena's situation."
The white-haired demon's eyes widened with bewilderment when Yuan uttered Supreme Ruler Dena's name aloud without hesitation.
He jumped from his seat and used his divine sense to look at the sky, as if he was anticipating the Demon God's Wrath to strike them soon.
"Relax, the rules of this world have no effect on me, who is from another world." Yuan calmly said to him.
"So the Demon God's Wrath... won't appear?" The white-haired demon swallowed nervously.
"Not for me."
"I see..." The white-haired demon muttered as he took a seat again.
"Oh, by the way, I forgot to introduce myself. I am the Grand Abyssal Elder, the current head of this organization."
"You may know me as Tian Chenyu, but you can call me Yuan now. That way, you won't invoke Dremon God's Wrath by saying my name," Yuan said.
"I understand, Yuan." The Grand Abyssal Elder nodded.
"Now, regarding... 'her'. What is it specifically that you want to know? I don't know where to begin."
"Let's start with why she was removed from her position and exiled to the Deprived Crimson Valley."
"So we're starting with the most difficult ones, huh?" said Grand Abyssal Elder with a bitter smile on his face.
He fell silent to ponder for a moment before responding, "Let's begin with who exiled her to the Deprived Crimson Valley. It was the 10th Supreme Ruler, so the one who replaced her."
"As for why..."

The Grand Abyssal Elder fell silent again, looking like he was hesitant to continue. He knew that Tian Chenyu and Supreme Ruler Dena had a good relationship, so he was worried that the information might not be something he'd want to hear.
"Just tell me. I can handle it." Yuan said, almost as if he knew what the Grand Abyssal Elder was thinking.
"I understand."
The Grand Abyssal Elder took a deep breath before revealing in a grim voice, "That woman... she was exiled because she devoured every living being in the City of Blood..."
"WHAT?!"
Both Yuan and Supreme Ruler Dena exclaimed in shock after hearing this.

The City of Blood was the largest and most populated city in the entire Demonic Realm, where tens of billions of demons lived. Moreover, it was also where the main headquarters for the Supreme Ruler was located.

If Supreme Ruler Dena had truly devoured everyone there, that meant she'd killed tens of billions of demons, a crime worthy of execution. Yet, she was merely exiled to the Deprived Crimson Valley because she was too powerful to be killed. "She devoured everyone in the City of Blood...? That's..." Yuan's gaze shifted to look at Supreme Ruler Dena, who stood behind him with a dazed expression on her face.

"The previous Supreme Ruler."
"I see..."
Yuan fell silent.

Though Tian Chenyu had never formed any deep attachment to the Demon Sealers, having taught them on a mere whim to test whether demons could wield Demon Sealing Aura, it still left a faint bitterness in his heart to learn they had been hunted to extinction.
As for the results of his experiment, a small number of demons had indeed managed to wield Demon Sealing Aura, albeit only in trace amounts, comparable to a human who had just begun learning it.
Moreover, only those demons whose appearance closely resembled humans—those of so-called noble bloodlines—were capable of using it at all.
Once they were inside the building and seated in a private room, the white-haired demon spoke, "What information are you looking for?"
"Everything you know about Dena—Supreme Ruler Dena's situation."
The white-haired demon's eyes widened with bewilderment when Yuan uttered Supreme Ruler Dena's name aloud without hesitation.
He jumped from his seat and used his divine sense to look at the sky, as if he was anticipating the Demon God's Wrath to strike them soon.
"Relax, the rules of this world have no effect on me, who is from another world." Yuan calmly said to him.
"So the Demon God's Wrath... won't appear?" The white-haired demon swallowed nervously.
"Not for me."
"I see..." The white-haired demon muttered as he took a seat again.
"Oh, by the way, I forgot to introduce myself.
I am the Grand Abyssal Elder, the current head of this organization."
"You may know me as Tian Chenyu, but you can call me Yuan now.
That way, you won't invoke Dremon God's Wrath by saying my name," Yuan said.
"I understand, Yuan." The Grand Abyssal Elder nodded.
"Now, regarding... 'her'.
What is it specifically that you want to know?
I don't know where to begin."
"Let's start with why she was removed from her position and exiled to the Deprived Crimson Valley."
"So we're starting with the most difficult ones, huh?" said Grand Abyssal Elder with a bitter smile on his face.
He fell silent to ponder for a moment before responding, "Let's begin with who exiled her to the Deprived Crimson Valley.
It was the 10th Supreme Ruler, so the one who replaced her."
"As for why..."
The Grand Abyssal Elder fell silent again, looking like he was hesitant to continue.
He knew that Tian Chenyu and Supreme Ruler Dena had a good relationship, so he was worried that the information might not be something he'd want to hear.
"Just tell me.
I can handle it." Yuan said, almost as if he knew what the Grand Abyssal Elder was thinking.
"I understand."
The Grand Abyssal Elder took a deep breath before revealing in a grim voice, "That woman... she was exiled because she devoured every living being in the City of Blood..."
"WHAT?!"
Both Yuan and Supreme Ruler Dena exclaimed in shock after hearing this.
The City of Blood was the largest and most populated city in the entire Demonic Realm, where tens of billions of demons lived.
Moreover, it was also where the main headquarters for the Supreme Ruler was located.
If Supreme Ruler Dena had truly devoured everyone there, that meant she'd killed tens of billions of demons, a crime worthy of execution.
Yet, she was merely exiled to the Deprived Crimson Valley because she was too powerful to be killed.
"She devoured everyone in the City of Blood...?
That's..." Yuan's gaze shifted to look at Supreme Ruler Dena, who stood behind him with a dazed expression on her face.

chapters.title: Chapter 2404 Devouring the City of Blood
paragraphs: "I... devoured everyone in the City of Blood...?" Supreme Ruler Dena muttered in a voice of disbelief.
"Hmm?" Grand Abyssal Elder raised his eyebrows after hearing her mumbling.
Since Supreme Ruler Dena was still in her disguise, he had no way of knowing of her true identity.

Seeing how depressed she looked, Yuan placed a hand on her head and said, "I'm sure there's a good explanation for it. Like it was caused by that curse. So, you don't need to feel too guilty about it."
"But it won't change the fact that I devoured them..." she sighed.
"Wait... what are you two...?"
Yuan looked at the Grand Abyssal Elder and revealed, "Oh, I forgot to mention. She's Supreme Ruler Dena."
"She's—?!"
The Grand Abyssal Elder jumped from his seat again and kissed the wall with his back.
Seeing his reaction, Yuan smiled and assured him, "Don't worry, she won't devour you."
The Grand Abyssal Elder's mouth was agape with shock and disbelief. He couldn't believe that two of the worst murders in history were currently inside his room at this moment.
His gaze shifted to Lev, silently wondering about his identity.
Noticing that the Grand Abyssal Elder's gaze on him, Lev smiled and said, "You don't have to worry. I am just a nobody."
Of course, his reassurance didn't calm the Grand Abyssal Elder even in the slightest.
Yuan then asked, "When did it happen? When did she devour the entire city?"
"It happened shortly after she returned from her trip to the Boundless Expanse." Grand Abyssal Elder said.
"So it happened after she devoured the Eternal..." Yuan rubbed his eyes and sighed.

The Grand Abyssal Elder continued, his tone growing more solemn, "When she returned from her trip, a troubling rumor began to spread. They said something had changed within her—that she was barely responsive, often lost in a daze."
"Once the rumor became widespread, people began to worry that she might have turned into a Forsaken."

"Then, a few years later, the entire population of the City of Blood vanished overnight, with 'her' being the only presence left. With that, people could only come to a single conclusion—that she'd devoured everyone."
Yuan raised his eyebrows at this new information and said, "Wait... so nobody actually witnessed Dena devouring the people?"
The Grand Abyssal Elder shook his head.
"No, but there is no other logical explanation for why everyone in the city vanished, as only she had the capability to erase such a massive population overnight without anyone noticing."
Yuan fell silent to ponder.

Since Supreme Ruler Dena had been under the curse's influence—unconsciously devouring demons within the Deprived Crimson Valley—it wouldn't be far-fetched to assume she had done the same to the people of the City of Blood.
However, something about the situation didn't sit right with Yuan.
'If she had only just returned after consuming the Eternal, would it have truly developed into a curse so quickly—enough for her to devour an entire city?'
'No... the Eternal didn't become a curse until after she was exiled to the Deprived Crimson Valley. So that likely wasn't the cause.'

'In that case... what could have driven Dena to devour an entire city... assuming she was even responsible to begin with?' 'Moreover, if the curse was really responsible, nobody would've been able to stop it, much less toss her into the Deprived Crimson Valley.' Yuan pondered inwardly.
After all, he was only able to wake up Supreme Ruler Dena because he wielded Eternal Essence. Had it been anyone else, they would've been devoured long before they could even get close to her.
The more he thought about it, the less convinced he was that Supreme Ruler Dena was responsible for the disappearance of the people of the City of Blood.
"I don't believe Dena is responsible," he announced some time later.
"Based on what evidence?" Grand Abyssal Elder inquired with intrigue.
"I have no evidence, just as there's no solid evidence that Dena is responsible. It's my gut feeling," he calmly replied.

"I'm glad you trust me so much, but it won't change the fact that everyone in the City of Blood had vanished without a trace, and I don't have any recollection of anything that happened after I consumed that crystal," Supreme Ruler Dena sighed. "Most importantly, the people of this world believe that I have done it."
Yuan then asked the Grand Abyssal Elder, "Do you have any more information on the subject? Any detail related is fine, too."
"Hmm... give me a moment to think about it."
A minute later, the Grand Abyssal Elder said, "Well, the one who discovered the incident first was the Supreme Adviser at the time, who also became the 10th Supreme Ruler after replacing her."
"The Supreme Adviser?" Yuan mumbled.
The Supreme Adviser was a position that was only below Supreme Ruler Dena. "He was also the first to accuse her of devouring the people of the city." the Grand Abyssal Elder added.
Yuan glanced at Supreme Ruler Dena and said, "I don't remember much about the Supreme Adviser, but I do recall disliking him. He always struck me as... ambitious—and not in a good way."
"Because he was," Supreme Ruler Dena replied calmly. "He often spoke of surpassing me one day, even in my presence. Personally, I found it rather amusing."
Yuan turned to the Grand Abyssal Elder and asked, "What became of the Supreme Adviser? Who succeeded him? And which generation of Supreme Ruler are we currently on?"

"The current Supreme Ruler is the 14th. As for the 10th Supreme Ruler... he actually disappeared after only just a few thousand years of being in power. Nobody knows where he went, nor have we heard or seen from him since then."
"He disappeared?" Yuan wore a suspicious expression on his face.

A few thousand years in the Demonic Realm was akin to a few months to humans in the Nine Heavens. For the Supreme Adviser to disappear so shortly after becoming the Supreme Ruler was simply too suspicious no matter how he looked at it.

chapters.title: Chapter 2405 Consuming the True Emperor of the Seas’ Blood Essence
paragraphs: "There's a good chance the Supreme Adviser had something to do with the disappearance of the people in the City of Blood, even pinning the blame on you," Yuan said to Supreme Ruler Dena after pondering for a moment.
"Even if that is true, what could he have done to the people? Where did they disappear to?" she wondered out loud.
Yuan then asked the Grand Abyssal Elder, "What's the City of Blood like now?"
"Well, the population has recovered about thirty percent since then."
"Only thirty percent?" Yuan remarked, as it sounded a little low for how much time has passed since then.

"Many are afraid of getting close to the City of Blood because they believe it might be cursed after what happened. They Moreover, the current Supreme Ruler actually prefers the lower population, so it's also much harder to live there nowadays."
"Speaking of the current Supreme Ruler, what kind of person are they?" Yuan then asked.

"The current Supreme Ruler is the son of the previous generation," the Grand Abyssal Elder began. "Much like his father, he is a devout fanatic of the Demon God, and... well... how should I put this...?"
He paused briefly before continuing, "He is utterly obsessed with solving our food shortage... as well as our overpopulation."
"What's so bad about that? You made it sound like he was about to do something horrific," Yuan said, shaking his head.

"There's nothing wrong with wanting to solve such problems," the Grand Abyssal Elder replied, his tone turning grave. "The issue lies in his solution, and it concerns you the most. He intends to make use of your world, which, according to him, is rich in both space and resources."
Yuan's brows rose at those words.
"The current Supreme Ruler... plans to invade my world?" he muttered, stunned at this revelation.
"Though he never stated it outright," the Grand Abyssal Elder said, "the implication was unmistakable."
"And what do the residents of this world think of his plan?" Yuan asked.

"Well, as with most things, there are those who oppose it," the Grand Abyssal Elder replied. "However, I would say the majority welcome the idea. After all, many have grown weary of their current way of life and long for something better."
Yuan rubbed his eyes and let out a deep, weary sigh. His worst fear had finally come to pass.
Even back then, Tian Chenyu had foreseen that things would inevitably reach this point if left unresolved, which was why he had always intended to return one day and find a solution.
"Don't worry. Once I reclaim my position, I will ensure that no invasion takes place," Supreme Ruler Dena said.
"Easier said than done," Yuan replied with a bitter smile.
"Still... given your situation, and the current Supreme Ruler's intentions, I suppose our next destination will be the City of Blood."
She nodded.
"But before we head out, I will need some time to cultivate the Blood Essences I recently acquired. We might need to fight, so it's best we prepare for it."
Yuan turned to look at the Grand Abyssal Elder and said, "We'd like to stay here for a little longer if you don't mind.

The Grand Abyssal Elder nodded and laughed, "Even if you decided to stay here forever, who'd be able to stop you? I will prepare a suitable and quiet dwelling for you immediately. Wait here a little."
The Grand Abyssal Elder left the room for several minutes before returning.
"Your living quarters are ready."
Yuan and his group followed the Grand Abyssal Elder to a small residential area only about ten minutes away.

"There will only be the three of you living in this place, and I have warned the others not to approach this area, so there should be no disturbance at all. If you need anything, there will be someone stationed nearby."
"Thanks for the hospitality. You're not too bad for a group of hired assassins."

A stiff smile tugged at the Grand Abyssal Elder's face as he spoke, "We're not limited to assassinations. In fact, it's a minor part of our whole organization, and we specialize in information gathering."
Under normal circumstances, they would not extend hospitality to anyone—not even the Supreme Ruler, much less to this extent.

However, they were now dealing with someone they deemed even more terrifying than the Supreme Ruler—or at least, that was how they viewed Yuan, having witnessed firsthand just how horrifying he could be.
"How long will you be in seclusion?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked Yuan once the Grand Abyssal Elder left them alone.
"Hmm... hard to say since I have two drops of Blood Essence to absorb, but it probably won't take longer than twenty years."
"Then I will also use this time to really focus on my recovery."
Yuan nodded before turning to look at Lev.
"You don't have to worry about me. There's really nothing for me to do, so I'll just wait for you to be done. Hell, I'll even stand guard to make sure nobody will disturb you two."
"Alright. Then I'll see you two later."
Yuan entered his living quarters and immediately prepared to consume the blood essences.
Since the True Emperor of the Seas was no doubt weaker than the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, Yuan decided to absorb its blood essence first, as it would prepare him for the next one.
Yuan stared at the True Emperor of the Seas' blood essence and mumbled, "I have finally avenged you guys..."
The next moment, he poured the blood essence into his mouth, and it disappeared into his tongue.
<You have consumed True Emperor of the Seas' Blood Essence>

The moment Yuan absorbed the True Emperor of the Seas' Blood Essence, it felt as though he had been dragged into the deepest abyss of the ocean, engulfed in darkness, with crushing pressure bearing down on him from all sides, as if intent on compressing him into nothing more than a formless mass.
He could also feel the True Emperor of the Seas' anguish and seething hatred in its final moments, like a lingering echo of its dying will, desperately clawing at him in a last attempt at vengeance.
"If you couldn't defeat me while alive, what makes you think you can affect me while being dead?! Scram!
In an instant, Yuan blew away the True Emperor of the Seas' last effort and focused on absorbing its blood essence.
A year later—
<You have successfully refined the True Emperor of the Seas' Blood Essence>
<Immortal Monarch's Bloodline is reacting to the True Emperor of the Seas' Blood Essence!>
<Immortal Monarch's Bloodline evolution has progressed slightly!>
<You have acquired the power of the True Emperor of the Seas' through its Blood Essence>
<Your Absolute Regeneration has evolved into Transcended Renewal>
<You have acquired the ability to breath in water>
<You have acquired the ability 'Perfect Water Manipulation'>
<You have acquired the ability 'Sea Emperor'>
Yuan slowly opened his eyes, and for a brief moment, his dark pupils churned like a violent maelstrom—deep and unfathomable, like a storm raging within a black sea.
"So the True Emperor of the Seas' had a Supreme-grade bloodline, huh? That made hunting it even more worth it!" Yuan smiled at the results.

He was also pleasantly surprised that his Absolute Regeneration still had room for improvements, but he couldn't fathom how much better his regeneration could have gotten when he could already regrow his entire body with ease.
Then there was his new ability Perfect Water Manipulation, which basically allowed him to control water as if it were part of his own body.
As for the ability 'Sea Emperor', it was a passive skill that boosted his damage against sea creatures by a tremendous amount.
After taking a brief break, Yuan retrieved the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' Blood Essence and stared at it in silence.
Unlike the True Emperor of the Seas, he hadn't yet grasped the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' prowess. In fact, he had no idea who it could even be compared to.
'Is it near the Primordial Phoenix's level, or perhaps similar to the Dragon God? No... there's no way it could be near the Dragon God's level...'
Although the Primal Sovereign of the Seas was definitely powerful, Yuan couldn't imagine it being anywhere near as strong as the Dragon God, as it simply made no sense.
'A goldfish being at the level of the Dragon God? That would be hilarious.' Yuan shook his head with a smile.
Yuan tempered his expectations, assuming the Blood Essence would be on par with the Primordial Phoenix's, and took a deep breath before consuming it.
<You have absorbed the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' Blood Essence!>
The very next instant, his eyes widened in shock. "Son of a—! That damn goldfish is even stronger than the Dragon God!"
Completely caught off guard by the sheer disparity, Yuan hurriedly steadied himself, bracing for the unbearable pain he knew was about to follow.

Completely caught off guard by the sheer disparity, Yuan hurriedly steadied himself, bracing for the unbearable pain he knew was about to follow.

chapters.title: Chapter 2406 Consuming the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' Blood Essence
paragraphs: 'Primal Sovereign of the Seas... just what the hell are you?!' Yuan cried inwardly after realizing that its Blood Essence was even stronger than the Dragon God.

When he recalled how he nearly died from absorbing the Dragon God's Blood Essence, only surviving because of Dragon Goddess Yeyou, Yuan prepared for a similar if not even worse experience. Shortly after consuming the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' Blood Essence, Yuan once again found himself plunged into the abyss of the ocean.

Yet, despite the familiar sensation from when he had absorbed the True Emperor of the Seas' Blood Essence, there was something fundamentally different about these waters—something far deeper, far more profound.

Moreover, instead of crushing him beneath unbearable pressure, Yuan was stunned to find the water gently embracing him. There was not a trace of pain, only a soothing warmth, as though he were being cradled within a soft, flowing blanket of liquid.
Suddenly, images began flashing within Yuan's mind—fragments of memories that did not belong to him, but to the Primal Sovereign of the Seas.
Within those memories, Yuan witnessed the very beginning of the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' existence.
At the moment of its birth, it was no larger than a speck of dust, and standing before it loomed a colossal, beastly silhouette, its presence vast and incomprehensible... likely its creator.
Over the passage of millions of years, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas grew in both strength and size. Yet its form bore no resemblance to the one Yuan recognized.
Rather than a goldfish, it appeared as something amorphous and undefined—a shifting mass of colorless, formless substance, like a living sphere of translucent slime.
Eventually, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas encountered its first prey, and with it, felt the instinct to hunt for the very first time.
When it successfully claimed its prey, it also experienced something entirely new... the sensation of satisfaction, and the intoxicating thrill of delight.
After consuming its prey, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' formless body began to shift, reshaping itself into the very form of the creature it had just devoured.

With this new appearance, it pursued its next hunt. The sensation of teeth tearing into flesh, the warmth of blood flooding its mouth—everything felt far more vivid, far more intoxicating than its first kill.
From that moment onward, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas hunted without end, relentlessly shifting its form into that of its prey, all in pursuit of ever greater sensation.

Eventually, it came to understand what it truly enjoyed—what brought it the greatest satisfaction—and thus settled upon a form that fulfilled those desires, becoming the figure Yuan had come to recognize.
'So it didn't start its life as a goldfish...' Yuan was somewhat disappointed to learn this. However, what truly surprised him was the beastly silhouette in the beginning of the memory.
'Was that... the Primal Monarch?
Though not even Tian Yi had ever witnessed the Primal Monarch's true form, Yuan somehow knew just from that memory that the being before it was none other than the Primal Monarch.
Does this mean the Primal Monarch had created the Primal Sovereign of the Seas? Would that make the Primal Sovereign of the Seas the Primal Monarch's child? Is that why they bore similar names?
Yuan had a lot of questions but no answers.
<You have successfully refined the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' Blood Essence!>
Before he realized, Yuan had refined its blood essence without experiencing any pain, which was a first.
<Immortal Monarch's Bloodline is reacting to the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' Blood Essence!>
<Immortal Monarch's Bloodline evolution has progressed slightly!>
<You have acquired the power of the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' through its Blood Essence>
<Your ability 'Sea Emperor' has evolved into 'Sovereign of the Sea'>
[Sovereign of the Sea]
[Rank: Celestial]

[Description: When you are in combat, your damage to sea creatures increases by 700,000%. When you are fighting in or surrounded by water, your overall combat prowess will increase by 300,000%] <Your ability 'Perfect Water Manipulation' has evolved into 'Absolute Water Manipulation>
[Absolute Water Manipulation]
[Rank: Celestial]
[Description: The highest level of Water Manipulation! The ocean and all water in this world is at your beckoning!]
<You have acquired the ability 'Water Tunnel'>
[Water Tunnel]
[Rank: Celestial]
[Description: Allows you to traverse between seas that you have visited(after acquiring this ability), regardless of their distance.]

'Water Tunnel? So I can traverse between worlds through the sea like the Primal Sovereign of the Seas?' Yuan was pleasantly surprised to acquire this ability, as this essentially allowed him to traverse anywhere at will.

However, since it only worked with places he'd been to after acquiring the ability, this meant that he wouldn't be able to return to the Nine Heavens or the Primal Expanse until he visited those places again.
Regardless, Yuan was delighted to have this ability due to its conveniences in the future.
<You have acquired 'Mark of the Seas'>
'Mark of the Seas? What is that?' Yuan raised an eyebrow at this notification.
Since the system showed no details of it, Yuan had no idea what it was or its purpose.

Afterward, Yuan contemplated whether he should absorb the True Emperor of the Seas' Monster Core, but after some consideration, decided to wait to see if there were some other uses since he wasn't in a hurry to increase his cultivation.
Some time later, Yuan decided to end his seclusion there and went outside.
"How long have I been in seclusion?" Yuan asked Lev, who was sitting outside like a statue.
"A hundred twenty years," Lev responded.
"That took a hundred twenty years?!" Yuan exclaimed with a shocked face, as it only felt like a few hours had passed since he started.
"What about Dena?" he then asked.
"She emerged from her seclusion earlier, but seeing that you weren't done, she decided to continue. She also said to wake her up once you are finished."
"I see. Then let's wake her up now."

chapters.title: Chapter 2407 Execution Squads
paragraphs: Yuan approached Supreme Ruler Dena's building and loudly knocked on it.
"Hey, Dena, I am done with my seclusion."
A few moments later, the door opened, and Supreme Ruler Dena stepped outside with a nonchalant look on her face.
"Less than twenty years, huh?" she mumbled in a low voice.
A stiff smile tugged at Yuan's lips as he said, "I underestimated the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' Blood Essence. Sorry."
Although a hundred years was nothing to demons, especially one as ancient as Supreme Ruler Dena, Yuan felt bad making them wait so long.
"How is your recovery, by the way?" Yuan then asked her.
"I recovered about 5 percent of my strength, I guess," she calmly replied.

Although five percent might seem insignificant given the time that had passed, one had to remember just how powerful Supreme Ruler Dena truly was, because even a mere five percent of her strength was enough to utterly dominate multiple True Gods at once.
"What about you? Are you satisfied with your cultivation?" Supreme Ruler Dena then asked him.
Yuan nodded, "Yes."
"Or do you want to consume some of my blood before we head to the City of Blood?" she continued.
Yuan raised an eyebrow, as he'd forgotten about her offer.

"I don't even know if I will benefit from absorbing your blood since I am not a demon. I have tried demon blood before out of curiosity, but nothing happened. A demon's core, on the other hand... not that I am asking for yours."
"My blood is different from your ordinary demon's blood. You won't know what effects it will have on you until you try it."
"In that case..."
However, before Yuan could finish his sentence, he suddenly noticed a presence quickly approaching their location.
Soon, this presence revealed himself to be the Grand Abyssal Elder.
"We have a situation!" the Grand Abyssal Elder shouted before he could even land.
"What happened?" Yuan asked.
"We're surrounded!" "Surrounded?" Yuan repeated with a raised eyebrow.
Then, he spread his divine sense until he could see a large group of demons surrounding their valley, all of them being True Gods.
"Who are they?" Yuan asked, narrowing his eyes. "Their attire... it looks somewhat familiar."
This time, it was Supreme Ruler Dena who answered instead of the Grand Abyssal Elder.

"The Elite Execution Squad and the Special Execution Squad," she said. "They are specialized enforcers tasked with handling the most extreme cases—situations beyond the capability of ordinary forces. And they answer only to the Supreme Ruler."
"Is that so? I guess the current Supreme Ruler sent them here after learning of your escape from the Deprived Crimson Valley," Yuan said with a calm smile.
"What should we do?" she asked.
Yuan looked at the Grand Abyssal Elder and asked, "I should've probably asked earlier, but did they say what they wanted? There's a slight chance that they aren't here for us."

However, the Grand Abyssal Elder shook his head and said, "No, they are definitely here for you. They first inquired about your group, and when we denied any knowledge, they immediately surrounded us without a word."
"What do you think?" Yuan asked Supreme Ruler Dena.
"They know they can't defeat me, so they're probably going to try and stall for time until the current Supreme Ruler shows up."
"Oh? So the Supreme Ruler will show up without needing us to travel to the City of Blood? How convenient," Yuan smiled.
"What do you want to do? Wait for him to show up, or leave this place before he arrives?" she then asked.
Yuan pondered for a moment before responding, "Let's have a chat with this special squad."
The next moment, he flew out of the valley to confront the Execution Squads.

When the Execution Squads initially saw Yuan, they didn't think much of him and thought he was from the Abyssal Council. However, their expressions and attitude changed when Yuan asked them, "So, how did you figure out Supreme Ruler Dena was here?"

Their eyes widened in disbelief the moment Yuan uttered Supreme Ruler Dena's name so casually. They froze in place, as though their minds refused to process what they had just heard. Then, realization struck.
Without hesitation, they distanced themselves from him, panic flashing across their faces as they anticipated the Demon God's Wrath.
"This lunatic! He's trying to drag us down with him!"
The Execution Squad members fled as though their lives depended on it despite being True Gods.
Yet, after putting a great distance between themselves and Yuan, and as time passed with no sign of divine retribution, confusion began to set in.
"Huh? Where's the Demon God's Wrath?"
They looked toward the still sky with raised eyebrows.
Meanwhile, Yuan continued to mess with them and shouted loudly, "DID YOU NOT HEAR ME? I ASKED HOW YOU KNEW SUPREME RULER DENA WAS HERE! SUPREME RULER DENA, I SAID!"
"This crazy son of a bitch!"
The Execution Squads distanced themselves from Yuan even more.
"What the hell is going on?! Where is the Demon God's Wrath?! Why isn't it striking him down?!"
Seeing this puzzling situation, the demons felt an urge to say Supreme Ruler Dena's name to see if something was wrong with their law.
"Supreme Ruler Dena! Supreme Ruler Dena! Supreme Ruler Dena!!!" Yuan started repeating her name over and over again like a broken recorder.
Eventually, one of the demons from the Execution Squad could no longer contain their curiosity and uttered her name.
"Supreme Ruler Dena...?"
The demon felt a wave of excitement course through his body from uttering a forbidden word, feeling like a child who'd purposefully done something mischievous.
However, that excitement vanished the next moment when the sky above him began to twist.
"D-Demon God's Wrath?!"
"What the hell?! Why did it activate for me but not that bastard?!" The demon exclaimed in disbelief.
The demon wanted to complain more, but it had no time, as the Demon God's Wrath struck the next second, instantly vaporizing it.

chapters.title: Chapter 2408 Execution Squads(2)
paragraphs: "Bree! That bastard killed Bree!"

After a stunned silence, the demons of the Execution Squad erupted into anguished cries for their fallen comrade, directing their grief and fury toward Yuan, despite the fact that Bree's death had ultimately been brought about by his own reckless curiosity.
They quickly flew toward Yuan and surrounded him.
"I don't care who you are, but you will pay for killing our comrade!" one of them shouted at him.
Yuan raised an eyebrow and replied, "How was his death my fault? It's not like I forced him to speak or anything like that."
"Bastard! It's because you kept shouting Supreme Ruler Dena that caused—" The demon hastily covered his mouth when he realized his own mistake, but alas, it was already too late.
The sky above the demon swirled, and the Demon God's Wrath fell shortly after, instantly vaporizing it.
The demons around that individual scrambled away in the last second, barely avoiding the Demon God's Wrath.
"J-Jean!"
The demons cried out once more, but this time their expressions were filled with disbelief rather than grief, as it was clear that the demon's fate had been sealed by his own careless words.
"You're not going to blame that one on me too, right?" Yuan remarked.
The demons immediately snapped their heads to glare at him with intense killing intent exuding from them.
They had no idea who Yuan was or why the Demon God's Wrath wasn't affecting him, but it was clear that he'd indirectly caused the death of two of their comrades.
Seeing the way they glared at him, like a pot on the verge of boiling over, Yuan spoke again, utterly unfazed, "So... care to answer my question? How did you know Supreme Ruler Dena was—"
"I SWEAR TO THE DEMON GOD, IF YOU UTTER THAT NAME ONE MORE TIME!!!"
The demons stood on the brink of attacking Yuan, their restraint hanging by a thread.
The only reason they had not already made their move, despite losing two of their own, was the Supreme Ruler's strict command to hold off until his arrival.
Moreover, Supreme Ruler Dena's presence weighed heavily on them. If she chose to intervene, they knew with absolute certainty that none of them would survive.
"What name? Supreme Ruler Dena?" Yuan inquired with a genuine-looking puzzled face.
"FUCK! LET'S KILL THIS BASTARD!"
Just as the demons began to move, a terrifying pressure descended upon them, freezing their bodies in place.
"T-This pressure! It's her! She's really here!"

Their expressions darkened, color draining from their faces as the realization settled in. Until now, her presence at the Abyssal Council had only been a suspicion—an educated guess formed after their exchange with the Crimson Broker whom Yuan had questioned. But now there was no doubt.
The next moment, before any of them could even react properly, a figure appeared beside Yuan like a ghost.
It was Supreme Ruler Dena in her original appearance.

Her crimson gaze calmly swept the demons, as if trying to memorize their faces. Then, she muttered in a nonchalant voice, "I heard you were looking for me? Did the current Supreme Ruler send you here?"
"S-Supreme—!"
The demons nearly uttered her name at her sudden appearance.

"What's wrong? You were looking for me, right? Well, here I am. What are you going to do now?" Supreme Ruler Dena slowly approached these demons. Yet, none of them dared to move, almost as if they were frozen in fear.
Even when she was a step away from one of them, they merely hovered there in silence like stone statues.
Supreme Ruler Dena quickly lost interest and turned to look at Yuan, asking, "What now?"

Yuan pondered for a moment before responding, "Although having the Supreme Ruler come here would save us some time, if we fought here, this entire place would be destroyed. Moreover, we need to head to the City of Blood regardless, so we might as well just meet him there.
He then turned to the Execution Squad and said, "Tell your Supreme Ruler to stay put in the City of Blood because we'll go to him."
"Shut up! Who the hell do you think you are to command—?!"
The demon's words died abruptly in his throat when he sensed that a gaze had fallen upon him.
It was calm—eerily so—but the moment he felt it, his entire body stiffened, and a suffocating chill crept up his spine as instinct screamed at him.

Yuan sighed and said, "Even if we want to leave, what can you do to stop us? Do you really think you can stall us long enough for the Supreme Ruler to come? Even without Dena's help, I can kill all of you before your Supreme Ruler arrives."
The demons wanted to argue against Yuan's claims but decided to remain silent.

They exchanged glances, speaking through voice transmission with each other before one finally spoke. "We will inform the Supreme Ruler. However, you must allow one of us to remain here—to ensure you don't attempt to flee."
"Run away?" Yuan let out a soft chuckle, his tone laced with amusement. "Very well. If leaving one of you behind to spy on us spares us a meaningless fight, we'll indulge you."
The Execution Squad quickly gathered as they contemplated who to leave behind.
It didn't take long for them to reach a decision.
Their gazes slowly shifted toward a single figure among them... a purple-skinned female demon.
No one voiced it aloud, but everyone understood why. If something were to go wrong and she were to perish, their loss would matter the least.
The purple-skinned demon didn't complain and silently nodded her head, quietly accepting her fate.
Then, without another word, both the Special Execution Squad and the Elite Execution Squad left the scene, leaving behind the purple-skinned demon.
"They really left you behind, huh?" Yuan suddenly appeared behind the demon like a ghost and remarked, startling her greatly.
"Get away from me, you freak!" she exclaimed as she distanced herself.

But now there was no doubt.
The next moment, before any of them could even react properly, a figure appeared beside Yuan like a ghost.
It was Supreme Ruler Dena in her original appearance.
Her crimson gaze calmly swept the demons, as if trying to memorize their faces.
Then, she muttered in a nonchalant voice, "I heard you were looking for me?
Did the current Supreme Ruler send you here?"
"S-Supreme—!"
The demons nearly uttered her name at her sudden appearance.
"What's wrong?
You were looking for me, right?
Well, here I am.
What are you going to do now?" Supreme Ruler Dena slowly approached these demons.
Yet, none of them dared to move, almost as if they were frozen in fear.
Even when she was a step away from one of them, they merely hovered there in silence like stone statues.
Supreme Ruler Dena quickly lost interest and turned to look at Yuan, asking, "What now?"
Yuan pondered for a moment before responding, "Although having the Supreme Ruler come here would save us some time, if we fought here, this entire place would be destroyed.
Moreover, we need to head to the City of Blood regardless, so we might as well just meet him there.
He then turned to the Execution Squad and said, "Tell your Supreme Ruler to stay put in the City of Blood because we'll go to him."
"Shut up!
Who the hell do you think you are to command—?!"
The demon's words died abruptly in his throat when he sensed that a gaze had fallen upon him.
It was calm—eerily so—but the moment he felt it, his entire body stiffened, and a suffocating chill crept up his spine as instinct screamed at him.
Yuan sighed and said, "Even if we want to leave, what can you do to stop us?
Do you really think you can stall us long enough for the Supreme Ruler to come?
Even without Dena's help, I can kill all of you before your Supreme Ruler arrives."
The demons wanted to argue against Yuan's claims but decided to remain silent.
They exchanged glances, speaking through voice transmission with each other before one finally spoke.
"We will inform the Supreme Ruler.
However, you must allow one of us to remain here—to ensure you don't attempt to flee."
"Run away?" Yuan let out a soft chuckle, his tone laced with amusement.
"Very well.
If leaving one of you behind to spy on us spares us a meaningless fight, we'll indulge you."
The Execution Squad quickly gathered as they contemplated who to leave behind.
It didn't take long for them to reach a decision.
Their gazes slowly shifted toward a single figure among them... a purple-skinned female demon.
No one voiced it aloud, but everyone understood why.
If something were to go wrong and she were to perish, their loss would matter the least.
The purple-skinned demon didn't complain and silently nodded her head, quietly accepting her fate.
Then, without another word, both the Special Execution Squad and the Elite Execution Squad left the scene, leaving behind the purple-skinned demon.
"They really left you behind, huh?" Yuan suddenly appeared behind the demon like a ghost and remarked, startling her greatly.
"Get away from me, you freak!" she exclaimed as she distanced herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 2409 Evacuating the City of Blood
paragraphs: "A freak? That's a little rude," Yuan said with a calm smile on his face. "Aren't you worried that I might kill you for that offense?"
The purple-skinned demon trembled slightly before responding with clenched fists, "K-Kill me if you want! The Supreme Ruler will definitely avenge me!"
She spoke with such confidence in her voice that it would've likely convinced even Buddha himself.
"I wouldn't be so sure if I were you," Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly joined in on the conversation. "Even I was not able to kill him, after all."
"What?"
The demon looked at her with a dumbfounded look on her face.
She wanted to ask for Yuan's identity, but before she could do so, Yuan spoke, "Anyway, a purple-skinned demon, huh? Even I have never seen a demon with your color before. Where are you from?"

Although the majority of demons were red-skinned and grey-skinned, there were occasionally demons born with rare skin colors, such as yellow, green, and even blue. However, Yuan had never heard of a purple demon before.
"You can ask me all you want, but I won't tell you anything," she sneered.
"If you tell me, I'll tell you my name," Yuan said with a faint smile.
The demon's body went rigid.

Though she had been left behind to watch them, she knew that wasn't her only purpose. The others hadn't said it aloud, but their expectations were clear. She needed to observe, probe, and extract whatever information she could from them.
"Fine, I'll tell you," she quickly agreed. "I'm from a small, remote land called the Violet Hollow."
Yuan turned to look at Supreme Ruler Dena and asked, "Ever heard of it?"

Supreme Ruler Dena fell silent for a moment, sifting through her memories before finally responding, "I have. It's a peculiar place where almost everything there is dyed in shades of purple, from the trees to even the waters surrounding it."
"As for the island itself, there's a massive hole at its center, hence the name."
"I have answered your question, Now, tell me your name."
"My current name is Yuan, but I used to go by a different name in this place," he said with a smile.
"What were you called before?" she continued asking.
"That's not important, and I have already given you my name." Yuan shrugged.
"Anyway, I will let the Grand Abyssal Elder know that we'll be leaving now."
He left the next moment while Supreme Ruler Dena stayed behind with the demon.
When Yuan returned to the valley, he was surprised to find thousands of demons gathered at the entrance, presumably the entire Abyssal Council, and they appeared to be ready to defend the place.
"Relax," Yuan said to them. "The Supreme Ruler's lackeys have already left."
"But they will definitely come back!" Someone loudly shouted.
"No, they won't."
"How can you be so sure?!" "Because they are only here for us, and we'll be leaving now for the City of Blood to meet the Supreme Ruler there," Yuan calmly revealed.

The Grand Abyssal Elder appeared at the scene the next moment and said, "Even if that is true, it doesn't change the fact that we have sheltered you and lied to them. They will definitely return to punish us later. However, since they left and won't be coming back soon, we can use this time to relocate."
"Sorry for the trouble," Yuan said.

The Grand Abyssal Elder shook his head and said, "There is no need for you to apologize, as such is the fate for people like us. I have barely escaped death once, and I will not allow it to get near me for a second time."
"It was an honor to meet you again, Demon Sealer surnamed 'Tian'."
The Grand Abyssal Elder turned to face the others and loudly commanded, "We're leaving! Pack your shit and return here within half an hour!"
"Yes!"
The demons immediately scrambled.
Yuan didn't interrupt them and left without another word.
"Hey, we're leaving." Yuan used voice transmission to speak to Lev, who was still back at their living quarters.
Lev hastily followed Yuan back to Supreme Ruler Dena and the purple-skinned demon.
"What's your name?" Yuan asked the demon when he returned.
"I'm not telling you until you tell me your other name," she sneered.
"Then I'll just call you Purple," Yuan shrugged.
"Let's go, Purple. Lead us to the City of Blood," he then said, treating her like a guide dog.
Purple wanted to complain, but since that was her job, she decided to suck it up.
Shortly later, she started guiding them toward the City of Blood.
Meanwhile, in the City of Blood, the current Supreme Ruler received news of the situation.
"Supreme Ruler, we must evacuate the city immediately and prepare to fight her!" The current Supreme Adviser said with urgency in his face and voice.
"Fight her?" The Supreme Ruler scoffed. "She's called the most powerful demon in history for a reason. Even I am not confident I could defeat her if we clashed directly without any preparations."
"Prepare the Demon God's Formation. We'll need to weaken her first before we confront her. I will also attempt to seek guidance from the Demon God, so I will be gone for some time."
"Yes!" The Supreme Adviser nodded before hurrying away.
Before he started preparing for the Demon God's Formation, the Supreme Adviser made sure to send out an evacuation order to the entire City of Blood.

Of course, he didn't reveal the real reason behind the evacuation, as he was certain people would panic if they knew Supreme Ruler Dena had escaped the Deprived Crimson Valley and was returning to the city soon.
Within days, the entire City of Blood became as empty as a ghost town, resembling a certain incident that shocked the entire world, and the people started to speculate the reason for the evacuation.
Meanwhile, the Supreme Ruler attempted to contact the Demon God at the Demon God's Altar.

chapters.title: Chapter 2410 The Demon God's Assistance
paragraphs: The Supreme Ruler knelt before a crimson altar centered in a pond of blood, kowtowing as he murmured, "O Demon God, creator of this world, your loyal child seeks your enlightenment."
Moments passed with no response from the altar or the Demon God. Still the Supreme Ruler kept kowtowing. Hours stretched into days, and weeks passed without any sign or answer.

Yet, the Supreme Ruler remained as still as a statue. When trying to communicate with the Demon God, it was normal for the Supreme Ruler to wait for years, even decades. Throughout history the Supreme Rulers attempted contact with the Demon God hundreds—if not thousands—of times, yet the responses were so rare they could be counted on one hand, or even just three fingers.
The only time a Supreme Ruler is guaranteed to hear the Demon God's voice is during the Succession Ritual where they become the Supreme Ruler, when they receive its guidance and blessing.

After nearly three months of waiting, the Supreme Ruler's ears twitched at the sound of popping bubbles. The blood pond before him began to boil without warning with countless bubbles forming and bursting.

'There's a response?! But what is this? I have never heard of such a reaction before!' The Supreme Ruler cried inwardly. But despite his curiosity, he did not dare to lift his head or even use divine sense to look at the phenomenon. Soon, the blood pond fell eerily still once more.
A few moments later, a ripple spread across the blood pond, though nothing visible had disturbed it, as if an invisible drop of liquid had fallen into its depths.
At this moment, the Supreme Ruler could not sense or hear anything. In fact, he wasn't even aware of the ripple that appeared on the surface of the blood pond.
"Speak."
A voice suddenly commanded.
At the sound of that voice, which sounded so close it seemed to come from right before him, the Supreme Ruler instinctively began to lift his head, then hastily stopped and bowed even lower.

The Supreme Ruler was stunned, his thoughts overheating as he wondered if the Demon God had actually manifested before him. If so, it would be unprecedented, as never once in history had the Demon God appeared in person.
"Why aren't you speaking? You were the one who summoned me," the Demon God said, his tone faintly annoyed.

"M‐My deepest apologies!" the Supreme Ruler stammered. "I blanked out for a moment, as I never imagined you would appear in person, Demon God! You must be here because you already know of ex-Supreme Ruler Dena's escape from the Deprived Crimson Valley and have guidance for me!"
However, the Demon God's response left the Supreme Ruler utterly speechless.
"No, I showed up because I happened to be in the area. As for that child Dena, I couldn't care less about her situation or how you intend to deal with her."
"Then..." The Supreme Ruler didn't know how to respond or if he should even ask the Demon God for its assistance.
The Demon God continued, "That being said, I didn't come here just to do nothing."

The next moment, the Supreme Ruler sensed the Demon God's presence drawing near until it loomed directly before him. Then, he felt something like a drop of blood descended onto the crown of his head, and an unfathomable power instantly surged through his entire body.
"T‐This is—?!" The Supreme Ruler trembled with excitement.
"I have just bestowed you some power. Do what you will with it," the Demon God said casually before his presence faded away, leaving without any explanation.
Even though the Supreme Ruler could no longer sense the Demon God's presence, he spent the next several days thanking it nonstop.
Meanwhile, somewhere in the starry sky, the Demon God watched with an amused smile.

"Though I swore never to intervene directly in my own world—even if its people destroyed it—I'll make an exception this time. Not only did that monster break our agreement, but it wouldn't be fair to that child to face him without any assistance."
Once the Supreme Ruler was finished, he immediately entered seclusion to better understand his new powers.
Meanwhile, Yuan and his group were still traveling to the City of Blood.
"Yuan, I'm hungry." Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly said to him.

"I guess it's been a while..." Yuan didn't say anything else and loosened the clothes around his neck. Since there was a good chance they might have to fight the Supreme Ruler, it would be wise to help Supreme Ruler Dena recover as much strength as possible before they arrived.
When she saw Yuan's smooth, tempting neck, Supreme Ruler Dena couldn't help but drool inwardly before latching onto his back and biting into his neck like a bloodthirsty fiend.
'What the hell are they doing?!'
Purple, who had never seen such a scene before, stared in bewilderment at Supreme Ruler Dena sucking on Yuan's neck with a blissful expression like a baby with a pacifier.
Then the scent of Yuan's blood reached her, and her mouth instantly began to water.
'Why does his blood smell so damn good?!' Purple was shocked to find herself craving a taste of Yuan's blood even though she'd never liked the taste of demon blood.
Seeing Purple's expression, Lev shook his head and warned her, "You can forget about it. That blood is reserved for her."

"Don't tell me his real identity is being her livestock?" Purple inquired with a weird look on her face. It wasn't weird for demons to keep livestocks, especially those with power and influence. However, these people usually kept their livestocks at home.
'But that doesn't explain why he could bypass the Demon God's Wrath...' she thought inwardly.
"Hey, your blood is even more delicious than before," Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly stopped consuming his blood and remarked.
"Did your seclusion have anything to do with this?" she then asked.

Yuan raised an eyebrow at her comment, wondering if enhancing his regeneration had somehow made his blood taste better to demons. Until now, he'd assumed it was related to the Immortal Monarch's Bloodline.
