chapters.title: Chapter 2411 Void Manipulation Training
paragraphs: 'The Immortal Monarch's Bloodline makes my blood a delicacy for beasts, but demons aren't beasts, so it shouldn't taste any different to them,' Yuan mused. 'If my regeneration ability affects how my blood tastes to demons, though, that would explain why Dena thinks it's gotten better...'

In the past, Tian Chenyu had gained regeneration on par with demons simply by consuming their cores, and even then Supreme Ruler Dena claimed his blood tasted better than demon blood. Yuan's regeneration had long since surpassed Tian Chenyu's peak, so it made sense that his blood now tasted even better than before.
Moreover, stronger demons had stronger regeneration and thus, stronger blood techniques.
"How long until we arrive at the City of Blood?" Yuan asked.
"About a thousand five hundred years at our current pace," Purple replied calmly, as though such a span of time were nothing out of the ordinary.
After all, with their limitless longevity, their perception of time had long since become skewed.
"There must be a faster way to get there. Can't we just use teleport formations?" Yuan asked.
"Teleport formations? Do you have any idea how tiring it is to use those? We will also need to use them several times, so I'll pass on that." Purple sneered.

Since the Demonic Realm lacked spirit stones, teleportation formations had to be powered by one's own energy. As a result, such methods of travel were rarely used and were typically reserved for emergencies.
As for the Abyssal Council's concealment formation, it was maintained by a dedicated group of demons whose sole purpose was to keep it active, supplying it with energy at all times.
There were, of course, resources that could power formations, but they were considered far too valuable to waste on such uses.

In truth, though, neither of these was Purple's real reason for avoiding the teleport formations. She knew the Supreme Ruler was already aware of their situation and likely preparing for their arrival, so she simply wanted to stall for time.
"Aren't you worried about upsetting the Supreme Ruler for making him wait too long?" Yuan asked.
"The Supreme Ruler is a very understanding person, so we'll be fine," she said.
Yuan pondered for a moment before speaking again, "Oh, I know. We can just travel using Void Manipulation."
"What?" Purple and Lev turned to look at him with wide eyes.
"Do you have any idea how far the City of Blood is? Nobody can cross that kind of distance with Void Manipulation in a single jump!"
Supreme Ruler Dena wanted to say that she could do exactly that, but it was only if she was at her full strength.
Yuan shook his head.
"Who said anything about doing it in one go? We can just keep hopping short distances until we get there."

"That's even more ridiculous! You make Void Manipulation sound easy, but can you even use it? We'd spend more energy than if we just used teleport formations!" Purple sighed, feeling like she was talking to someone unreasonably ignorant. Of course, Yuan was aware that it wasn't easy using Void Manipulation. However, he saw this as an opportunity to train his Void Manipulation.
He also knew that Purple was trying to stall them, but he couldn't care less.
"Umm... I cannot use Void Manipulation..." Lev suddenly said.
"Don't worry, I'll take you with me," Yuan said with a smile.
Bringing others into the void would cost more energy, which would only accelerate his training.
"I don't even trust you to watch my back, so what makes you think I'll trust you not to screw up using Void Manipulation with us?!" Purple exclaimed in disbelief.
Yuan looked at her and shrugged, "You don't have to come with us if you don't want to. And just so we are clear, we're not following you. We're allowing you to follow us."
"If you don't want to come with me, then you're free to chase after us."
Purple gritted her teeth in frustration, but Yuan was right. If they went ahead and left her behind, there was nothing she could really do about it.
Still, she wasn't willing to trust Yuan's Void Manipulation and said, "You can go without me. I want to see how long you'll be able to keep using it before you run out of energy!
Yuan nodded and, without hesitation, used Void Manipulation while carrying Lev and Supreme Ruler Dena, traversing several dozen miles in the blink of an eye.
Although Supreme Ruler Dena could easily use Void Manipulation herself, she was still feasting on Yuan's blood, and he'd rather let her conserve her energy.
Meanwhile, Purple also used Void Manipulation to follow them.
<Void Manipulation>
<Void Manipulation>
<Void Manipulation>
Yuan would only emerge from the void for a brief second before entering it again, making it look as though he was teleporting constantly.
<Your understanding of Void Manipulation has increased slightly!>
The more Yuan's proficiency with it increased, the further he was able to traverse in the void.
In just a few short years, Yuan's Void Manipulation improved so much that he went from traversing several dozen miles to several hundred miles.

'This guy has been using Void Manipulation nonstop for six years straight while carrying two people, but he doesn't seem tired in the slightest! Just how much energy does he have?!' Purple cried inwardly as she was starting to feel exhausted from constantly using Void Manipulation to chase after them.
Using Void Manipulation didn't just require spiritual energy. It also required Soul Strength, and most people cannot recover Soul Strength as fast as they could recover spiritual energy.
Of course, there was no way for Purple to know about Yuan's unfathomably powerful Soul Strength, as well as his soul cultivation technique that constantly strengthens it.
After another ten years, Purple was completely exhausted and could no longer continue using Void Manipulation.
"W-Wait!" she shouted at them. "What is it?" Yuan casually used Void Manipulation to teleport in front of her and asked in a nonchalant voice.

sentences.text: 'The Immortal Monarch's Bloodline makes my blood a delicacy for beasts, but demons aren't beasts, so it shouldn't taste any different to them,' Yuan mused. 'If my regeneration ability affects how my blood tastes to demons, though, that would explain why Dena thinks it's gotten better...'
In the past, Tian Chenyu had gained regeneration on par with demons simply by consuming their cores, and even then Supreme Ruler Dena claimed his blood tasted better than demon blood.
Yuan's regeneration had long since surpassed Tian Chenyu's peak, so it made sense that his blood now tasted even better than before.
Moreover, stronger demons had stronger regeneration and thus, stronger blood techniques.
"How long until we arrive at the City of Blood?" Yuan asked.
"About a thousand five hundred years at our current pace," Purple replied calmly, as though such a span of time were nothing out of the ordinary.
After all, with their limitless longevity, their perception of time had long since become skewed.
"There must be a faster way to get there.
Can't we just use teleport formations?" Yuan asked.
"Teleport formations?
Do you have any idea how tiring it is to use those?
We will also need to use them several times, so I'll pass on that." Purple sneered.
Since the Demonic Realm lacked spirit stones, teleportation formations had to be powered by one's own energy.
As a result, such methods of travel were rarely used and were typically reserved for emergencies.
As for the Abyssal Council's concealment formation, it was maintained by a dedicated group of demons whose sole purpose was to keep it active, supplying it with energy at all times.
There were, of course, resources that could power formations, but they were considered far too valuable to waste on such uses.
In truth, though, neither of these was Purple's real reason for avoiding the teleport formations.
She knew the Supreme Ruler was already aware of their situation and likely preparing for their arrival, so she simply wanted to stall for time.
"Aren't you worried about upsetting the Supreme Ruler for making him wait too long?" Yuan asked.
"The Supreme Ruler is a very understanding person, so we'll be fine," she said.
Yuan pondered for a moment before speaking again, "Oh, I know.
We can just travel using Void Manipulation."
"What?" Purple and Lev turned to look at him with wide eyes.
"Do you have any idea how far the City of Blood is?
Nobody can cross that kind of distance with Void Manipulation in a single jump!"
Supreme Ruler Dena wanted to say that she could do exactly that, but it was only if she was at her full strength.
Yuan shook his head.
"Who said anything about doing it in one go?
We can just keep hopping short distances until we get there."
"That's even more ridiculous!
You make Void Manipulation sound easy, but can you even use it?
We'd spend more energy than if we just used teleport formations!" Purple sighed, feeling like she was talking to someone unreasonably ignorant.
Of course, Yuan was aware that it wasn't easy using Void Manipulation.
However, he saw this as an opportunity to train his Void Manipulation.
He also knew that Purple was trying to stall them, but he couldn't care less.
"Umm...
I cannot use Void Manipulation..." Lev suddenly said.
"Don't worry, I'll take you with me," Yuan said with a smile.
Bringing others into the void would cost more energy, which would only accelerate his training.
"I don't even trust you to watch my back, so what makes you think I'll trust you not to screw up using Void Manipulation with us?!" Purple exclaimed in disbelief.
Yuan looked at her and shrugged, "You don't have to come with us if you don't want to.
And just so we are clear, we're not following you.
We're allowing you to follow us."
"If you don't want to come with me, then you're free to chase after us."
Purple gritted her teeth in frustration, but Yuan was right.
If they went ahead and left her behind, there was nothing she could really do about it.
Still, she wasn't willing to trust Yuan's Void Manipulation and said, "You can go without me.
I want to see how long you'll be able to keep using it before you run out of energy!
Yuan nodded and, without hesitation, used Void Manipulation while carrying Lev and Supreme Ruler Dena, traversing several dozen miles in the blink of an eye.
Although Supreme Ruler Dena could easily use Void Manipulation herself, she was still feasting on Yuan's blood, and he'd rather let her conserve her energy.
Meanwhile, Purple also used Void Manipulation to follow them.
<Void Manipulation>
<Void Manipulation>
<Void Manipulation>
Yuan would only emerge from the void for a brief second before entering it again, making it look as though he was teleporting constantly.
<Your understanding of Void Manipulation has increased slightly!>
The more Yuan's proficiency with it increased, the further he was able to traverse in the void.
In just a few short years, Yuan's Void Manipulation improved so much that he went from traversing several dozen miles to several hundred miles.
'This guy has been using Void Manipulation nonstop for six years straight while carrying two people, but he doesn't seem tired in the slightest!
Just how much energy does he have?!' Purple cried inwardly as she was starting to feel exhausted from constantly using Void Manipulation to chase after them.
Using Void Manipulation didn't just require spiritual energy.
It also required Soul Strength, and most people cannot recover Soul Strength as fast as they could recover spiritual energy.
Of course, there was no way for Purple to know about Yuan's unfathomably powerful Soul Strength, as well as his soul cultivation technique that constantly strengthens it.
After another ten years, Purple was completely exhausted and could no longer continue using Void Manipulation.
"W-Wait!" she shouted at them.
"What is it?" Yuan casually used Void Manipulation to teleport in front of her and asked in a nonchalant voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 2412 Void Manipulation Training(2)
paragraphs: "I...I..." Purple hesitated, struggling to ask Yuan to carry her. After all, she had rejected his offer earlier, and now the thought of asking for his help felt somewhat embarrassing.
"Are you tired?" Yuan asked with a smile on his face, and he continued, "I don't mind carrying you, but you'll need to ask nicely, considering how rude you were before."

"Wha—! I wasn't being rude! I was merely being realistic!" she exclaimed, defending herself. "Who in their right mind would trust a first-level False God to use Void Manipulation properly?! Not a single True God out there! Especially when we're enemies!"
"You see me as an enemy?" Yuan remarked with a chuckle. "Unfortunately, you don't qualify."
"I don't qualify? Big talk for some who is just livestock!"
"Livestock?" Yuan raised an eyebrow.
Yuan had been so focused on his training that he completely forgot about Supreme Ruler Dena, who had been feasting on his blood this whole time.
"You're still drinking my blood? Aren't you satisfied by now?" Yuan asked her, who was still sucking away without a care in the world.

Supreme Ruler Dena removed her lips from his neck and licked it clean before replying, "The more I drink your blood, the tastier it tastes. It is like I am having a different meal with each mouthful, and I cannot get enough of it!"
"But is it helping with your recovery?" he asked.
"Yes. If I continue drinking your blood, I should recover at least 70 percent of my strength by the time we arrive at the City of Blood."
Purple raised an eyebrow after overhearing their conversation and thought to herself, 'She's injured...?'

That's when Purple realized she had made a grave mistake. Had she not attempted to stall them, Supreme Ruler Dena would have arrived at the City of Blood in a weakened state, making her far easier to deal with.

Unfortunately, it was a misstep she could no longer correct without raising suspicion. If she suddenly urged them to use a teleportation formation to hasten their arrival, it would only make her intentions all the more questionable.
Purple felt like kicking herself in the butt over her mistake, unaware that Yuan was already expecting an ambush in the City of Blood.
"In that case, drink as much as you want." Yuan said to her before looking at Purple again and resuming their conversation in a nonchalant manner, "So, do you want me to carry you or not?"
Purple gritted her teeth and silently nodded her head.
Yuan tilted his head slightly, turning his ear toward her as he cupped a hand behind it. "What was that? I didn't quite catch it.
Purple clenched her fists in frustration before speaking loudly, "Can you take me with you?! Please!"
Without another word, Yuan activated Void Manipulation and resumed his training with an additional training load.
Although a single additional individual may not seem like a lot, Yuan could instantly feel a difference, and he was no longer able to traverse as much distance as before.
However, it also sped up his progress, so he didn't complain and even welcomed it.
'At the rate he's improving and our pace, we will arrive at the City of Blood in less than five hundred years!' Purple thought to herself.
A few years later—
<Your Void Manipulation mastery has reached a new level>
The moment Yuan's Void Manipulation reached a new level, he could instantly traverse ten thousand miles with a single leap through the void.
However, even with his Void Manipulation reaching a new level, his Advanced Void Understanding has barely approached the next level.
"Hey, Dena, how do you train your Void Manipulation?" Yuan suddenly asked her.
She stopped feasting on his blood to respond, "Do you want to see it?"
He quickly nodded.
Supreme Ruler Dena then got off his back and said, "Watch carefully."
She activated Void Manipulation and vanished into the void. Yet, even after several moments had passed, she did not return.
Yuan raised a brow and followed after her, stepping into the void to see what she was doing.
Within that formless expanse, he was met with a shocking sight—Supreme Ruler Dena stood utterly defenseless, allowing the void itself to tear her body apart.
Normally, one would manipulate the void carefully, ensuring it never came into contact with their body, as the void itself was inherently destructive, capable of eroding anything it touched.
However, Supreme Ruler Dena did the opposite. She allowed it to ravage her freely, relying on her superior regeneration to outpace the damage and continuously restore her body.
"I find it easier to understand it when I am touching it," she calmly explained. "But it might be different for you."
"Heavens... how did I never think of such a simple training method before?" Yuan muttered in a daze. Sometimes the simplest ideas are the easiest to overlook.

The next moment, Yuan stopped pushing away the void and allowed it to ravage his body. The instant it touched his skin, he felt himself being torn apart, and not just his flesh ripping, but his entire body being destroyed and vaporized by an unstoppable force.
Even with his immense tolerance for pain, the agony was almost unbearable. Still, the results were worth it, as his Void Manipulation and Void Comprehension advanced at a remarkable pace.
However, since Yuan's Void Manipulation was nowhere near Supreme Ruler Dena's level, he was only able to remain in the void for about half an hour before he had to exit and enter again.
"I am going to train like this for a few years," Yuan suddenly declared.
Supreme Ruler Dena then asked, "Does that mean I won't be able to drink your blood?"
"It'll only be for a few years."
"Fine..." Supreme Ruler Dena muttered, but then her eyes flickered, as if she thought of something.
"In that case, I'll use this time to prepare my blood for you."
"Oh?"
"I promised that I'd let you taste my blood if you let me drink yours, after all."

chapters.title: Chapter 2413 Consuming Supreme Ruler Dena’s Blood
paragraphs: 'What in Demon God's name did she just say? That she'll let him drink her blood?' Purple stared at Supreme Ruler Dena in disbelief, her eyes as wide as saucers. 'Why the hell would a being like her let someone taste her blood, let alone a mere livestock?!'

Even though Supreme Ruler Dena was no longer in power, it didn't change the fact that she had once held the title and remained one of the most powerful demons in the world. For a Supreme Ruler to share their blood was akin to an emperor bestowing their own power on a subject. It was simply unthinkable, especially for a loyal subject like Purple.
"Then I'll start my training now. The two of you can do whatever." Yuan said to Lev and Purple before entering the void to resume his training.
<Your understanding of the Power of the Void has improved moderately>
<Your understanding of Void Manipulation has improved significantly>

Not long after beginning his training, Yuan realized that this training method felt all too familiar, as he was already used to training himself in similar ways, repeatedly pushing his body to the extreme through pain and destruction.

For example, when he trained in the Primal Expanse by poisoning himself in the Baneful Dragon's Poisonous Swamp, when he roasted himself like a chicken in the Nine Levels of Hell, and when he constantly destroyed his body at the Sky Splitting Dragon's Tribulation.
If one had to describe Yuan's training methods in one word, it would definitely be masochistic.
In just a few short months, Yuan was able to extend his time within the void without leaving from half an hour to almost six hours.
After another year, that six hours became nearly a full day.
<Your Void Manipulation mastery has reached a new level>
Then another five years passed in the blink of an eye.
<Your Void Manipulation mastery has reached a new level>
By now, Yuan could remain inside the void for nearly three days without coming out.
In the blink of an eye, another ten years passed.
<Your Void Manipulation mastery has reached a new level>
Satisfied by the results, Yuan decided to stop his training for now.
"Are you done?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked him when she noticed that he didn't immediately return to the void.
He nodded, "Yes, I'll stop here for now."
"Then here is my blood."
Supreme Ruler Dena produced a fist-sized crimson orb of her own blood and offered it to him.
Yuan accepted the crimson orb and inspected it out of curiosity. However, it appeared to be ordinary blood.
He didn't really think much of it and consumed it.
<You have consumed Supreme Ruler Dena's blood>
"Anything?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked him.
Yuan shook his head, "No."
"In that case..."
Without delay, Supreme Ruler Dena retrieved something else, as if she'd had prepared it in advance.
"I made this in case my regular blood had no effect," she said, handing him a crimson crystal shaped like a teardrop, about the size of a peanut.
"What is this?" Yuan asked.
Even at a glance, he could sense the immense energy sealed within it. In fact, it resembled the crystals embedded in every Lower Demon's body—their cores.
"I just copied what you did with the True Emperor of the Seas, as well as what the Primal Sovereign of the Seas gave you," she said calmly.
"I couldn't replicate it exactly, so I improvised and adjusted it."
"You what?!" Yuan exclaimed and stared at her with wide eyes, looking absolutely bewildered.
Supreme Ruler Dena had essentially claimed to have created her own Blood Essence, something only beasts were supposed to be capable of.
"In order for beasts to form their Blood Essence, they have to sacrifice a tremendous amount of energy and even some of their lifespan," Yuan said. "Just how much did you give up to make this?"

Supreme Ruler Dena gave a casual shrug. "I'm not sure how much longevity I sacrificed, but I used about half of my power. I'm essentially back to the state I was in when we first left the Deprived Crimson Valley."

Yuan nearly facepalmed, exasperated by her usual tendency to act without much thought, a habit she picked up after being invincible for so long. In her head, the word consequence was almost nonexistent.
"We're about to confront the Supreme Ruler, and you use up all of your powers to create this when there is no guarantee it will benefit me?" Yuan sighed.
"Don't worry about me. I'm sure it'll work out somehow," she replied.
"Forget it." Yuan shook his head.
Meanwhile, both Lev and Purple stared at the crimson crystal in Yuan's grasp with dazed expressions, as though their minds had been thrown into utter disarray.
Suddenly, Lev's body jolted as if struck by lightning. In the next instant, he lunged toward Yuan, arm outstretched and fingers curled into a claw, attempting to snatch the crystal from his grasp.
"The heck?" Although he was surprised by Lev's sudden action, Yuan reacted instantly and subconsciously used Void Manipulation, teleporting behind Lev like a ghost.
Then, with his free hand, grabbed Lev in the back of his neck, restricting him.
"What are you doing?" he questioned as Lev struggled to break free.
"Have you finally lost your mind and become a Forsaken?" Yuan frowned at his crazed behavior that resembled a Forsaken.
However, Yuan doubted Lev had actually turned into a Forsaken, as it seemed too sudden, and he looked more like a mindless beast acting on pure instinct.
While Yuan contemplated this phenomenon, Purple suddenly sprang into action, lunging at him in the same fashion.
Seeing this, Supreme Ruler Dena extended her crimson hair, swiftly binding Purple's limbs and restraining her in an awkward position with her arms and legs secured behind her back.
Afterward, she turned to Yuan and asked, "What's wrong with them?" "I was going to ask you the same thing," he said while shaking his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 2414 Supreme Ruler Dena's Refined Life Essence
paragraphs: "While I don't know what happened to them, it looks like they're aiming for your blood," Yuan said when he noticed that both Lev and Purple were staring daggers at the crimson crystal in his grasp, looking like predators instinctively watching its prey.
"Can demon blood make other demons go crazy?" he then asked.
"Not literally," she shook her head.
"Perhaps it's because of what you've done to it. Anyway, let's try this..."
Yuan put the crimson crystal into his spatial ring and waited to see the results.
Lev and Purple immediately calmed down, but it took several minutes before they fully returned to their normal self.
"W-What the hell is this?!" Purple exclaimed in shock when she woke up and saw that she was being restrained by Supreme Ruler Dena.
"Kill me if you want because I won't beg for my life! The Supreme Ruler will definitely avenge me!" she shouted while trying to act tough, but her terrified expression betrayed her.
"Uh... why am I suddenly being choked like this?" Lev asked in a puzzled tone.
Yuan raised an eyebrow and asked them, "You don't remember what just happened? That both of you tried to steal Dena's blood from me?"
"What?! I definitely have no recollection of doing anything like that!" Lev immediately replied, sounding genuinely shocked by Yuan's accusation.
"I remember watching you drink her blood, and the next thing I know, I was being choked by you!"
"The same with me..." Purple muttered.
"I thought you had turned Forsaken for a second and was prepared to kill you, you know?" Yuan lied with a straight face, messing with them.
However, neither of them commented on it, as it was only normal—even the right thing to do when one turns Forsaken.
"Anyway, the two of you should distance yourselves from me for the time being since I will be consuming that blood soon," Yuan said a moment later.
They silently nodded and flew far away, until they were tens of thousands of miles away from Yuan.
Once they were gone, Yuan retrieved the crimson crystal again and quickly consumed it.
<You have consumed Supreme Ruler Dena's Refined Life Essence>
'Refined Life Essence...?'
Yuan wondered how it differed from Blood Essence, but before he could dwell on the thought, a sudden sensation washed over him, forcing him to clear his mind and focus on it instead.

A sharp, searing pain erupted in his chest, as though a blade were being driven into his heart again and again. With each passing second, the agony only intensified, and the pain focused in a single point, magnifying the torment severalfold.
Supreme Ruler Dena noticed the agony contorting Yuan's face and swallowed nervously. If he were to die from consuming her blood... she had no idea how she would respond.
"AH!" Yuan suddenly released a deafening roar, his voice erupting with such force that the very earth beneath him and the sky above split apart.
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has activated>
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has begun to refine Supreme Ruler Dena's Refined Life Essence>
A few moments later, Supreme Ruler Dena's brows furrowed. Without warning, she grabbed Yuan by his clothes and pulled them open, exposing his upper body.
Then, her eyes narrowed as her gaze fixed on the center of his chest.
A thin slit had appeared there, slowly spreading open, as though something beneath his skin was forcing its way out, tearing him apart from within.
Soon, Supreme Ruler Dena saw a crystal-like object emerge from the hole. It appeared colorless at first, but when sunlight touched it, the crystal gleamed with majestic prismatic colors.
"This... is a core...?" Supreme Ruler Dena muttered at its resemblance to a demon's core.

However, Yuan's transformation did not end there. His skin turned ghostly pale, as though his blood had been drained, and his hair became silver. His once-brown eyes now gleamed like the crimson crystals he'd consumed. But most surprisingly of all, two black, symmetrical horns emerged from the top of his head.

Supreme Ruler Dena's jaw dropped at Yuan's transformation, and despite her shock, she did not fail to notice the strange, unfamiliar emotion stirring within her.

The Yuan right now radiated an unfathomably dreadful aura so potent that even Lev and Purple felt it from afar, as though they were sensing a being of unimaginable viciousness.

Yuan lowered his head, staring in disbelief at the star-shaped crystal embedded in the center of his chest.

One might expect Yuan to loathe this transformation, given his former hatred for demons, yet to his surprise he felt no disgust at all. If anything, what he felt most was the immense energy surging within him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2415 City of Blood
paragraphs: Yuan looked at Supreme Ruler Dena, who was still gawking at him with a dazed look on her face.
"Looks like I can turn into a demon now," he remarked with a smile on his face, which only made her flustered even more.
"C-Can you return to your original form?" she asked in a nervous voice. "Or are you stuck like that permanently?"
Yuan deactivated his Demonic Awakening and said, "It is not permanent. It's similar to my Dragon Awakening."
"Oh..." she mumbled, sounding a little disappointed.

"Then how long can you maintain that form for?" Yuan pondered for a bit before responding, "It's not too tiring, so I can probably maintain it for as long as I want as long as I don't use all of my energy in one go."
"By the way, what's with that look on your face? I have never seen such an expression from you before," he suddenly addressed the elephant in the room.
"I-I have no idea what you're talking about!" Supreme Ruler Dena hastily responded in a flustered manner, and her hair started moving by itself to cover her face.
"..." Yuan raised an eyebrow at her unusual reaction.
Although Supreme Ruler Dena was acting like a lovestruck maiden, it never occurred to Yuan that was actually the case, as in his mind, she was incapable of feeling such emotions.
Suddenly, Lev and Purple returned to them, breaking the awkward atmosphere.
"What was that just now?! Who did that terrifying presence belong to?!" Lev asked nervously.
Had Yuan not already deactivated his Demonic Awakening, Lev wouldn't have even dared to return.
"You mean this presence?" Yuan abruptly activated Demonic Awakening again.
"My god! That was you?!" Lev cried out loud, his eyes widening with disbelief.
Supreme Ruler Dena's hair subtly moved just enough for her to peek at Yuan's violent appearance.
As for Purple, she was left utterly speechless. And despite her naturally purple complexion, a faint flush of red crept across her face.
'What the hell happened to him in such a short time?!' she cried inwardly, unable to trust her own eyes, and even more shocking, the fact that she found herself drawn to him.
Yuan deactivated his transformation a moment later, and an audible 'aw...' could be heard coming from Supreme Ruler Dena.
"Alright, let's continue heading to the City of Blood," Yuan said.
He activated Void Manipulation, and they instantly traversed over a hundred thousand miles.
"How long do you think it'll take us to reach the City of Blood at this pace?" Yuan asked Purple a few minutes into their journey.
"Uhhh... a few years?" she said, sounding uncertain.
Meanwhile, at the City of Blood, the Demon God's Formation had recently been completed. However, the Supreme Ruler was nowhere to be seen.
"Supreme Adviser! Have you seen or spoken to the Supreme Ruler lately? All preparations are completed!"
"No, the Supreme Ruler hasn't returned since he left to communicate with the Demon God," the Supreme Adviser shook his head.
"We have received information from our scouts that they could sense 'their' presence quickly approaching our city!"
"It would be great if the Supreme Ruler returns before they arrive, but if he doesn't, we'll have to face her on our own and hopefully stall her for long enough for his return."
Despite the urgent situation, none of them even considered disturbing the Supreme Ruler, as nothing took priority over the Demon God, even if the entire city were to be burnt down.
Two years later, Yuan stopped using Void Manipulation.
"We have arrived at the City of Blood," he said aloud as they hovered a few hundred miles away, just enough to see the city on the horizon.
"Why did we stop here?" Purple asked, trying her best not to sound off or nervous.
Yuan didn't respond and merely stared at the city in silence.
"As I thought, they've prepared an ambush for us," he said out loud without a care if Purple could hear him or not.
"?!" Purple's eyes widened.
Yuan turned to look at her and smiled, "They could've made it less obvious by not evacuating the entire city. That being said, the formation surrounding the city is just as obvious.
"What do you want to do, Dena?" Yuan turned to ask her.
"Are you afraid?" she suddenly asked.
"Why would I be?"
"Then there's no reason not to go, even if it's a trap."
Yuan nodded with a smile, "Oh, Lev, you should probably—"
"Stay here, right? No problem." Lev immediately said without hesitation. Purple looked at him with a weird gaze.
'Is he really just a nobody?' she wondered inwardly.
"You are coming with us, right?" Yuan suddenly asked Purple, snapping her out of her thoughts.
"Of course!"
Moments later, Yuan and Supreme Ruler Dena approached the City of Blood while Purple followed them from behind, keeping a certain distance from them.
"How does it feel to finally return home after spending so long in the Deprived Crimson Valley?" Yuan asked Supreme Ruler Dena.
"I was basically asleep during my entire duration there until you woke me up, so it doesn't feel that long. However, this place definitely feels foreign," she said.
"Perhaps it's the lack of presence, or maybe it's how much the place has changed, but it really feels different."
"Well, considering how long you've been gone, it's normal."
Soon, they arrived at the city walls, and almost instantly, Yuan felt thousands of gazes fall upon them.
"Seriously... could they be any more obvious?" he muttered, slightly dumbfounded by their apparent lack of stealth.

However, unbeknownst to him, these individuals were in fact concealing their presence. It was simply that Yuan's Soul Strength had grown so formidable that he perceived them as clearly as if they weren't hiding at all.
Eventually, they arrived at the heart of the city, where a colossal tower soared into the heavens, its peak seemingly piercing the sky itself.
"Where's the Supreme Ruler? Why isn't he showing up?" Yuan turned to ask Purple.

chapters.title: Chapter 2416 Demon God’s Formation
paragraphs: "Uh... I'm not sure...?" Purple responded to Yuan's question about the Supreme Ruler's whereabouts.
Suddenly, Yuan noticed a figure emerging from the tower and quickly approaching them.
"Are you the Supreme Ruler?" Yuan asked the human-looking demon hovering before them.
"Not even close," he responded. "I am the Supreme Adviser, second in power within the Crimson Continent."
"Then where is the Supreme Ruler?" Yuan asked.

"The Supreme Ruler will appear soon, but first..." The Supreme Adviser turned his gaze to Supreme Ruler Dena and continued speaking, "Why did you leave the Deprived Crimson Valley and return here? Have you forgotten about the indescribable crime you've committed against the people here? If I were you, I'd be too ashamed to show my face here again."
"There is no place besides the Deprived Crimson Valley that welcomes a Forsaken, especially one as heinous as you!"
Despite the Supreme Adviser's harsh words, Supreme Ruler Dena's expression remained as calm as a still pond.
"How does one forget something they have no recollection of in the very beginning?" she spoke a moment later.
"What...?" The Supreme Adviser frowned.
"As for me being a Forsaken... I have no clue where you got such information, but that's nothing more than slander," she continued before the Supreme Adviser could say anything else.

"Are you claiming to be innocent despite the overwhelming evidence against you? Do you really expect me—expect anyone to believe that?" The Supreme Adviser responded with a deep frown, looking like he'd been mocked.
"Whether you believe me or not is none of my concern," Supreme Ruler Dena calmly said. "I am just here to reclaim my position."

"Reclaim your position?! And how are you going to do that? With force, like you usually do?!" The Supreme Adviser shouted, his face and voice full of anger. "Even if you force your way back into being the Supreme Ruler again, nobody would trust you!"
"I couldn't care less if nobody trusts me. Even if everyone hates me, as long as they do their job properly—"
"Alright, let's stop there." Yuan interrupted her.

He then turned to the Supreme Adviser. "You claim there's overwhelming evidence she's responsible for this city's disappearance, but from what I've heard, your so‐called proof is flimsy at best and proves nothing."
The Supreme Adviser frowned at Yuan in confusion.
"I should have asked this sooner, but who in the hell are you? Are you the one responsible for the deaths of our two soldiers?" he asked after a brief silence.
"You make it sound like I personally killed them," Yuan sighed while shaking his head. "They were the ones who invoked Demon God's Wrath."
"That's not what I heard from those who were present."
"I don't know what those idiots told you, but they definitely lied."
"Lie? To me? There's no way."
"You're a bit too trusting—borderline gullible. No wonder you were so quick to believe those false accusations against Dena," Yuan said.

'He can really utter her name without triggering Demon God's Wrath!' The Supreme Adviser cried inwardly after confirming the information the others had given him, as he refused to believe such outrageous claims.
"You... Why can you utter her name without triggering Demon God's Wrath? Why are you able to ignore the laws of this world, something even I cannot do?"
"Isn't it obvious?" Yuan remarked with a smile. "It's because you're not me."

The Supreme Adviser trembled at Yuan's humorless joke and shouted, "Regardless of who you are, your very existence defies the laws of this world and the Supreme Ruler who made it! This is not acceptable!"
"And what are you going to do about it? Kill me?"
"Don't worry, we will deal with you later. As for now..." The Supreme Adviser's gaze returned to Supreme Ruler Dena before narrowing slightly.
After a brief silence, he shouted, "We will not allow you to terrorize our people a second time! Activate the Demon God's Formation!"
At his command, the people overseeing the formation sprang into action. A crimson barrier instantly rose to envelop the entire city, turning it into a prison.
On closer inspection, the barrier was actually woven from countless crimson swords, each radiating the might of a True God.
"Demon God's Formation, huh?" Supreme Ruler Dena muttered, gazing at the barrier with a calm expression.

Though she'd never deployed it herself, it was something she knew well. After all, the Demon God's Formation was the most powerful formation available and their final line of defense—their trump card, and its power was overwhelming enough to threaten even a Supreme Ruler.
Even at her full strength, she wouldn't escape the Demon God's Formation unscathed, much less her current weakened state.
Yet, despite the seemingly dire situation, Supreme Ruler Dena kept calm and showed no sign of panic, nor was she putting on a brave face. She was genuinely unconcerned.
As for Yuan, he was actually admiring the formation, as it was unfathomably powerful and far beyond even the strongest formations within the Nine Heavens.
"This is your last chance to return to the Deprived Crimson Valley," the Supreme Adviser warned as he lifted his arm, pointing it toward the crimson sky.
"I refuse," Supreme Ruler Dena replied without hesitation.
"Then die."

The Supreme Adviser swung his arm in a downward motion, as if trying to split the space before him, and in the next instant, the countless crimson swords forming the barrier locked onto Supreme Ruler Dena and shot toward her.
The scene resembled Yuan's Swords of Eternal Torment, but on a massive scale.
In response, Supreme Ruler Dena sprang into action, meeting the storm of blades head‐on with her crimson hair.
Clang! Clang! Clang!

Although Supreme Ruler Dena managed to destroy the swords for a time and seemed to be holding her own, her weakened state gradually began to show. Her movements slowed, and she started failing to block some of the blades.
The blades she failed to block impaled her body and started draining even more of her strength.

Soon, Supreme Ruler Dena had grown so weak that she could no longer control her hair. However, the Demon God's formation remained active and continued its relentless assault until her body was riddled with countless strikes, leaving her looking like a porcupine bristling with quills.

chapters.title: Chapter 2417 The Appearance of an Absolute God
paragraphs: "Hahaha! The Demon God's Formation is much stronger than I anticipated! To think it would subdue the strongest Supreme Ruler in history with such ease!" The Supreme Adviser laughed out loud with a delighted expression on his face, misunderstanding the situation.
Since Purple never had the chance to tell him about Supreme Ruler Dena being in a weakened state, he thought the Demon God's Formation was powerful enough to overwhelm her with ease.
Meanwhile, Yuan watched the whole thing without moving and with a calm expression on his face.

Perhaps the Supreme Adviser didn't see Yuan as a threat and wanted to focus all of their efforts on Supreme Ruler Dena, but the Demon God's Formation completely ignored him, so not a single sword flew at him.
"To think we worried over nothing! Or maybe her strength was exaggerated. Either way, we handled her without the Supreme Ruler's help!" the Supreme Adviser laughed merrily.
However, Yuan then spoke aloud, "I wouldn't celebrate so early if I were you."
"What?" The Supreme Adviser's laughter died as he narrowed his eyes at Supreme Ruler Dena.
Only then did he notice the swords impaled in her body were moving, slowly being drawn into her flesh.
"The Demon God's Formation... is being devoured?!" he exclaimed in disbelief.

Without hesitation, he reactivated the Demon God's Formation, resuming the assault. Before the swords could reach her, however, a crimson barrier suddenly materialized around Supreme Ruler Dena, enveloping her entire body like an egg.
When the swords struck the barrier, they sank into it without a trace, as though hurled into a bottomless sea.
Yuan watched the scene with a nostalgic smile on his face.
"This is the second time I have seen her in this state..." he mumbled.
"What the hell is going on?! What in god's name is she doing?!" The Supreme Adviser shouted at Yuan in confusion, demanding an explanation.
However, Yuan merely shrugged in silence.
Quickly realizing that Yuan wasn't going to explain the situation, the Supreme Adviser decided to continue attacking her with the Demon God's Formation.
"I refuse to believe that you can remain in that state forever! Whatever technique you're using, I bet it consumes a lot of energy!"

She nodded and explained, "I'm simply so powerful that I hardly need to use any energy to defeat anyone. Because of that, I gain far more energy than I spend. As a result, my 'core' is always full, and the excess builds up in other parts of my body. It's like drawing water from rivers that were created from an overflowing lake."
"The last time I was forced to transform was when I had to confront a certain Demon Sealer," she reminisced with a subtle smile on her face, her gaze briefly glanced at Yuan.
"T-That's ridiculous..." The Supreme Adviser trembled as an overwhelming wave of fear crashed over him.
"Now then..."
Supreme Ruler Dena slowly turned her head from left to right, her crimson gaze sweeping over the surroundings.
"Supreme Blood Arts, Crimson Storm."

In the next instant, a pair of crimson wings unfurled from her back—formed not of feathers, but of countless crimson swords resembling the Demon God's Formation. Then the sword-like feathers shot forth in every direction like a machine gun on steroids, clashing into the Demon God's Formation like an endless rain.

Although the Demon God's Formation could regenerate endlessly as long as it had energy, Supreme Ruler Dena shattered it faster than it could repair itself. In mere moments she completely annihilated the formation, forcing those supplying it with energy to cough up mouthfuls of blood.
"I've destroyed your trump card. Now what?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked calmly as the Supreme Adviser unconsciously backed away.

He caught himself and stopped retreating, then shouted angrily, "So what if you destroyed the Demon God's Formation?! We're far from finished!" His body began to twist and change, shedding its human semblance as he transformed into something far more demonic.

Much like how some Forsakens would transform when enraged, humanoid demons also possessed a demonic form they could assume, which would greatly enhance their prowess at the cost of consuming more energy.
Of course, the Supreme Adviser had no intention of facing Supreme Ruler Dena alone, as that would be no different from stepping into his own grave.
"Plan B!" he shouted.
In the next moment, tens of thousands of demons who'd been lying in ambush surged forth like a tidal wave, surrounding Supreme Ruler Dena on all sides.
These demons were all True Gods who served directly under the current Supreme Ruler, including members of both the Special Execution Squad and the Elite Execution Squad.
But they weren't the only reinforcements. Soon, another presence descended—a lone demon whose aura eclipsed everyone else's.
An Absolute God had appeared.
Yuan focused all of his attention on the Absolute God, wondering if the Supreme Ruler had finally chosen to reveal himself.
"We greet the Supreme Ancestor!" The Supreme Adviser and the demons greeted the Absolute God.
"Supreme Ancestor?" Yuan raised an eyebrow.
"That's the title given to someone who used to be a Supreme Ruler," Supreme Ruler Dena explained. "He's probably the 13th generation Supreme Ruler."

chapters.title: Chapter 2418 Supreme Ancestor
paragraphs: "The Supreme Ancestor showing up before the Supreme Ruler, huh? This feels backwards for some reason," Yuan muttered as he narrowed his gaze at the human-looking Supreme Ancestor.
"So he's the one responsible for annihilating the Demon Sealers..."
Supreme Ruler Dena sensed a hint on killing intent within his voice and asked, "Do you want to take care of him? I'll let you have him."
However, Yuan shook his head and said, "No, it's fine. You can deal with him."
Meanwhile, the Supreme Ancestor moved to the front and approached Supreme Ruler Dena.
"This is your last chance to back down, you fiend," he said to her in a cold voice.
But despite his tough-looking appearance, he was actually screaming inwardly, feeling absolutely terrified of her presence.

Although he had once been the Supreme Ruler, not all Supreme Rulers were created equal. Supreme Ruler Dena was widely acknowledged as the strongest in history for a reason, and she had earned that title without ever revealing her transformation, which was several times more powerful than anything others had witnessed.

If he had the choice, he would have remained in seclusion and avoided making an appearance altogether. Unfortunately, as the Supreme Ancestor, he had a reputation he could not afford to ignore, and his absence would tarnish it.
However, Supreme Ruler Dena ignored him and asked, "I heard you were responsible for killing all of the Demon Sealers. Why did you do such a thing?"
"Isn't it obvious?" the Supreme Ancestor replied. "Demon Sealers wield power that preys on our kind and is a direct insult to the Demon God, our creator."

"I don't see how it insults the Demon God," Supreme Ruler Dena said, shaking her head. "If anything, it's a marvelous power that deserves respect, not scorn. No one's managed to recreate anything like it, even after all this time."
"Why the hell would anyone even try to recreate such a power?" The Supreme Ancestor sneered in disdain.

"Because it's highly effective, and we're essentially powerless against it. Who wouldn't want such overwhelming power that would make them near untouchable? I bet if given the chance, most would jump at the opportunity to learn Demon Sealing Aura. Unfortunately, only very few people can learn it, much less wield it.
A cold smile suddenly appeared on Supreme Ruler Dena's face as she continued, "Are you sure you didn't annihilate them out of jealousy because you weren't able to learn it yourself?"
The Supreme Ancestor trembled at her words and accusation.
"That's a baseless accusation! Nothing but slander!" he shouted in an enraged voice, his face flushed with redness.
"You're pretty terrible at controlling your emotions for someone who used to be a Supreme Ruler. No wonder you couldn't restrain your jealousy and killed them."
The Supreme Ancestor trembled nonstop, fists clenched so tightly that blood dripped from his knuckles. Yet even as rage pushed him to the brink, he didn't dare attack Supreme Ruler Dena.
Supreme Ruler Dena sighed, "I think it's pretty obvious that none of you will be able to defeat me, so let's not waste any time or energy fighting."
After a brief pause, she added, "To be frank, since this is only my second time in this form, I won't be able to control my strength properly, so there will be a lot of casualties if we fight."
Yuan then spoke up, "In fact, we came here to speak with the Supreme Ruler. You were the ones who set up this ambush and attacked us first."
"You..." The Supreme Ancestor finally noticed Yuan and narrowed his eyes, finding his face strangely familiar for some reason. "Who the hell are you?"
"My name's Yuan, and I am just her livestock," Yuan introduced himself as Supreme Ruler Dena's livestock.
"Her... livestock?" The Supreme Ancestor repeated in a dumbfounded voice.

Eventually, he snapped out of his daze and said to Supreme Ruler Dena, "Even if we cannot defeat you and will likely perish by your hands, we will not allow a fiend like you to exist outside the Deprived Crimson Valley!"
He raised his arm, pointing it straight at the sky.
"This is our final warning! Return to the Deprived Crimson Valley and stay there for an eternity, or face our wrath!
"Then... all of you can die." Supreme Ruler Dena calmly responded.
The Supreme Ancestor gritted his teeth and started swinging his arm down, shouting, "Att—"
"Wait."
A calm voice suddenly resounded.
Hearing this voice, the Supreme Ancestor immediately closed his mouth and froze his movements.
"Supreme Ruler!" The Supreme Adviser nearly cried tears of joy after sensing his presence.
The next moment, a male figure descended from the sky, and all of the demons there lowered their heads to bow toward him.

Yuan narrowed his eyes at the newcomer—a tall, muscular demon. Unlike the Supreme Ancestor or the Supreme Adviser, he bore no human resemblance. His skin was a dark gray, his eyes pitch black, and six black horns sat on his head like a jagged, demonic crown.
"All of you stand down and leave. There is no need for pointless deaths, and I alone will be more than enough to deal with her," said the Supreme Ruler in a cold tone.
Heeding his commands, all of the demons, except the Supreme Ancestor and the Supreme Adviser, left the scene.
"This is our first time meeting, Ninth. I am the 14th Supreme Ruler, Grant."
Supreme Ruler Grant narrowed his gaze at her and continued, "I understand why you were called the strongest Supreme Ruler in history. With such an overwhelming aura, you truly deserve such a title."
Despite Supreme Ruler Dena's aura clearly surpassing his own, Supreme Ruler Grant did not show any hint of worry on his face.
When the Supreme Adviser noticed this, he wondered if Supreme Ruler Grant had successfully contacted the Demon God and received some kind of guidance.
"If you're going to tell me to return to the Deprived Crimson Valley, then you can save your breath," Supreme Ruler Dena then said.

chapters.title: Chapter 2419 The Demon God's Power
paragraphs: "Return to the Deprived Crimson Valley...?" Supreme Ruler Grant gave a weak chuckle, almost as if he found it amusing.
Then, he said in a cold voice, "The only reason you were banished to the Deprived Crimson Valley was simply because nobody could kill you."
Supreme Ruler Dena narrowed her gaze at his ominous words and asked, "Are you implying that someone is capable of killing me now? Who might that individual be? You?"
"There's no need for implications because I am outright saying that I can kill you, so there's no need for you to return to the Deprived Crimson Valley."
"Bold words for someone who is only somewhat stronger than the Supreme Ancestor," she sneered. "Where is your confidence coming from?"
A smile slowly appeared on Supreme Ruler Grant's face as he responded, "Before I answer that question, let me ask you how many times you have spoken with the Demon God?"

"The Demon God?" Supreme Ruler Dena frowned, wondering if his confidence had something to do with it. "I have only ever heard his voice, so I can't say that I have spoken with the Demon God before. Are you claiming that you have?"
"Not only have I spoken with the Demon God, but he even appeared before me!"
"What?!"
Not just Supreme Ruler Dena, but even the Supreme Ancestor and Supreme Advisor exclaimed in shock at his claims.
The Demon God has never appeared before them before, so this was an unprecedented event!
"W-What did the Demon God look like?" The Supreme Ancestor asked.
"I didn't dare to look at him, so I cannot say," he said while shaking his head.
"You didn't see him, yet you claimed he appeared before you?" Supreme Ruler Dena wore a suspicious expression on her face.
"Just because I didn't look at him doesn't mean I couldn't sense his presence right before me!"
"Then what did you talk about?"
"Honestly, not much—if anything at all. However, he did grant me... something."
Supreme Ruler Grant slowly raised his right arm, and a profound, otherworldly energy began to surge from his clenched fist.
"Behold! This is the power the Demon God bestowed upon me!"
"That's..." Supreme Ruler Dena narrowed her eyes at the familiar energy.
Then, she looked at Yuan to see his reaction.
"Eternal Essence...? No, it's similar but fundamentally different. It's also similar to what Dena replicated but much more refined." Yuan mumbled to himself as he analyzed the energy.
It was not real Eternal Essence, and compared to Supreme Ruler Dena's replication, it was much more complete and powerful.
"It's similar, but it's not the same," Yuan said to Supreme Ruler Dena a moment later.
Supreme Ruler Dena then said to Supreme Ruler Grant, "That's some fancy new power you acquired from the Demon God, but that doesn't automatically mean you'll be able to kill me."
"Why don't we put that to the test?!"
Supreme Ruler Grant suddenly sprang into action, unleashing his new power against her.

"Hmph." Supreme Ruler Dena sneered coldly and counterattacked, meeting his strike with her own might. Unfortunately, she couldn't use her replicated Eternal Essence like the curse did while controlling her body, so she could only respond with the strength of an Absolute God.
When their energies clashed, Supreme Ruler Dena's attack managed to last a full second against Supreme Ruler Grant's fake Eternal Essence before falling apart.
Seeing this, Supreme Ruler Dena, who wasn't using her full strength, unleashed even more power.
During their next clash, Supreme Ruler Dena was able to cancel out Supreme Ruler Grant's fake Eternal Essence, greatly surprising him.

"So it won't be easy to kill you even with the Demon God's powers, huh? As I thought. You truly deserve to be called a monster!" Supreme Ruler Grant, who was also using only a portion of his newfound power, started to increase his output.
Meanwhile, the Supreme Adviser and the Supreme Ancestor turned their attention toward Yuan, who had been a spectator this entire time.
"What are you looking at? Don't tell me you want to fight me," Yuan noticed their gazes and turned to speak to them.
"You've been irritating me for some time now, you little bastard..." the Supreme Ancestor growled, clenching his fists.
"I have? I don't recall doing anything to bother you," Yuan remarked with a raised eyebrow.
However, it wasn't Yuan's words that provoked him. Rather, it was that oddly familiar face that made his skin crawl for some reason.
"I still haven't forgotten about the two subordinates of mine that you've killed," said the Supreme Adviser.
"How many times do I have to say they perished because of their own actions before it gets through that thick skull of yours?" Yuan sighed, shaking his head.
"You're extremely arrogant for a mere first-level False God. Without that fiend protecting you, I'm surprised that you still dare to open your mouth," the Supreme Ancestor sneered with disdain.
"I may be a first-level False God, but that's more than enough to deal with an ant like you," Yuan said with a calm smile.
"What?" The Supreme Ancestor frowned.
Without another word, he pointed a finger at Yuan and muttered, "Blood Manipulation."
A concentrated jet of blood burst from his fingertip, lancing toward Yuan like a high‐pressure water stream.
An overwhelming aura abruptly exploded from Yuan's body as he activated Demonic Awakening, his dreadful presence instantly engulfing the entire area.
<Blood Manipulation>
Just as the Supreme Ancestor's blood beam was about to pierce Yuan's brow, it abruptly split into two streams and moved around his head, missing completely.
"What?!" the Supreme Ancestor cried out when he saw Yuan's transformation.
He had met countless demons in his lifetime, but never one with an appearance like Yuan's, not to mention his dreadful presence that surpassed even Supreme Ruler Dena.
"W-Who the hell are you?!" The Supreme Adviser asked.
"I'm just livestock," Yuan calmly said.

He then turned to stare at the Supreme Ancestor and said, "I wasn't going to do anything to you, but since you went out of your way to attack me first, I might as well avenge the Demon Sealers you murdered out of jealousy."

"How many times do I have to say they perished because of their own actions before it gets through that thick skull of yours?" Yuan sighed, shaking his head.
"You're extremely arrogant for a mere first-level False God.
Without that fiend protecting you, I'm surprised that you still dare to open your mouth," the Supreme Ancestor sneered with disdain.
"I may be a first-level False God, but that's more than enough to deal with an ant like you," Yuan said with a calm smile.
"What?" The Supreme Ancestor frowned.
Without another word, he pointed a finger at Yuan and muttered, "Blood Manipulation."
A concentrated jet of blood burst from his fingertip, lancing toward Yuan like a high‐pressure water stream.
An overwhelming aura abruptly exploded from Yuan's body as he activated Demonic Awakening, his dreadful presence instantly engulfing the entire area.
<Blood Manipulation>
Just as the Supreme Ancestor's blood beam was about to pierce Yuan's brow, it abruptly split into two streams and moved around his head, missing completely.
"What?!" the Supreme Ancestor cried out when he saw Yuan's transformation.
He had met countless demons in his lifetime, but never one with an appearance like Yuan's, not to mention his dreadful presence that surpassed even Supreme Ruler Dena.
"W-Who the hell are you?!" The Supreme Adviser asked.
"I'm just livestock," Yuan calmly said.

He then turned to stare at the Supreme Ancestor and said, "I wasn't going to do anything to you, but since you went out of your way to attack me first, I might as well avenge the Demon Sealers you murdered out of jealousy."

chapters.title: Chapter 2420 Fighting an Absolute God
paragraphs: Despite saying he wanted to avenge the Demon Sealers killed by the Supreme Ancestor, in truth, it was just an excuse for Yuan to test out his new demon form.
"Arrogant bastard, let's see if you'll still dare to talk once I beat the shit out of you!" The Supreme Ancestor roared as he lunged at Yuan.
"Blood Manipulation!" The Supreme Ancestor summoned a long spear with his own blood.
<Blood Manipulation>
A crimson sword formed of blood appeared in Yuan's grasp.

Since he wanted to test the limits of his new transformation, as well as his new ability 'Blood Manipulation', Yuan decided to fight the Supreme Ancestor without using any Demon Sealing Aura. "Hahaha! How foolish of you to challenge me, who used to be a Supreme Ruler, with Blood Manipulation!" The Supreme Ancestor laughed as he thrust his crimson spear straight at Yuan's face.
"Foolish?" Yuan murmured, swinging his crimson sword to meet the strike.
Sha!
In the next instant, Yuan's blade sheared the spear cleanly in two.
"Haha—hah?!" The Supreme Ancestor almost choked on his own laughter as he stared at his destroyed weapon in disbelief.
"What?! His Blood Manipulation is even stronger than the Supreme Ancestor's?! How is that possible?!" The Supreme Adviser's eyes nearly bulged from their sockets.

In the Demonic Realm, Blood Manipulation was the most basic and widespread technique, turning one's own blood into power. It was akin to cultivators using Qi Manipulation, but instead of controlling the spiritual energy in the air, they would control the blood in their body, which is made possible only because of their regeneration.
However, its power depended heavily on the strength of one's bloodline, and those with the stronger lineage naturally wielded the stronger art.

As a former Supreme Ruler, the Supreme Ancestor naturally possessed one of the strongest bloodlines in the world, and every Supreme Ruler's bloodline was further strengthened during their succession ritual. For that very reason, he was utterly stunned to see a nobody overpower him in Blood Manipulation.

"I... I refuse to believe that his Blood Manipulation is stronger than mine! It must have been a fluke!" The Supreme Ancestor immediately summoned another spear, one that looked different. Its color was a darker crimson, and its surface was glossy and hardened like forged steel.
Clang!

When they clashed again a moment later, neither weapon shattered. To onlookers it may seem like a draw, but the Supreme Ancestor knew he had lost. Even after refining his Blood Manipulation with another technique, he still couldn't overpower Yuan's ordinary Blood Manipulation.
Unbeknownst to the Supreme Ancestor, this was Yuan's first time using Blood Manipulation, so he was essentially fighting a complete novice.
"That's a neat trick. Let me see if I can do it..." Yuan said.
In the next instant, his crimson sword turned glossy and far more refined.
"You—!"
Before the Supreme Ancestor could finish speaking, Yuan's blade sliced clean through his spear and then through his body, severing his head from his neck.
The Supreme Ancestor quickly distanced himself from Yuan as his body regenerated.
"So you can strengthen your Blood Manipulation with Celestial Qi in such a manner, huh? Thanks for the guidance," Yuan remarked with a smile afterward.

The Supreme Ancestor went silent for a heartbeat, then began to tremble with rage. Then, an overwhelming aura erupted from his body, surging with a force reminiscent of Celestial Qi yet clearly far superior.
"This is the power of an Absolute God, huh?" A faint, excited smile tugged at Yuan's lips.

After fighting and killing many True Gods—and even clashing with Eternals—Yuan had a solid grasp of an Absolute God's capabilities. He estimated the Supreme Ancestor's strength at roughly thirty percent of Saaruk's true power, far from enough to contend with an Eternal, but more than sufficient to annihilate anything below them.

'I couldn't even contend with Saaruk at twenty percent of his power back then, even while using Eternal Essence. Let's see how well I fare against thirty percent now... without Eternal Essence or Demon Sealing Aura,' Yuan thought as he braced for the Supreme Ancestor's attack.
However, the Supreme Ancestor didn't attack immediately. Instead, he used Blood Manipulation to encase himself in crimson armor from head to toe, taking on the appearance of a blood‐red knight.

"I went easy on you because of your cultivation, but it seems I have severely underestimated you, so I will be fighting you with my full strength now." The Supreme Ancestor declared as he pointed his spear at Yuan.
"I'm so scared." Yuan remarked in a sarcastic voice.
"DIE!"
Without warning, the Supreme Ancestor used Void Manipulation to initiate his attack.
Fortunately, Yuan had trained his Void Manipulation before arriving at the City of Blood, or else he wouldn't have been able to keep up with the Supreme Ancestor's movements.
Clang!
Yuan managed to block the Supreme Ancestor's strike from the void, but his sword shattered after the exchange.

Without flinching, he simply formed another blade with Blood Manipulation. That, too, would break during their next clash, but with each repetition his proficiency grew, and every new sword emerged stronger than the last.

However, after hundreds of exchanges and swords later, Yuan realized that his Blood Manipulation refined with Celestial Qi was nowhere near competing with the power of an Absolute God, so he tried something else.
<Absolute Dragon Awakening!>

For the first time, Yuan activated two awakenings at once. His aura vanished for a heartbeat, then surged back several times stronger. The prismatic crystal in his chest flared with golden light, his right eye turned gold, and glistening scales spread across his body, forming a radiant golden armor.

"What the hell did he just do?!" The Supreme Ancestor froze mid‐attack, staring at Yuan in bewilderment. His aura now carried a distinctly beastly ferocity, as though he'd transformed into a beast himself.
Yuan examined his body with delight and satisfaction. 'This worked out better than I thought it would... No, I wasn't even sure if this would work,' he smiled inwardly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2421 Fighting the Supreme Ancestor
paragraphs: "You! What the hell are you really?!" The Supreme Ancestor shouted at Yuan after seeing the drastic change in his aura.
"I'm... human," Yuan calmly replied.
"Wha—"
The Supreme Ancestor's eyes widened with disbelief, but before he could even process what he heard, Yuan attacked him.
"Did you just say you're a human?!" The Supreme Ancestor questioned, asking for confirmation. "How is that even possible with the gateway to the Divine Heaven sealed? You must be pulling my leg!"
He refused to believe Yuan's claim. After all, Yuan had been messing with him nonstop.
When they clashed again, Yuan's sword no longer shattered after a single exchange, and it endured ten to twelve blows before breaking.
The Supreme Ancestor's spear, meanwhile, remained intact. However, cracks had begun to appear across its surface.
'His prowess increased by this much?! This is my first time seeing someone with two stages of transformation!' The Supreme Ancestor cried inwardly after the clash.
Meanwhile, Yuan was wondering if he could combine three forms into one.
'If I can use two different awakenings at once, what's stopping me from using three—even four at once?'
Without hesitation, Yuan proceeded to test his limitations.
<True Phoenix Awakening!>
Suddenly, a pair of prismatic, flame-wreathed wings burst from Yuan's back, while his horns were engulfed in the same dazzling, multicolored fire.
"This feels... incredible!" Yuan laughed, each breath spilling out flickers of flame.
"This... damn monster..." The Supreme Ancestor swallowed nervously, struggling to comprehend the unprecedented existence standing before him.
Although Yuan's aura was undeniably terrifying, that alone wasn't what unsettled the Supreme Ancestor.
It was the sheer absurdity of Yuan's existence—like facing a being that could evolve without limit—that filled him with a deep, instinctive unease.
'Why don't I use my Heavenly White Tiger Transformation while I am at it?!

The mere thought of wielding four forms at once sent a thrill through Yuan, his body trembling with excitement. Yet, the moment he tried, he felt an invisible barrier halt him, preventing him from taking that final step.
'Is three forms my limit now? I guess I'll try again later...' Yuan sighed inwardly.
Though he wasn't certain what conditions he needed to meet to activate more transformations simultaneously, Yuan had a strong feeling that such a feat was not only possible, but it was inevitable.
Yuan turned to look at the Supreme Ancestor, who was waiting to see if he was going to transform any more, and said, "Sorry for the wait."
Yuan activated Blood Manipulation, but this time, it emerged a little different.
A radiant golden aura shimmered around its blade, while silver flames coiled along its length, giving it an otherworldly presence.
"Is that all you've got?! Any tricks left?!" the Supreme Ancestor roared as he clashed with Yuan once more.
The moment their weapons met, a surge of flames erupted from Yuan's blade, instantly engulfing him.
"Damn it! What kind of fire is this?! It won't go out no matter what I do to them!"
To rid himself of the flames, the Supreme Ancestor was forced to tear away his own burning flesh again and again, as he was unable to act quickly enough before the fire spread.
Unwilling to endure such torment in close combat, he immediately shifted tactics, retreating into long-range attacks and unleashing a barrage of bloody techniques from afar.
"Supreme Blood Arts, Endless Crimson Barrage!"
The Supreme Ancestor summoned millions of spear-like projectiles and threw them all in Yuan's direction simultaneously.
<Blood Manipulation>
To generate blood at a sufficient rate, Yuan drove his hand straight into his own chest, punching a hole into it without hesitation.
From the wound, he drew out his blood in a grotesque yet controlled manner, harvesting it directly from his own body.
Then, using that blood, he erected a crimson barrier around himself, shielding his body from the relentless barrage, each projectile carrying enough power to slay a Cultivation God.
However, midway through the assault, Yuan's eyes flickered with a sudden resolve. Without warning, he dismissed the barrier, allowing the Supreme Ancestor's attacks to strike him head-on.
This greatly puzzled the Supreme Ancestor, but he had no issues with Yuan willingly stepping into his own grave.
The projectiles tore into him without mercy, riddling his body with countless holes, destroying his flesh faster than it could regenerate.
However, even when his entire body was reduced to nothing, with every cell annihilated, Yuan did not die.
In the very next instant, he regenerated, his body restored in perfect condition as though he had never been harmed at all.
"What in Demon God's name? How did he survive even after his heart was completely annihilated?!" the Supreme Ancestor exclaimed, disbelief etched across his face.
By 'heart,' he was referring to the crystal embedded within Yuan's chest—the very core that served as a demon's greatest weakness.
While some powerful demons like the Supreme Ancestor could survive having their heart shattered into many pieces, not even he would survive having his heart completely annihilated.
"I told you why already. It's because I am human!"
"Can it really be...? Is he really a human from the Divine Heavens?" The Supreme Ancestor wondered to himself aloud.
Yuan suddenly turned his head, his gaze snapping toward a distant direction where another battle raged.
He had been so focused on his clash with the Supreme Ancestor that he had all but forgotten about the confrontation between Supreme Ruler Grant and Supreme Ruler Dena.
"I expected it to be intense... but to erase half the city this quickly..."

While his own battle with the Supreme Ancestor had already devastated the surroundings and reshaped the terrain, it was nothing compared to the destruction caused by the two Supreme Rulers, where entire sections of the city, along with the very ground beneath them, had been utterly vaporized.
Yuan shifted his gaze back to the Supreme Ancestor, a faint smile tugging at his lips.
"Let's not let them steal all the spotlight," he said calmly. "Shall we go all out, too?"
