chapters.title: Chapter 2422 Divine Paragon Unleashed
paragraphs: "Go out all...? So you're claiming that you're still hiding some strength?" The Supreme Ancestor narrowed his eyes at Yuan, his gaze filled with anger.

Without another word, Yuan unleashed his Chaotic Essence, and his already terrifying aura twisted into something utterly incomprehensible, as though the Demon God himself had descended upon the world.
Due to his Demonic Awakening, which increased his Chaotic Essence when in his demon form, his already powerful Chaotic Essence only became even more powerful.
"Ready or not, here I come!" Yuan shouted as he charged at the Supreme Ancestor, who continued trying to keep his distance from Yuan because of his flames.
Although the flames caused him no physical pain, they still melted his body and hindered his movements. However, their most troublesome trait was their ability to burn away his energy.
In an attempt to keep Yuan away, the Supreme Ancestor used Void Manipulation and attacked at the same time.
Unfortunately for him, Yuan could also use Void Manipulation at a similar level, and none of his attacks were effective against Yuan, who could easily recover from any damage he received.
For the first time, the Supreme Ancestor experienced what it was like for humans to face demons in their earliest encounters—battling an incomprehensible existence that simply refused to die.

It wasn't that Yuan had surpassed the Supreme Ancestor in strength, either. Even with his Chaotic Essence, he still fell slightly short. What made him so troublesome was his absurd resilience, which turned the battle into a never-ending ordeal for the Supreme Ancestor.

Seeing the Supreme Ancestor struggle against Yuan, the Supreme Adviser—who had initially chosen not to intervene, confident his presence wouldn't be necessary—finally decided to step in and assist the Supreme Ancestor.
"Supreme Blood Arts, Grand Severance!"
The Supreme Adviser unleashed a crimson arc of blood, aiming directly at Yuan's back.
Yet Yuan didn't even spare it a glance, much less attempt to block it.

A moment later, the attack struck him squarely, but to no one's surprise, it caused no damage. Yuan didn't so much as flinch, continuing to chase after the Supreme Ancestor as if the Supreme Adviser didn't exist at all.
The Supreme Adviser, who had never suffered such blatant disregard, trembled with fury, his rage boiling over as he unleashed an even more relentless barrage of attacks upon Yuan.
"This... goddamn monster!" The Supreme Ancestor cursed out loud as he stopped running away and unleashed his most powerful techniques at Yuan.
"Supreme Blood Arts, Crimson Mirage!"
The Supreme Ancestor severed one of his own arms, letting his blood pour freely into the air.
From that flowing crimson, many figures began to take shape, molding itself into a perfect replica of him, creating multiple clones in seconds.
<God of War's Astral Arts!>
Yuan created a massive avatar, but he also used Blood Manipulation on it, turning it into a crimson giant.
With one swing of its sword, the avatar completely annihilated the Supreme Ancestor's clones.
"What is that ridiculous technique?!"
The Supreme Ancestor stared at the giant behind Yuan with widened eyes.
In the next moment, the Supreme Ancestor chose to imitate Yuan, conjuring a crimson giant of his own. However, unlike Yuan's avatar, his creation lacked refinement, its form crude and unstable.
Not long after, the two towering figures collided, their clash shaking the heavens.
Though the Supreme Ancestor's construct was inferior in form, it compensated with raw might, fueled by the overwhelming energy of an Absolute God.
Still, it fell short and ultimately lost to Yuan's avatar after a couple of exchanges.
After shattering the crimson giant, Yuan's avatar went straight for the Supreme Ancestor.
<God of War's Final Execution!>
The crimson avatar unleashed a relentless barrage, each strike growing heavier and more devastating than the last.
"This... irritating bastard!" the Supreme Ancestor roared, his defenses finally breaking under the overwhelming assault. In the next instant, his entire body was obliterated.

However, for demons, the heart was not merely a vital organ. It served as their heart, Dantian, and even their soul. As such, it was far more resilient than a human's soul refined with Soul Strength, making it exceedingly difficult to destroy.
At Yuan's current level, even with his overwhelming strength, he could not shatter the heart of an Absolute God without resorting to Eternal Essence.

Such a core was comparable to roughly thirty percent of Saaruk's power, and considering Saaruk stood among the upper echelon of Eternals, an Absolute God could realistically rival nearly half the strength of an ordinary Eternal.
Since Yuan couldn't destroy the Supreme Ancestor's core, he regenerated back to full seconds later.
"Looks like you cannot kill me, either." The Supreme Ancestor remarked with a cold smirk on his face.
"I wouldn't be so sure about that if I were you," Yuan replied with a profound smile.
The Supreme Ancestor's brows furrowed as he wondered if Yuan was just bluffing or really had more tricks hidden in his sleeves.
"So, when are you going to fight seriously?" Yuan suddenly asked him.
"What do you mean? I have been fighting seriously this whole time."

"I mean, you haven't really displayed the power of an Absolute God besides infusing some of your energy into your blood. Surely, you can do more than that as an Absolute God, or you're no different from a True God."
The Supreme Ancestor narrowed his eyes. Yuan was right—he had been holding back the power of an Absolute God.
However, it wasn't out of arrogance or because he deemed it unnecessary. Rather, it was a force so dangerous that it was reserved only for true life-and-death situations.
Although he couldn't kill Yuan, the reverse was equally true.
The battle had reached a deadlock with neither side able to truly end the other, so his life was not in genuine danger.
"I am not foolish enough to use a power that could destroy myself when my life is not in any danger," remarked the Supreme Ancestor.
"Oh? It's that powerful?" Yuan raised his eyebrows, his interest piqued.
"What the hell would you know when you're not even a True God, much less an Absolute God?" The Supreme Ancestor sneered in disdain.
After a moment of silence, Yuan spoke, "In other words, you'll only use that power when your life is threatened, huh?
In the next moment, Yuan summoned the Demon Devouring Sword, a cold smile spreading across his lips.
"I had hoped to defeat you without relying on this power... but it seems that was too much to expect at my current level."
"What... What is that sword?" the Supreme Ancestor muttered, his body trembling at the ominous aura it exuded.
"Bastard! How many have you slaughtered with that weapon?!" the Supreme Adviser shouted, his voice filled with alarm.
The sword exuded a terrifying presence perceptible only to demons—a malignant aura akin to killing intent, forged through the slaughter of countless lives.
<Demon Sealing Zone>
Without offering a response, Yuan activated the Demon Sealing Zone, erecting a barrier around himself and the Supreme Ancestor, as though he intended to fight to the death within it.
"This blasphemous power!!! You were a Demon Sealer this entire time?!" the Supreme Ancestor recoiled in shock, his face twisted with disbelief.
"You wanted to learn Demon Sealing Aura, right? Why don't I teach you... just like how I taught the others?"
A vicious light flickered in Yuan's eyes as an immense amount of Demon Sealing Aura exploded from his body.
"Against someone who used to be a Supreme Ruler, I guess it'll be fine to go all out for once..."
Yuan closed his eyes and recalled Tian Chenyu's memories.
"Demon Annihilation Array."
The Demon Sealing Zone suddenly shifted, its surroundings warping as it transformed into a massive structure—one that closely resembled the Demon Sealing Clan's Grand Library.

At the same time, the Supreme Ancestor felt his strength being steadily siphoned away by the array. The entire space was saturated with overwhelming Demon Sealing Aura, and under its influence, his power was not only being drained but actively suppressed.
However, Yuan wasn't done yet.
<Swords of Eternal Torment>
Countless shimmering swords materialized out of thin air, blanketing the entire space like a gleaming storm ready to descend.
"Demon Annihilation Legion."
The swords formed by the Swords of Eternal Torment began to expand and reshape, contorting into humanoid figures—each one taking form as a warrior, armed with a shimmering sword in hand.
Each of these warriors exuded immense Demon Sealing Aura, enough to instantly seal a ninth-level False God with a single strike.
Yuan then lowered himself, taking a seat upon the demon that was summoned using the Demon Devouring Sword, his presence towering over the field like an unrivaled sovereign.
"You son of a... You can't be..." The Supreme Ancestor's eyes trembled as a long-buried memory of a figure who had once plunged their world into terror countless eons ago surfaced.
"Allow me to reintroduce myself," Yuan said calmly, his gaze unwavering. "I am called Yuan now, but I was once known as Tian Chenyu—"
He paused, his presence deepening as the air itself seemed to grow heavier.
"—or, as others liked to call me, Divine Paragon."

sentences.text: "Go out all...?
So you're claiming that you're still hiding some strength?" The Supreme Ancestor narrowed his eyes at Yuan, his gaze filled with anger.

Without another word, Yuan unleashed his Chaotic Essence, and his already terrifying aura twisted into something utterly incomprehensible, as though the Demon God himself had descended upon the world.
Due to his Demonic Awakening, which increased his Chaotic Essence when in his demon form, his already powerful Chaotic Essence only became even more powerful.
"Ready or not, here I come!" Yuan shouted as he charged at the Supreme Ancestor, who continued trying to keep his distance from Yuan because of his flames.
Although the flames caused him no physical pain, they still melted his body and hindered his movements.
However, their most troublesome trait was their ability to burn away his energy.
In an attempt to keep Yuan away, the Supreme Ancestor used Void Manipulation and attacked at the same time.
Unfortunately for him, Yuan could also use Void Manipulation at a similar level, and none of his attacks were effective against Yuan, who could easily recover from any damage he received.
For the first time, the Supreme Ancestor experienced what it was like for humans to face demons in their earliest encounters—battling an incomprehensible existence that simply refused to die.
It wasn't that Yuan had surpassed the Supreme Ancestor in strength, either.
Even with his Chaotic Essence, he still fell slightly short.
What made him so troublesome was his absurd resilience, which turned the battle into a never-ending ordeal for the Supreme Ancestor.

Seeing the Supreme Ancestor struggle against Yuan, the Supreme Adviser—who had initially chosen not to intervene, confident his presence wouldn't be necessary—finally decided to step in and assist the Supreme Ancestor.
"Supreme Blood Arts, Grand Severance!"
The Supreme Adviser unleashed a crimson arc of blood, aiming directly at Yuan's back.
Yet Yuan didn't even spare it a glance, much less attempt to block it.
A moment later, the attack struck him squarely, but to no one's surprise, it caused no damage.
Yuan didn't so much as flinch, continuing to chase after the Supreme Ancestor as if the Supreme Adviser didn't exist at all.
The Supreme Adviser, who had never suffered such blatant disregard, trembled with fury, his rage boiling over as he unleashed an even more relentless barrage of attacks upon Yuan.
"This... goddamn monster!" The Supreme Ancestor cursed out loud as he stopped running away and unleashed his most powerful techniques at Yuan.
"Supreme Blood Arts, Crimson Mirage!"
The Supreme Ancestor severed one of his own arms, letting his blood pour freely into the air.
From that flowing crimson, many figures began to take shape, molding itself into a perfect replica of him, creating multiple clones in seconds.
<God of War's Astral Arts!>
Yuan created a massive avatar, but he also used Blood Manipulation on it, turning it into a crimson giant.
With one swing of its sword, the avatar completely annihilated the Supreme Ancestor's clones.
"What is that ridiculous technique?!"
The Supreme Ancestor stared at the giant behind Yuan with widened eyes.
In the next moment, the Supreme Ancestor chose to imitate Yuan, conjuring a crimson giant of his own.
However, unlike Yuan's avatar, his creation lacked refinement, its form crude and unstable.
Not long after, the two towering figures collided, their clash shaking the heavens.
Though the Supreme Ancestor's construct was inferior in form, it compensated with raw might, fueled by the overwhelming energy of an Absolute God.
Still, it fell short and ultimately lost to Yuan's avatar after a couple of exchanges.
After shattering the crimson giant, Yuan's avatar went straight for the Supreme Ancestor.
<God of War's Final Execution!>
The crimson avatar unleashed a relentless barrage, each strike growing heavier and more devastating than the last.
"This... irritating bastard!" the Supreme Ancestor roared, his defenses finally breaking under the overwhelming assault.
In the next instant, his entire body was obliterated.
However, for demons, the heart was not merely a vital organ.
It served as their heart, Dantian, and even their soul.
As such, it was far more resilient than a human's soul refined with Soul Strength, making it exceedingly difficult to destroy.
At Yuan's current level, even with his overwhelming strength, he could not shatter the heart of an Absolute God without resorting to Eternal Essence.

Such a core was comparable to roughly thirty percent of Saaruk's power, and considering Saaruk stood among the upper echelon of Eternals, an Absolute God could realistically rival nearly half the strength of an ordinary Eternal.
Since Yuan couldn't destroy the Supreme Ancestor's core, he regenerated back to full seconds later.
"Looks like you cannot kill me, either." The Supreme Ancestor remarked with a cold smirk on his face.
"I wouldn't be so sure about that if I were you," Yuan replied with a profound smile.
The Supreme Ancestor's brows furrowed as he wondered if Yuan was just bluffing or really had more tricks hidden in his sleeves.
"So, when are you going to fight seriously?" Yuan suddenly asked him.
"What do you mean?
I have been fighting seriously this whole time."
"I mean, you haven't really displayed the power of an Absolute God besides infusing some of your energy into your blood.
Surely, you can do more than that as an Absolute God, or you're no different from a True God."
The Supreme Ancestor narrowed his eyes.
Yuan was right—he had been holding back the power of an Absolute God.
However, it wasn't out of arrogance or because he deemed it unnecessary.
Rather, it was a force so dangerous that it was reserved only for true life-and-death situations.
Although he couldn't kill Yuan, the reverse was equally true.
The battle had reached a deadlock with neither side able to truly end the other, so his life was not in genuine danger.
"I am not foolish enough to use a power that could destroy myself when my life is not in any danger," remarked the Supreme Ancestor.
"Oh?
It's that powerful?" Yuan raised his eyebrows, his interest piqued.
"What the hell would you know when you're not even a True God, much less an Absolute God?" The Supreme Ancestor sneered in disdain.
After a moment of silence, Yuan spoke, "In other words, you'll only use that power when your life is threatened, huh?
In the next moment, Yuan summoned the Demon Devouring Sword, a cold smile spreading across his lips.
"I had hoped to defeat you without relying on this power... but it seems that was too much to expect at my current level."
"What...
What is that sword?" the Supreme Ancestor muttered, his body trembling at the ominous aura it exuded.
"Bastard!
How many have you slaughtered with that weapon?!" the Supreme Adviser shouted, his voice filled with alarm.
The sword exuded a terrifying presence perceptible only to demons—a malignant aura akin to killing intent, forged through the slaughter of countless lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 2423 Divine Paragon Returns!
paragraphs: "Divine—?! That maniac has returned?!" the Supreme Adviser cried out, his voice trembling as though his greatest nightmare had come to life.
"No way!" Purple, who was watching from afar, nearly fell from the sky after learning of Yuan's true identity.
"What did he just say?" Even Supreme Ruler Grant halted his clash with Supreme Ruler Dena, his gaze snapping toward Yuan as his eyes widened in disbelief.
"That's the lunatic from the other world—the one who went on a killing spree the moment he arrived?!"
The demons observing from a distance erupted into chaos, their voices rising in a storm of shock and fear.
"What were the people from the other world called again? Hymen?"
"I swear they were called hyumen."
"They're called humans, you idiots!"
"Blasphemer! Why the hell have you returned to our world?! Are you trying to collude with that fiend to take over our world?!" The Supreme Ancestor questioned Yuan.
"I heard you were quite close with her, after all!"
"Taking over your world? Isn't that what your current Supreme Ruler is plotting against my world?" Yuan sneered. "T-That's—!"
The Supreme Ancestor opened his mouth to speak, only to fall silent a second later, realizing he had no excuse to offer.
"Not even going to try and defend yourselves, huh?" Yuan shook his head.
"We are only doing what must be done!" the Supreme Adviser suddenly shouted. "Otherwise, our world will fall into chaos!"
"So, to resolve your crisis, you intend to plunge another world into chaos... for the second time?" Yuan's voice rang out, carrying for miles.
"In that case..." his gaze turned cold as he continued, "I now have every reason to resume my former goal—the complete eradication of demons!"
Yuan's already ridiculous Demon Sealing Aura surged even more violently.

He pointed at the Supreme Ancestor and commanded, "Bring me his core, then annihilate every single demon in this world!" At his command, the warriors surged forward in unison, each one moving with the precision and mastery of seasoned veterans, striking the Supreme Ancestor from all directions.
Even at this point, the Supreme Ancestor refused to use his powers as an Absolute God.
"Look at what you've done..." Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly remarked while shaking her head.
"What do you mean?" asked Supreme Ruler Grant.
"Do you have any idea how much effort I had put into changing his mind about annihilating our kind?" she sighed. "And you just undid all of my effort with your foolish ambition."
Supreme Ruler Grant sneered in disdain, "Do you really believe that a single mere human can wipe out our entire race? As I expected, you've gone crazy after becoming a Forsaken."

"What do you know? It's not like you've ever fought him," Supreme Ruler Dena said. "If I hadn't stopped him that day, none of you would even be alive right now. And that was ages ago. He's far stronger now than he was then. If you can't even defeat me, you can forget about defeating him."
"In that case, there won't be any problem!" Supreme Ruler Grant laughed as he dove back into battle, assailing her with his fake Eternal Essence.

Despite her overwhelming strength, Supreme Ruler Dena was nearly helpless against the Eternal Essence, even if it was an inferior version. Not only did Grant's control improve with every exchange, she also had to expend a tremendous amount of energy just to defend against it.

One might assume she could simply endure his blows and regenerate the damage, but Eternal Essence was fundamentally different. It was a power that could erase existence itself, damage that no regeneration can repair.

That being said, this didn't mean Supreme Ruler Dena couldn't regenerate an arm lost to Eternal Essence. But if the same spot took too much of that damage, the existence of that limb could be erased entirely and become impossible to recover.
Suddenly, as if struck by enlightenment, Supreme Ruler Dena began recalling the sensation of wielding Eternal Essence—or at least what she wielded while under the curse's control.

"Y-You! Why the hell do you have that power?!" Supreme Ruler Grant shouted, eyes and mouth agape. "Don't tell me the Demon God bestowed it on you too! Did he give it to me because he knew you could wield it?!"
"Who knows?" Supreme Ruler Dena replied with a cold smile, refusing to elaborate just to mess with him.

However, although she could wield Eternal Essence again, it was nowhere near the level she'd commanded in the past. Even so, it was more than enough to level the battlefield, allowing her to fight Supreme Ruler Grant on equal footing, and like him, her mastery improved with every exchange.
Meanwhile, the Supreme Ancestor had all his limbs, and even half his body, turned into stone after enduring hundreds of thousands of strikes from Yuan's Demon Annihilation Legion.
"What do you think? Are you able to grasp the Demon Sealing Aura in your body? Think you can wield it?" Yuan asked the Supreme Ancestor.
The Supreme Ancestor opened his mouth to respond, but Yuan immediately interrupted.
"You don't need to tell me because I already know the answer. You know, there's a reason why you cannot wield Demon Sealing Aura."

"The reason I cannot wield that power...?" The Supreme Ancestor fell silent, listening intently. He had always wondered why he couldn't wield Demon Sealing Aura despite his superior talent and bloodline compared to those who could.

Yuan pointed at him with the Demon Devouring Sword and spoke with a look of disdain, "Among those few demons who could wield Demon Sealing Aura, all of them had incredibly pure hearts. In other words, your heart is too corrupted to use Demon Sealing Aura."
"What kind of bullshit reasoning is that?!" the Supreme Ancestor roared, his aura suddenly skyrocketing toward the heavens.
"Enough of this farce! I'll kill you, even if my entire body falls apart!"
In the next instant, an unfathomable, profound energy erupted from him, filling the entire battlefield and collapsing on Yuan like an invisible mountain.
<You have discovered the existence of Refined Celestial Essence>

chapters.title: Chapter 2424 Refined Celestial Essence
paragraphs: 'Refined Celestial Essence, huh...' Yuan mused calmly as the Supreme Ancestor's overwhelming aura bore down on him.

In that moment, he finally understood why the Supreme Ancestor had refrained from using this power until now, as the sheer destructive force it carried was so intense that it even surpassed Chaotic Essence itself.

From the pressure alone, Yuan could feel his bones creaking and beginning to crack. Had his physique not been tempered to such extremes, that overwhelming force would have crushed him to death on the spot.
'Looks like it might really be impossible to fight him without Eternal Essence...' Yuan sighed inwardly.
Even so, he decided not to use it immediately, as he wanted to gauge his own limit.
"Die for me, you blasphemer!" the Supreme Ancestor roared as he unleashed his Refined Celestial Essence in a violent surge, wielding it as pure, unrestrained power without the need for any technique.

An invisible but overbearing energy washed over the Demon Annihilation Array, creating cracks throughout the structure. However, it was unable to destroy the array, and any damage was quickly restored.
As for the Demon Annihilation Legion, they were unable to bear the pressure and were all destroyed simultaneously.

When the Refined Celestial Essence slammed into Yuan, it felt as though his entire body was being shattered into countless fragments, like a jar being smashed over and over again, even after it had already been reduced to pieces.
As for his soul, it too was vaporized. But as long as Yuan's will remained unbroken, it could not be truly extinguished, and moments later, it reformed. Then, his body regenerated completely.
"He can still regenerate even with his soul destroyed...? I thought that was his kind's one true weakness!" the Supreme Ancestor cried out in disbelief.
Unbeknownst to him, although Yuan was technically human, he had long since transcended the limits of humanity.
<Eternal Constitution(Incompleted) has activated>
<Your understanding of Refined Celestial Essence has improved slightly>
"Is that all you've got?" Yuan scoffed. "I was curious what kind of power you were hiding... but this is rather disappointing.

The Supreme Ancestor became even more enraged and began unleashing even more Refined Celestial Essence without regard for his own well-being, as the energy was so destructive that it harmed its own user.
The Demon Annihilation Array eventually collapsed, and Yuan's body and soul were destroyed multiple times.
<Eternal Constitution(Incompleted) has activated>
<Your understanding of Refined Celestial Essence has improved slightly>
Yet, Yuan regenerated fully moments later.
"Why?! Why won't you fucking die?!" the Supreme Ancestor roared, unleashing his most powerful attack yet.
This time, however, Yuan did not remain still to endure it. An otherworldly energy erupted from his body, surging forth to meet the incoming Refined Celestial Essence head-on.
For a brief moment, the two forces clashed in a violent stalemate before Yuan's Eternal Essence suddenly surged, overwhelming the Refined Celestial Essence entirely.
It tore through the attack without resistance and crashed into the Supreme Ancestor, annihilating most of his body in an instant.
"This energy is...?!" Supreme Ruler Grant halted his fight with Supreme Ruler Dena for a second time to shift his attention to Yuan.
"How the hell is a human wielding the Demon God's power?!" he exclaimed in a sharp, bewildered tone.
Although he could tell that Yuan wielded Eternal Essence, he couldn't discern the difference between his own and Yuan's true, authentic Eternal Essence.
"Do you now understand why you won't be able to stop him if he wants to eradicate our existence?" Supreme Ruler Dena said with a smile on her face.

"The... The Demon God would never allow such a thing to happen!" "I wouldn't be so sure about that," Supreme Ruler Dena shook her head. "What the hell do you know when you've never even spoken to him! He bestowed me this power for a reason! Because he cares!"
"Whatever you say..." Supreme Ruler Dena said before launching an attack at him, resuming their fight.
Meanwhile, the Supreme Ancestor regenerated the damage caused by Yuan's Eternal Essence with difficulty.
"You... that power... it's what the Supreme Ruler is using! How did you acquire it?! Did the Demon God bestow it upon you as well?!

The Supreme Ancestor's disbelief deepened. In his eyes, Yuan's very existence was an affront to the Demon God, so the thought of him wielding such power felt like a direct insult to everything he believed in.
Moreover, this essentially meant that Yuan had the direct approval of the Demon God, something even he lacked as someone who once held the title of Supreme Ruler.
Yuan silently shrugged in response, refusing to satisfy his curiosity.

"Damn it..." The Supreme Ancestor felt perplexed, his thoughts in turmoil as he weighed whether to continue the fight. To stand against Yuan now after learning of the truth meant willingly opposing someone acknowledged by the Demon God—an act no different from blasphemy.
"What's wrong? Are you out of energy already? Or are you simply giving up?" Yuan suddenly remarked. A provocative smile tugged at his lips as he continued, "What a pathetic little bitch."
Hearing Yuan's insult, something snapped within the Supreme Ancestor.
"AAAAAHHHH!"
A violent surge of energy erupted from the Supreme Ancestor, his aura twisting and distorting as it transformed into something entirely unrecognizable.
"Oh...? Is he...?" Yuan raised an eyebrow as a familiar smell—a stench started emitting from the Supreme Ancestor.
"Bastard! So what if you received the Demon God's approval?! Even if you were the Demon God himself, I would still dare to devour you!" The Supreme Ancestor roared like an unrestrained beast.
"Supreme Ancestor?! What are you—?!" The Supreme Adviser's eyes widened with bewilderment as the Supreme Ancestor had suddenly turned into a Forsaken.

"To think you'd turn into a Forsaken just like that..." Yuan said, his tone calm as his eyes observed the transformation. "This is my first time witnessing it firsthand, and it's quite disappointing. Then again, you've done nothing but disappoint me since the beginning."
He paused briefly before continuing, his voice turning indifferent.
"Oh well. I suppose there's no longer any reason to spare you now... not that I had such intentions, anyway."

"This energy is...?!" Supreme Ruler Grant halted his fight with Supreme Ruler Dena for a second time to shift his attention to Yuan.
"How the hell is a human wielding the Demon God's power?!" he exclaimed in a sharp, bewildered tone.
Although he could tell that Yuan wielded Eternal Essence, he couldn't discern the difference between his own and Yuan's true, authentic Eternal Essence.
"Do you now understand why you won't be able to stop him if he wants to eradicate our existence?" Supreme Ruler Dena said with a smile on her face.
"The...
The Demon God would never allow such a thing to happen!" "I wouldn't be so sure about that," Supreme Ruler Dena shook her head.
"What the hell do you know when you've never even spoken to him!
He bestowed me this power for a reason!
Because he cares!"
"Whatever you say..." Supreme Ruler Dena said before launching an attack at him, resuming their fight.
Meanwhile, the Supreme Ancestor regenerated the damage caused by Yuan's Eternal Essence with difficulty.
"You... that power... it's what the Supreme Ruler is using!
How did you acquire it?!
Did the Demon God bestow it upon you as well?!
The Supreme Ancestor's disbelief deepened.
In his eyes, Yuan's very existence was an affront to the Demon God, so the thought of him wielding such power felt like a direct insult to everything he believed in.
Moreover, this essentially meant that Yuan had the direct approval of the Demon God, something even he lacked as someone who once held the title of Supreme Ruler.
Yuan silently shrugged in response, refusing to satisfy his curiosity.
"Damn it..." The Supreme Ancestor felt perplexed, his thoughts in turmoil as he weighed whether to continue the fight.
To stand against Yuan now after learning of the truth meant willingly opposing someone acknowledged by the Demon God—an act no different from blasphemy.
"What's wrong?
Are you out of energy already?
Or are you simply giving up?" Yuan suddenly remarked.
A provocative smile tugged at his lips as he continued, "What a pathetic little bitch."
Hearing Yuan's insult, something snapped within the Supreme Ancestor.
"AAAAAHHHH!"
A violent surge of energy erupted from the Supreme Ancestor, his aura twisting and distorting as it transformed into something entirely unrecognizable.
Is he...?" Yuan raised an eyebrow as a familiar smell—a stench started emitting from the Supreme Ancestor.
"Bastard!
So what if you received the Demon God's approval?!
Even if you were the Demon God himself, I would still dare to devour you!" The Supreme Ancestor roared like an unrestrained beast.
"Supreme Ancestor?!
What are you—?!" The Supreme Adviser's eyes widened with bewilderment as the Supreme Ancestor had suddenly turned into a Forsaken.
"To think you'd turn into a Forsaken just like that..." Yuan said, his tone calm as his eyes observed the transformation.
"This is my first time witnessing it firsthand, and it's quite disappointing.
Then again, you've done nothing but disappoint me since the beginning."
He paused briefly before continuing, his voice turning indifferent.
"Oh well.
I suppose there's no longer any reason to spare you now... not that I had such intentions, anyway."

chapters.title: Chapter 2425 Devouring the Supreme Ancestor
paragraphs: "T-There must be a misunderstanding! The Supreme Ancestor can't have turned into a Forsaken!" The Supreme Adviser tried to reason with Yuan, but he wasn't having any of it.
"The foul stench coming from him, there's no mistaking it," Yuan remarked as he stopped holding back and attacked the Supreme Ancestor with his Eternal Essence.

Despite the Supreme Ancestor's superior cultivation as an Absolute God, it was nowhere near enough to handle Yuan's Eternal Essence. After he devoured the curse that had taken control of Supreme Ruler Dena's body in the Deprived Crimson Valley, his Eternal Essence improved tremendously, which was stronger than Supreme Ruler Grant and Supreme Ruler Dena... combined. "If you kill the Supreme Ancestor, you'll truly become the enemy of this world!" The Supreme Adviser continued.
Yuan sneered, "If you don't shut up, I'll kill you too."
The Supreme Adviser trembled at his cold words.

Yuan continued, "You tossed Dena into the Deprived Crimson Valley without solid evidence that she'd turned into a Forsaken, yet you're going to spare this asshole? There's really something wrong with your logic!" "That's..." Unable to refute Yuan's words, the Supreme Adviser turned silent and lowered his head in shame.
"Die, you insufferable bastard!" the Supreme Ancestor roared, hurling everything he had at Yuan.
"I should be saying that to you," Yuan sneered as he coated the Demon Devouring Sword.
<Heaven Splitting Sword Strike>
Instead of using spiritual energy, Yuan activated Heaven Splitting Sword Strike using pure Eternal Essence, something he'd never done before due to a lack of Eternal Essence.

An unstoppable beam of Eternal Essence shot toward the Supreme Ancestor, who tried to run but was suddenly restricted by the Demon Annihilation Array Yuan had set up again shortly after his last one was destroyed.
"You—!"
The beam completely engulfed the Supreme Ancestor, and his silhouette was almost instantly vaporized. However, even with such a powerful attack, it was not able to completely destroy his heart.
Seeing this, Yuan tossed the Demon Devouring Sword at it.
"Devour it!" he commanded.
The instant the Demon Devouring Sword's tip touched the Supreme Ancestor's heart, the illusion of a colossal jaw manifested, snapping shut around the crystal and devouring it.
<The Demon Devouring Sword has consumed the Supreme Ancestor's Core>
<The Demon Devouring Sword has begun to refine the Supreme Ancestor's Core>
<The Demon Devouring Sword has fulfilled all conditions for its evolution>
<The Demon Devouring Sword has begun to evolve>
"Hm?" Yuan raised an eyebrow when he saw these notifications, looking pleasantly surprised by it.
He never knew the Demon Devouring Sword could evolve, much less that it was already in the process of its evolution.
'Looks like I still haven't recalled all of Tian Chenyu's memories...'

However, now that he thought about it, the fact the Demon Devouring Sword could evolve wasn't too surprising, as it was originally an ordinary sword that evolved into a powerful treasure specifically meant to kill demons.

And while the Demon Devouring Sword has devoured countless demons throughout the years, including high-ranking demons like Demon Emperors, it had never tasted the core of a Supreme Ancestor, a demon that once ruled the Demonic Realm as a Supreme Ruler.
Moments later...
<The Demon Devouring Sword has evolved into 'Demon Annihilation Sword'>
<The Demon Annihilation Sword has gained new Unique Abilities!>
[Unique Ability: When wielding the Demon Annihilation Sword, all Demon Sealing Techniques will have their power amplified by 666,666% -> 6,666,666%]
[Unique Ability(5): All demons below the rank of 'Supreme Ruler' that are struck by this sword will be instantly annihilated. All annihilated demons will be considered devoured.]
[Unique Ability(6): The Demon Annihilation Sword can transform into a Sword Spirit, possessing a will of its own.]
"Oh? It can also transform now?" Yuan muttered after seeing its new ability.
Without hesitation, he immediately tested the ability out.
In the next moment, the Demon Annihilation Sword began to change. Its blade extended and reshaped into a humanoid torso and limbs, while the hilt twisted and formed into a human head.
However, it didn't fully become human—only a rough approximation. It had no facial features or hair, appearing as a smooth, human‐sized mannequin.
"Uhhh...

Just as Yuan thought the Demon Annihilation Sword had finished transforming, it suddenly trembled, and new details began to emerge. Long black hair spilled from its head, and distinctly feminine features formed on its face. Its body also became taller and more slender.
"Y-You..."
Yuan's eyes nearly bulged from their sockets at the Demon Annihilation Sword's final form, his heart pounding like war drums.
Meanwhile, the Demon Annihilation Sword stared back at Yuan with her clear, hazel-colored eyes.
After a moment of silence, she muttered in a low voice, "Chenyu..."
Yuan swallowed nervously before subconsciously responding, "Ai... Rong?"
The Demon Annihilation Sword had shockingly taken the form of Tian Chenyu's sweetheart, Ai Rong!
'No... there's no way that's the real Ai Rong. It must have taken the form of the person it believes Tian Chenyu loved most...' Yuan thought.
Suddenly, the Demon Annihilation Sword turned away from Yuan to look at the Supreme Adviser, who was hovering not too far away with a bewildered expression on his face.
"Demon..."
The Demon Annihilation Sword muttered in a cold voice, then her expression twisted into a sadistic grin.

"I'll eradicate all of the demons in this world!" she shouted, suddenly charging at the Supreme Adviser, who let out a piercing scream like a man haunted by a vengeful ghost before turning around and running away.
"H-Hey! Stop! He's not a target!" Yuan hastily said to the Demon Annihilation Sword.
The Demon Annihilation Sword stopped chasing the Supreme Adviser.
However, before Yuan could even say anything else, she turned to look in the direction where Supreme Ruler Grant and Supreme Ruler Dena were fighting and flew toward them.
"Wait!"
Yuan shouted at her again, but instead of stopping, she actually quickened her pace.
"Damn it! How do I even undo her transformation?!" Yuan exclaimed as he chased after her.

chapters.title: Chapter 2426 Demon Annihilation Sword
paragraphs: 'Heavens! She can use Void Manipulation?!' Yuan exclaimed inwardly when he saw the Demon Annihilation Sword using Void Manipulation to travel.
Meanwhile, Supreme Ruler Grant and Supreme Ruler Dena remained locked in a stalemate, neither able to gain the slightest advantage over the other.

Although Supreme Ruler Dena had a much better understanding of Eternal Essence, Supreme Ruler Grant's Eternal Essence was naturally stronger since it was created by a real Eternal—a Prime Eternal, no less. This allowed him to match Supreme Ruler Dena's prowess despite having a weaker... barely any understanding of Eternal Essence.
It was like a talentless cultivator wielding a priceless treasure against a true genius armed with nothing more than a broken blade.
Suddenly, they halted mid-clash, their attention snapping toward a powerful, unfamiliar presence rapidly approaching.
Not only was its aura overwhelmingly strong, it also carried an insane amount of the very energy all demons feared—Demon Sealing Aura.
"It's not Yuan... who is that?" Supreme Ruler Dena was shocked to see someone with as much Demon Sealing Aura as Yuan.
"What a monster..." Even Supreme Ruler Grant was surprised by her overwhelming presence.
Soon, the Demon Annihilation Sword appeared before them with an excited look on her face.
"Foul demons, I will annihilate all of you!"

The Demon Annihilation Sword suddenly appeared in her grasp. Then, without hesitation or warning, she attacked, lunging at Supreme Ruler Grant, who happened to be the closest to her. "This crazy little—!"
Supreme Ruler Grant raised his arm that was coated in Eternal Essence to block her strike.
However, to his absolute surprise, the Demon Annihilation Sword tore right through it and severed his arm.
Seeing this, Supreme Ruler Grant subconsciously distanced himself from her with a bewildered expression on his face.

It wasn't as though she was using Eternal Essence, so how had she cut through it? Studying his severed arm more closely, he realized the Eternal Essence remained intact, and it was only the limb that had been cleaved away, as if her attack had passed straight through his Eternal Essence.
When Supreme Ruler Grant ran away, the Demon Annihilation Sword immediately turned her attention to Supreme Ruler Dena, who was now the closest to her.
"Die, demon!"

Witnessing what happened to Supreme Ruler Grant, Supreme Ruler Dena didn't attempt to block her attack with Eternal Essence. Instead, Supreme Ruler Dena created a crimson barrier, but rather than using it to defend herself, she used it to trap the Demon Annihilation Sword.
Yet, not even a second after it enveloped the Demon Annihilation Sword, it was sliced in half by her.
"So effortlessly?!" Supreme Ruler Dena almost couldn't believe her eyes.
The Demon Annihilation Sword had no cultivation base either, and her entire being seemed to be formed purely from Demon Sealing Aura.
While she was in a daze, the Demon Annihilation Sword teleported in front of Supreme Ruler Dena like a ghost.
"Die!"
The Demon Annihilation Sword brought her sword down, aimed at Supreme Ruler Dena's head.
However, the Demon Annihilation Sword's attack was halted by Yuan, who just caught up and blocked her attack with Number One Under Heaven.
"Stop!" Yuan shouted at her. The Demon Annihilation Sword immediately withdrew her sword and stood still.
"Why?" she suddenly asked.
"I thought you wanted to kill all demons? I am only following your will, Master."
Yuan rubbed his eyes and sighed, "That was ages ago when I was still Tian Chenyu. I don't have such ambitions nowadays."
"Then what is my purpose? If I cannot kill demons, then I am worthless," she said in a cold voice.

"I never said we won't be killing a demon ever again," Yuan shook his head and clarified, "I am just saying that we no longer kill every demon in sight, especially now that we know there are two different kinds of demons, and it was the Forsaken that wreaked havoc in the Nine Heavens."
"What about those two?" The Demon Annihilation Sword pointed at the Supreme Rulers behind him.
"They look delicious," she added.
"The one behind me is not a target. She's a friend," Yuan said.
"As for that one..." Yuan's gaze shifted to Supreme Ruler Grant, their eyes locking.
After a brief silence, he smiled calmly. "You know what? You can go ahead and kill him."
"This son of a bi—!
"Yay!"
Supreme Ruler Grant couldn't even finish cursing at Yuan before the Demon Annihilation Sword lunged at him.
'Fuck! Why the hell is my arm regenerating so slowly?!' he cried inwardly.

After the Demon Annihilation Sword severed his left hand earlier, it still hadn't fully regenerated. Even when he focused on healing it, the process didn't improve and continued to recover at a snail's pace.
"Die, demon, die!"
The Demon Annihilation Sword attacked like a madman while Supreme Ruler Grant focused on avoiding her attacks, not daring to clash with her for obvious reasons.
After some time, the Demon Annihilation Sword stopped chasing after him and mumbled, "Arise."
The next moment, thousands... even millions of demons appeared out of thin air.
"What the fuck is this?! She can create demons?!" Supreme Ruler Grant exclaimed, unaware that they were all demons that she'd devoured in the past.
"Kill him!"
At the Demon Annihilation Sword's command, the demons rushed at Supreme Ruler Grant.

"Stop! As the Supreme Ruler, I command all of you to stop!" Supreme Ruler Grant tried to command them using his Power of Authority as the Supreme Ruler, but the demons completely ignored him and continued to lunge at him.
Seeing this, Supreme Ruler Grant immediately gave up on trying to control them and resorted to killing them instead.
"Get out of my way, you damn ants!"

Just by releasing his aura, he instantly vaporized almost all of the demons that surrounded him. After all, these demons retained their original strength at the time they were devoured and not strengthened in any way.
However, not even a second later, the Demon Annihilation Sword summoned even more demons to attack him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2427 One of Three Supreme Rulers
paragraphs: "Hey, bastard! Get your rabid mutt off me! I thought you were only killing Forsaken! I'm clearly not one!" Supreme Ruler Grant shouted as he clashed against the relentless tide of demons summoned by the Demon Annihilation Sword.

"Did I ever say that?" Yuan replied, tilting his head with a puzzled expression. "I may not kill ordinary demons without reason... but that doesn't mean I won't. If they've done something worthy of death, then I won't hesitate to kill them."
He narrowed his gaze and continued, "And you, who intends on invading my world, deserves death."

"But I am not the only one with such ambitions! In fact, it was the other two Supreme Rulers who proposed this idea in the first place!" Supreme Ruler Grant shouted, revealing a startling piece of information.
"The other two Supreme Rulers?" Yuan raised an eyebrow after hearing this.
He suddenly remembered that Supreme Ruler Grant was only one of three existing Supreme Rulers in this world, each ruling a part of the Demonic Realm.
The Demonic Realm was unfathomably massive, even larger than the entirety of the Nine Heavens combined, and currently, they were in the Crimson Continent, one of three major regions.

Even in the past, Tian Chenyu had never visited the other two regions, as it was simply too far away. Each region was so massive that they were essentially considered their own world, and unless war broke out, the three regions never interacted with one another. Even the Supreme Rulers rarely spoke with each other.
"Who are the current Supreme Rulers for the Bone Atoll and the Death Paradise?" Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly asked.
"The Supreme Rulers for those two regions haven't changed since you were last in power!" said Supreme Ruler Grant.
"So it's still Supreme Ruler Exosso and Supreme Ruler Umbra, huh?"
Yuan then remarked, "You've mentioned those names to me before, but you never went into detail about them.

"Supreme Ruler Exosso is the ruler of the Bone Atoll, a region that is ninety-nine percent water, and their people live on scattered islands there. Supreme Ruler Umbra is the ruler of Death Paradise, a world shrouded in darkness."

"The demons from these places are fundamentally different from the demons in the Crimson Continent because of their environment, even wielding different powers. While we specialize in Blood Arts, those from the Bone Atoll use Bone Techniques. As for those at Death Paradise... honestly, even I am not sure about their powers."

"Now that I think about it, I've met a few unusual demons who fought with their bones instead of blood, but they were incredibly rare compared to those from the Crimson Continent. Out of the millions of demons I've encountered, I've probably only seen a dozen like that. As for demons from Death Paradise, I don't think I've ever seen any of that type," Yuan wondered out loud.
"Why were there so few of them compared to demons from the Crimson Continent?" Yuan then asked.

"For the most part, it's because the Crimson Continent has the largest population by far, while Death Paradise has the smallest. Another reason was because the gateway to your world was located in the Crimson Continent, so they'd have to traverse a tremendous distance."

Yuan turned to look at Supreme Ruler Grant, who was still clashing with the army of demons and the Demon Annihilation Sword, and asked, "Hey, instead of invading my world, why don't you just go to the other regions?"
"If that was a choice, we would've already done it long ago!" Supreme Ruler Grant exclaimed.
"The Bone Atoll barely has any land, and Death Paradise is only habitable by its residents because of their unique constitution!" A surprised look crossed Yuan's face at the response.
"What kind of place is Death Paradise," he asked, "that even demons—creatures who survive the harshest environments—cannot endure?"

"There is something there that messes with our blood—wait a second!" Supreme Ruler Grant suddenly interrupted himself. "I will tell you everything you want to know, but you have to stop this beast first!"

With the help of her army of demons, the Demon Annihilation Sword managed to land two more attacks on Supreme Ruler Grant, each one successfully severing a limb. Now, Supreme Ruler Grant had one... and a half limbs left.
"I'll only tell her to stop if you swear that you will give up on invading my world," Yuan said. "Otherwise, you can die here."

paragraphs: "If any demon that lacks the required constitution is exposed to the air in Death Paradise, their blood will lose its power and eventually die if their exposure is prolonged," Supreme Ruler Grant explained. "Fortunately, the poison is confined to Death Paradise and won't spread outside. If it did, we would have been wiped out long ago."
'I will need to investigate this further myself later...' Yuan thought to himself.
"Now tell me about the other two Supreme Rulers and why they want to invade my world," he then inquired.
"Their reason for wanting to invade your world?" Supreme Ruler Grant stared at Yuan with a blank expression for a moment before muttering, "I have no idea."
"What?" Yuan frowned.
"I-I swear!" he hastily continued. "They have never mentioned anything like that to me!"
"And you accepted it without question? Are you really that stupid?" Yuan asked.

Supreme Ruler Grant shook his head and admitted, "To be frank, I didn't. After all, the idea made sense back then... and it still does even now! Not to mention, it would resolve our issue, even if it's only a temporary one. At least, it would give us some more time to find another solution."
Yuan looked at Supreme Ruler Dena and asked, "Do you have anything to add?"
She shook her head
"No, I barely spoke with them before."
"In that case, I'll have to figure it out myself when I visit them," Yuan sighed. "Unless I stop them, they will definitely invade my world later."
"Where do you want to go first?" Supreme Ruler Dena then asked.
"What's the closest?"
"The Bone Atoll." "The Bone Atoll, it is."
She nodded.
"Then I'll take us there now."
"Wait." Yuan said before turning to look at Supreme Ruler Grant. "You're coming with us."

"What?!" Supreme Ruler Grant exclaimed. "Why do I have to come with you?! This is your problem, not mine! And I've already agreed not to invade your world, so just leave me alone!" "You can either come with us, or you can go to hell. Which do you prefer?" Yuan glared at him.
"You...! Do you have no shame?! How can you still threaten me after our agreement?! Are all humans as despicable as you?!"
"No, some are even worse." Yuan smiled.

"Anyway, even if you already promised not to invade my world, it doesn't change the fact that you're still involved in this whole situation and my world is still in danger, so until we completely resolve this issue, our agreement is on hold."
"What about him?" Supreme Ruler Dena's gaze shifted to Lev, who was waiting for them in a safe area with Purple beside him.
"I'll let him decide."
A moment later, Yuan asked Lev, "We're going to meet the Supreme Ruler of Bone Atoll right now. Do you want to come along or stay here? Once again, I cannot guarantee your safety."

"I doubt it'll be more dangerous than what I've already experienced on our way here," Lev said with a stiff smile. "In fact, I'm beginning to think the safest place in this world is by your side, so I'll follow you even to the end of this world!" Yuan nodded.
"Then let's go."
"At least let me heal first—" Supreme Ruler Grant requested, but was interrupted when Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly used Void Manipulation, teleporting them millions of miles in the blink of an eye.
However, the distance from the City of Blood to the Bone Atoll was so immense that it required several more teleportations to reach their destination.
"So this is the Bone Atoll, huh?" Yuan muttered as they returned to the Bloody Expanse.
"We're still in the Crimson Continent," Supreme Ruler Dena corrected, then moved forward a few paces.
"Come here," she then said.
Yuan nodded and flew to her.

The moment he crossed an invisible threshold, the air shifted. It wasn't just the scent or atmosphere that changed, either. The gravity also grew several times heavier, as if he'd walked into another world. But when he looked around, the landscape remained unchanged.
"Wow...what an odd feeling," Lev said as he entered the Bone Atoll for the first time.
"Though we all share the same plane, the three regions are separated by invisible barriers—each one a bubble with its own rules and environment," explained Supreme Ruler Grant.
"This also means that the rules from one continent don't apply to another continent," he added.
"Isn't that right, Supreme Ruler Dena?" Supreme Ruler Grant uttered her name without fear.
"You can't utter her name in the Crimson Continent even as the Supreme Ruler?" Yuan asked.
"Of course not. A rule that doesn't apply to everyone isn't a proper one," he sneered.
"Wow, I didn't think you were capable of saying such a thing," Yuan said with a surprised face.
Supreme Ruler Grant frowned at his comment.
"Are you implying that I am evil and have no sense of justice?" Yuan silently shrugged.
"Umm... if the rules in this region are different... how do we know what's against the rule and what isn't? What if we accidentally invoke Demon God's Wrath?" Lev suddenly asked.
"Unfortunately, there's no way to know unless you ask the residents of this region. This is also why people avoid traversing to other regions," said Supreme Ruler Dena.
"No way... then how do we avoid breaking the rules by accident?"
"It's quite simple. Don't talk unless necessary, and don't make unnecessary movements."
Lev was speechless, and he was beginning to regret following them to another region, where he could die by uttering a forbidden word by accident.
Yuan looked at Supreme Ruler Grant and said, "As the Supreme Ruler, you should be familiar with the rules of this place, no?"
"Nope."
"And you expect me to believe that?" Yuan refused to believe that a Supreme Ruler would not know the rules of a neighboring region even if he rarely visited them.
Supreme Ruler Grant shrugged.
"Believe it or not, this is actually my first time leaving the Crimson Continent. When we have our meetings, we would meet at the tripoint, where the borders for all three regions are connected."

paragraphs: "You know surprisingly little for a Supreme Ruler," Yuan sighed. "Why did we even bring you?"
"You're more than welcome to send me back," Supreme Ruler Grant sneered.
"Too much work," said Supreme Ruler Dena, completely denying his wishes.
"So, where should we go now?" Yuan then asked her.

"I've visited the Supreme Ruler's territory a few times, but I doubt that knowledge will be of much use now. The islands within Bone Atoll are constantly drifting with the natural currents, and only its residents understand their movements well enough to track them," she said.
"So we need to find some residents to ask them."
"I will lead the way."
Instead of using Void Manipulation, Supreme Ruler Dena just flew normally.
A few days later, they arrived at a certain island.

Although it was called an island, it was quite massive, nearly the size of a medium-sized city in the Nine Heavens that could easily fit millions of people. However, despite the spacious land, Yuan could only sense a few thousand presences from it.
"Let's go." "Wait!" Supreme Ruler Grant suddenly shouted.
"Are you seriously going to let the public see me in this state?! I am still the Supreme Ruler, you know!"
He gestured at his mangled body with his only remaining arm—his legs still severed, the other arm only halfway regenerated.
Yuan glanced at him and smirked, "Don't worry, we have another Supreme Ruler here. You can just pretend to be our livestock or something."
"Me?! Livestock?!" He exclaimed with a bewildered expression, as if he couldn't believe his ears.
Never had he been humiliated to such an extent.
But before he could express his displeasure, Yuan descended to the island with Supreme Ruler Dena and Lev following behind.
Supreme Ruler Grant had intended to stay behind, but a sharp, pointy sensation suddenly pressed against his back.
When he turned around, he was met with the sight of the Demon Annihilation Sword, her blade already raised in her grasp.
"What do you want?
"If you don't follow my master, I'll devour you," she calmly replied, her indifferent tone sending chills down his back.
'To think I'd be treated like a slave and threatened like this!' he gritted his teeth in frustration.
"Listen here, you little—"
He wanted to retaliate, but when he sensed the Demon Annihilation Sword's Demon Sealing Aura slowly surging, he swallowed his words and reluctantly chased after Yuan's group.
Meanwhile, Yuan landed upon the island and extended his divine sense, sweeping across the residents ahead.
Instead of ordinary buildings, every structure was constructed from bones, casting a grim and unsettling atmosphere over the entire place.
Moreover, unlike ordinary bones, these bones were naturally black, resembling charcoal.
Shortly after their arrival, several demons emerged from their bone-crafted dwellings, each gripping a spear fashioned from the same dark material.
"Who are you people?" one of them demanded.

These demons looked identical to those from the Crimson Continent. However, unlike their counterparts, the inhabitants of Bone Atoll rarely ventured beyond their own islands, spending most of their lives within their territory.
As a result, visits from outsiders were uncommon, and more often than not, they ended in conflict, which explained the wariness and hostility in their expressions.
"I am the Supreme Ruler of the Crimson Continent, and I have some questions for you," said Supreme Ruler Dena.
"The Supreme Ruler?!" They all expressed shock at her introduction, but they didn't immediately believe her.
"Why would the Supreme Ruler come to a place like this? Show us proof of your identity."
Supreme Ruler Dena didn't say anything and revealed the Power of Authority on her forehead.
Upon sensing the unfathomable energy exuding from her symbol, they quickly lowered their weapons and bowed to her.
"We greet the Supreme Ruler of the Crimson Continent. If you have any questions, we will answer them to the best of our ability."
They may hail from a different region, but the authority and reverence commanded by a Supreme Ruler did not diminish simply by crossing into another territory.
"Where can I find Supreme Ruler Exosso?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked.
"The Supreme Ruler can be found at the Weeping Ossuary."
"And where is that? I am unfamiliar with your territory."
"In that case, it would be in your best interest to find a guide who can take you there."

"Can I just have one of you take us there?" The demons immediately fell silent as they became hesitant. Although they wanted to refuse, they didn't dare to say no to a Supreme Ruler, fearing the consequences.
Noticing their reluctance, Yuan asked, "Where can we find a guide? If we're going to look for one, we might as well find a proper one."
The demons quickly became at ease upon hearing his words, and one of them said, "There's actually a well-known guide not too far from our atoll. I can bring you there if you'd like."
"Let's do that." Without any delay, the demon led Yuan and his group to another island nearly two weeks away.
Soon, they arrived at another atoll—this one far smaller, resembling a solitary island—with a single, lonely structure standing at its center.
Before Yuan's group even touched the ground, a figure emerged from the building to meet them.
"If it isn't my neighbor. Looking for a guide?" Asked the guide, a grey-colored male demon. "Where are ya trying to go?"

"I am not the one looking for you. They are." The demon who led Yuan's group there said. "She's the Supreme Ruler of the Crimson Continent, and they are trying to reach the Weeping Ossuary to meet with our Supreme Ruler."
"What?"
The guide looked at Supreme Ruler Dena with a suspicious gaze.
"Are you sure about that? From what I heard, their most recent Supreme Ruler is male," he remarked.
"What?! Are you saying that she's an imposter?! But she has the Power of Authority, which can only be possessed by Supreme Rulers!"
Supreme Ruler Dena then spoke in a calm voice, "If you're talking about that weakling Supreme Ruler Grant, then I killed him not long ago and took over his position."

Fortunately for you, I am an experienced guide."

Supreme Ruler Dena fell silent.
"Is that too expensive? Normally, I would charge a hundred thousand Grand Calx or ten Supreme Bone Calx..."
Lev then spoke, "Uh... we don't have such currency in the Crimson Continent."
It was the guide's turn to fall silent.
"Don't tell me... you want me to guide you for free?" he asked after a moment of silence.
Yuan then spoke, "How about this? Rather than an upfront payment, we'll pay you upon arrival at our destination, and we'll even pay you your original—no, double your normal rates."
"Even if we get there, how do you intend to pay when you don't have any money?" The guide inquired with a puzzled face.
"Although we don't have any money, we won't be the ones paying you. Supreme Ruler Exosso will be footing the bill, after all," Yuan elaborated with a nonchalant face.
"Uhh... do they know that they'll be paying me, or are you just..." the guide's confused face turned into a doubtful one.
"Trust me, they'll definitely pay you. The Supreme Ruler here will make sure of that." Yuan said while pointing at Supreme Ruler Dena.
"Alright! I will trust you!"
Despite his enthusiasm, the guide was lying about trusting them.
However, there was really nothing he could do but accept his fate and guide them to their destination even if they couldn't pay him.
After all, if he refused and offended them, death would be the least of his worries.
"When would you like to go?" The guide then asked.
"Can we depart immediately?"
"Not immediately since I will need some time to study the currents."
"How much time do you need?"
"A few days should be enough."
"Then we will leave once you're ready."
Some time later, the guide left the island to study the current while the demon who led them there returned to his own island.
"What if he just leaves us here?" Lev asked as they watched the guide disappear.
"Then we will sink this place," Supreme Ruler Dena calmly said.
Three days later, the guide returned and said, "Alright, we can start traveling."
Yuan nodded, and they started following him into the water.
"By the way, my name is Gutou."
"We can use Void Manipulation, you know?" Lev remarked shortly after their journey began.

"So can I, but if I want accurate reading, I must constantly study the currents. Normally, it doesn't require this much effort, but like I said earlier, the currents have been chaotic and unpredictable recently."
Lev then asked, "If the currents are unpredictable, how can you accurately pinpoint our destination? By the time we arrive, it will likely have drifted somewhere else entirely."
"Although the atolls move with the currents, those currents aren't entirely random," Gutou explained. "They all circulate within the same region, so the atolls never stray beyond a fixed area."
He continued, "I'm not reading the currents to pinpoint the Weeping Ossuary itself, but to chart a path toward its area. Without doing so, we'd easily lose our way.
"Can't we just head in one direction? Even without reading the currents, we should eventually reach that area."
Gutou shook his head. "It's not that simple. While the atolls themselves don't leave their region, the regions shift—so what is east now could become west later."
"Wouldn't it be impossible to even begin if you're not constantly reading the currents? If you ignore them for too long, you wouldn't even know where to start," Lev said, raising an eyebrow.

"No," Gutou replied. "We can roughly determine our location—and what surrounds us—by the scent of the water. Each region has a slightly different smell. That's why I said only an experienced guide can navigate these waters."
"Oh, and each region also has its own unique landmarks," he added. "We use those as reference points as well."
"What a pain in the ass... no wonder the people here prefer to stay on their own island and rarely venture out." Supreme Ruler Dena sighed out loud.
"How long do you think it'll take us to reach our destination?" Yuan finally asked.
"Hard to say, but a few thousand years if we're lucky."
Yuan sighed, "I knew it was something ridiculous, so I was afraid to even ask..."
"Wait a second..."
Yuan suddenly stopped moving and remained still with a pondering look on his face.
"What's wrong?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked him.
Yuan glanced at the crimson sea below and muttered, "Let me try something."
He descended onto the surface and pressed his palm against the water.
In the next instant, the raging sea fell into complete stillness—its currents silenced, as though the ocean itself had been subdued.
"T-The Bloody Expanse became still?!" Gutou exclaimed in shock and bewilderment. "What in Demon God's name did you do?!"
"I commanded it to stop moving, that's all," Yuan calmly said.
"That's all?! THAT'S ALL?!?!" Gutou shouted hysterically, his voice cracking as if on the verge of madness. "Who the hell are you?! The king of the seas?!"
"No, I'm Yuan," he replied, looking as nonchalant as possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 2431 Bone Atoll(4)
paragraphs: 'Absolute Water Manipulation... what a powerful technique.' Yuan thought to himself, as he never anticipated he would be able to literally command the sea.
However, while it may have seemed as though he had frozen the entire Bloody Expanse in time, in reality, he had only stilled a portion of it.
Even so, that 'portion' spanned several hundred thousand miles of the sea.
"How much faster can we arrive at our destination now?" Yuan asked Gutou.
Gutou stared at Yuan in shock, stunned speechless.
After a moment of silence, Gutou spoke, "If you can keep the currents frozen, we can travel with Void Manipulation and speed up our pace tremendously. Still, we'll need at least several years."
Yuan nodded and turned to Supreme Ruler Dena, "Can you follow his directions and move us to the edge of my 'territory'?"
She calmly nodded.
"This direction." Gutou pointed east a few moments later.
Supreme Ruler Dena then used Void Manipulation to teleport them to the edge of Yuan's territory, where the sea wasn't under his command.
When Yuan uses Absolute Water Manipulation, anything within his control is considered his territory.
After arriving, Gutou said, "Please give me a few days to read the currents, then you can freeze it."
A few days later, Yuan used Absolute Water Manipulation, freezing the Bloody Expanse as far as their eyes could see.
"That direction."
They would repeat this process for multiple times throughout the next two years.
Eventually...

"Seeing that atoll with the skull mountain? We have officially entered the region with the Weeping Ossuary. Honestly, we got lucky with its location." Gutou said as he pointed to an island on the horizon that had a lone white mountain shaped like a skull.
"So the Weeping Ossuary is somewhere around here?" Yuan asked.

"Somewhere, yes," Gutou replied. "Unfortunately, this is the largest region within the Bone Atoll. It may take us even longer to locate the Weeping Ossuary than it did to reach this place... even if we know the general location and head straight there."
"Then let's not waste any more time and get going—"
Suddenly, a massive bubble swelled beneath Yuan's feet, distorting the surface of the water, before erupting upward like a volcanic blast.
Supreme Ruler Dena quickly reacted and used Void Manipulation to teleport them all to safety.
The next instant, a massive sea serpent with crimson scales jumped out of the water and flew into the sky.
"Which bastard is responsible for disturbing my cultivation?!"
It glared at Yuan's group with immense killing intent.
"Huh? What are you talking about?" Yuan questioned.
"The bastard that stopped my currents! Identify yourself!" The red sea serpent roared.
"You're the cause of the abnormal currents?!" Gutou exclaimed with surprise.
With his vast experience as a guide, Gutou could proudly claim that he knew most of, if not all, sea devils within the Death Atoll. Yet, he has never seen or heard of this red serpent.
Moreover, like other guides, he believed that the unpredictable current was a natural phenomenon, not something caused by a sea devil.
"Are you responsible?!" The crimson sea serpent snapped to glare at Gutou.
"N-No!" he hastily refused while shaking his head.
"Then is it you?!"
It turned to look at Lev next.
"Th-That's right! I am responsible! So what?!" For some reason, Lev admitted to a crime he didn't commit.
"So... you will pay for your crime with death!" The crimson serpent roared as it lunged at Lev, who immediately hid behind Yuan.
Without a word, Yuan retrieved Number One Under Heaven and swung it at the incoming sea devil.
Sha!
Not only did Yuan cleave the crimson sea serpent in half with a single strike, but he also split the sea in half.
"Huh." Yuan stared at the sea devil's mangled corpse with a raised eyebrow.
"It's a lot weaker than I expected, considering that it was able to affect the Bloody Expanse to such an extent," he remarked.
As if he had jinxed it, the severed Sea Devil's corpse suddenly reconnected, its mangled body stitching itself back together before rising from the surface of the sea.
"Hahaha! If you think you can kill me with such a weak—"
Before the sea devil could even finish its sentence, Yuan unleashed Heaven Splitting Sword Strike at it, completely vaporizing its body until not even a single scale of it was left behind.
"Surely, it won't be able to regenerate from that, right?" Lev mumbled.
However, the moment Lev closed his mouth, a crimson orb suddenly materialized out of thin air, quickly expanding in size until it formed the crimson sea serpent again.
"What the hell?! To regenerate from that, its regeneration is on par with yours!" Lev exclaimed as he turned to look at Yuan.
Yuan narrowed his eyes at the crimson sea serpent. Then, without a word, unleashed Heaven Splitting Sword Strike again. This time, he used Eternal Essence.
However, not even half a minute later, the sea devil returned.
"It's useless! You will never kill this Everlasting Crimson Dragon!"
"You? A dragon?" Yuan sneered. "You're barely a sea serpent, much less a dragon."
"And I doubt you're really immortal."
"Then how is it coming back to life even after its entire body is vaporized?" Gutou asked.
"That's probably not its real body," Yuan remarked with a profound smile.
"?!" The Everlasting Crimson Dragon's body visibly stiffened when it heard Yuan's words.
The smile on Yuan's face widened.
"Looks like I am right. I bet its real body is somewhere in the Bloody Expanse."
"I'll give you credit where it's due," the Everlasting Crimson Dragon said. "You're the first to see through the truth."
"However, even if you know the truth, there's nothing you can do about it unless you know where my real body is! Hahaha!"
After a moment of silence, Yuan said, "So what? It's not like you can kill us, either."
"A bold claim! I may be unable to kill you now, but there's no such thing as forever! I'll wear you down and then kill you, no matter how long it takes!"
"Wear me down?" Yuan chuckled. "Good luck with that. I am guaranteed to find your real body before you can exhaust me."
"It would be nice if the Primal Sovereign of the Seas was still with us. I bet he'd be able to find its real body in a heartbeat," Lev remarked.
Suddenly, another bubble swelled across the water's surface nearby, and a massive figure surged forth from the sea in the next instant.
"Primal Sovereign of the Seas?!" Lev cried out loud in disbelief.
"I heard this majestic one's name being mentioned, so here I am!" the Primal Sovereign of the Seas laughed, its voice echoing across the sea.
Yuan narrowed his eyes before speaking in a suspicious tone, "Don't tell me you've been stalking us this entire time."
"Me? Stalking?" the Primal Sovereign of the Seas echoed, its expression turning incredulous, as if the very notion offended it.
He continued, "I just happened to be in the area."
Despite his clear-sounding voice, Yuan did not believe him one bit.
Meanwhile, the Everlasting Crimson Dragon trembled in fear.
"P-Primal Sovereign of the Seas?! What the hell are you doing here?!" It exclaimed, looking like it just saw a ghost.
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas turned to face it and spoke, "Hm? If it isn't Little Red. What are you doing here?"
"I came to this world to evolve because I didn't want to disturb the seas in the Primal Expanse!" He cried out loud.
"And yet, here you are!"
"It's just a coincidence."
"You two know each other?" Yuan suddenly interjected.
"Yes, we've clashed a few times in the Primal Expanse."
Yuan raised an eyebrow and remarked, "It survived not one but several clashes with you? It must be quite formidable."
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas burst out laughing and said, "That's because I never fought her seriously."
"She's female?"
"Not only that, but she has a crush on this majestic one. Unfortunately, we are not fated to be—"
"Shut the fuck up!" The Everlasting Crimson Dragon suddenly roared. "Who the hell has a crush on you?! That's just your own made-up fantasy!"
"If you don't have a crush on me, then why are you always coming after me and picking fights with me?"
"Because I am trying to surpass you!" "There's no need to be ashamed. This majestic one has plenty of admirers across the three worlds, after all."
"Screw you, you fat bastard!"
"You've become more feisty since I last saw you."
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas returned to Yuan and said, "Anyway, why did you call for me?"
Yuan sighed, "Nobody called for you."
"Then why was this majestic one's name mentioned?"
Lev raised his hand and said, "Um... I was the one who called your name."
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas' gaze immediately shifted to him, who proceeded to explain their situation to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2432 Weeping Ossuary
paragraphs: After hearing Lev's explanation, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas nodded repeatedly, as if everything had finally clicked—acting as though it hadn't already known all along.

The Primal Sovereign of the Seas turned to the Everlasting Crimson Dragon the next moment and said to her, "I won't stick my nose into your business, but before you proceed to fight to the death with him, you should know that he's the Primal Monarch's son."
"He's what?!" The Everlasting Crimson Dragon cried out loud, her eyes bulging from their sockets from shock.

"Oh, I mean he's the Primal Monarch's adopted son. He also possesses the Primal Monarch's powers." The Primal Sovereign of the Seas corrected himself and added another detail, leaving her absolutely speechless.
The Everlasting Crimson Dragon slowly turned to look at Yuan, a terrified glint flickering in her eyes.
"I...I am willing to forgive you for disturbing my evolution," she said a moment later.
Yuan rubbed his eyes and sighed aloud, "I've lost the desire to fight the moment this goldfish appeared."
"Hey, that's quite rude, especially when I gave you my Blood Essence," he remarked.
"You gave him your Blood Essence?!" The Everlasting Crimson Dragon exclaimed.
"Well, I did owe the Prima Monarch a—" the Primal Sovereign of the Seas suddenly halted his speech, his round eyes slowly shifting to glance at Yuan.
"I knew it." Yuan muttered. "You would've given me your Blood Essence even if I didn't get rid of the True Emperor of the Seas."
"That's..."

Yuan sighed out loud before speaking, "I planned to get rid of the True Emperor of the Seas, anyway. However, it doesn't feel good knowing that I had been fooled. I'll make sure to let my father know about this."
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas' eyes widened with disbelief.
"You're going to complain to the Primal Monarch?! That is petty as hell!" he cried out loud.
"Well, I nearly died because of you."
"The hell are you talking about?!"
Yuan revealed what the Demon God said shortly after his departure.
"To think his master would seek vengeance so quickly..."

After a brief pause, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas continued, "But I fail to see how any of this is my fault. If you were going to kill the True Emperor of the Seas regardless, you would've offended her sooner or later."
"True," Yuan replied, his voice calm, "but I would've done so in the Nine Heavens—where she couldn't touch me. You dragged it into the Demonic Realm, where Eternals can interfere."
"That's..."
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas' round body stiffened at Yuan's words, as if struck by their undeniable logic.
Sure enough, had it not dragged the True Emperor of the Seas into the Demonic Realm and urged Yuan to kill it, Prime Morveth would have had no opportunity to personally attack him.

"Fine, I get your point," said the Primal Sovereign of the Seas. "I have already given you my Blood Essence. What more do you want from me? The only thing even more valuable than my Blood Essence would be my life."
"Is that it? Do you want my life? You might as well have it if you're going to tell the Primal Monarch about what happened."
Yuan looked at him with raised eyebrows.

"Are you that afraid of the Primal Monarch? What even is your relationship with him? Seeing how you're even stronger than the Dragon God, I doubt you're a nobody. Of course, I also saw some of your memories when I consumed your Blood Essence."

He fell silent for a moment before speaking again, "For your assistance with the True Emperor of the Seas and your trouble, I'm willing to do the same thing for you. "That's relieving to hear."
"Unfortunately, I don't need you to kill anyone for me right now, so I'll keep this favor in my pocket for now."
"That's fine, too."
