A prideful smile tugged at the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' lips as it responded, "My title 'Primal' isn't for show, you know? Besides Eternals and the Primal Monarch, I am essentially unmatched."
Yuan pondered for a moment before asking, "So you're strong enough to defeat the Dragon God?"
"If you mean the Dragon God in his current state, then yes, I can deal with him no problem. If you're talking about his complete form, however... that might be an issue."
"I understand." Yuan nodded, having a decent grasp of the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' capabilities.
"Oh, I should also clarify. It's not that I cannot defeat Eternals. I am just unable to kill them. There's a big difference."
"Good to know." "Then I'll return to my feast now."

The Primal Sovereign of the Seas turned to look at the Everlasting Crimson Dragon, but he did not say anything, and after a moment of silence, dived into the Bloody Expanse, submering its massive body without causing even a single drop of water to splash.
"So, what do you want to do now?" Yuan asked the Everlasting Crimson Dragon. "Do you still want to fight?"
The Everlasting Crimson Dragon hastily shook her head. Even without Yuan saying it, she knew that he wouldn't hesitate to make the Primal Sovereign of the Seas kill her for him.

While she wasn't worried that Yuan might find her true body, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas was an entirely different story, as he could locate anything within the seas, regardless of their distance and location.
Yuan then said, "If you're going to return to your evolution or whatever, wait until we're done here because I will only disturb you again."
"That's fine. It's not like I can immediately return to my cultivation after being disturbed," she sighed.
"Sorry for disturbing you, by the way. It really wasn't on purpose."
The Everlasting Crimson Dragon didn't say anything else and disappeared into the water shortly later.

Gutou silently nodded his head.
Without another word, he resumed their journey.
With the currents returning to normal, Gutou swiftly located the Weeping Ossuary, and within five years, guided them to their destination.
"Dear esteemed guests, we have finally arrived at our destination—the Weeping Ossuary!" Gutou announced out loud the moment he saw its silhouette on the horizon.
"That's the Weeping Ossuary? What an ominous-looking place," Yuan remarked after seeing the island.

The island lay under a blanket of ash, dominated by a massive castle of bone that took up about seventy percent of the land's space. There were no trees or plants—only desolation, the castle being the island's only feature.
Without hesitation, Yuan used his divine sense to examine the castle's interior.
"I can only sense a single presence inside. Is this normal?" Yuan turned to Gutou.
"Uhh... I have never actually been inside, but no, I don't think it's normal," he replied.
Hearing this, Yuan quickly approached the Weeping Ossuary without uttering another word. Supreme Ruler Dena and the others quickly followed.
Some time later, Yuan stopped right outside the castle. Or more precisely, he was forced to stop by the powerful formation that enveloped the entire place.
"What should we do about—"
Before Gutou could even finish his sentence, Yuan retrieved Number One Under Heaven and swung it at the formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 2433 Supreme Ruler Exosso
paragraphs: Upon being struck by Yuan's overwhelming strength, the formation that surrounded the castle on Weeping Ossuary collapsed like a sheet of fragile glass after being struck by a hammer.
"Let's go."
Yuan immediately entered the castle, but instead of entering through the front gate, he went through the window that was closest to the presence.
Clang!
He smashed through the window and stepped into a vast, dim chamber fit for an emperor of death—pillars hewn from bone, a solitary throne carved of the same material.
Meanwhile, seated on the throne was a silhouette... or more precisely, a skeleton.
Even though whoever the skeleton belonged to appeared to have perished long ago, it still had a presence somehow.
Yuan turned to ask Supreme Ruler Dena, "What's going on here?"
However, she shrugged her shoulders and replied, "I don't know."
Suddenly, Gutou stepped forward and exclaimed in a shocked voice, "T-That's the Supreme Ruler!" "You can recognize him in that state?" Yuan raised his eyebrows, seemingly impressed by it.
Gutou nodded and explained, "As Bone Demons, everyone's bones and structures are unique."
"It's like how we can identify a demon purely by their blood," Supreme Ruler Dena remarked.
"Oh? I didn't know you could do that, either," Yuan muttered. He thought that he'd already known everything about demons, but turns out that wasn't the case.
"Anyway, why is the Supreme Ruler in that state?" he then asked. "And is he still alive?"

Gutou approached the throne, where the Supreme Ruler was seated, and examined it for a moment before shaking his head, "It may seem like he's alive, but he's already dead. As for his cause of death... sorry, but I don't know. It looks like he had all of his lifeforce consumed, leaving his bones behind—"
Gutou suddenly halted his speech, and his eyes widened with shock.
"S-Something's wrong!" he exclaimed.
"What is wrong?"
In the next moment the Supreme Ruler's skeleton shuddered, then slowly rose to its feet.
"Uh... I thought you said he was dead?" Yuan said.
"That's what I thought, but his bones suddenly returned to life!
Suddenly, a yellow orb of light emerged in each empty eye socket.
"I wasn't expecting any visitors," the skeleton spoke in a stiff voice.
"Are you Supreme Ruler Exosso?" Yuan questioned it.
"Indeed, I am. Who are you, and why did you break into my territory?"
Supreme Ruler Dena stepped forward and said, "Remember me?"
Supreme Ruler Exosso's flickering eyes dimmed slightly as he turned to look at her.
"Supreme Ruler Dena... I thought you had been imprisoned within the Deprived Crimson Valley."
Then he noticed Supreme Ruler Grant, who was standing not far away.
"You are Supreme Ruler Grant... What is going on here?"
"We should be asking you that," said Supreme Ruler Dena. "Why are you in that state? And why are you alone?"
Supreme Ruler Exosso raised an arm and silently gazed at it.
"It appears that I have been betrayed," he muttered in a nonchalant voice.
"What?"

Supreme Ruler Exosso then spoke, "I do not have time to explain everything, so I will just say this—I will be dying soon, but if you promise to kill Owen for me, I will use what little power I have left to preserve my bones and gift them to you."
"Owen? Who is that?" Yuan asked.
"He was the Supreme Adviser... my advisor," Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly said. "In other words, the 10th Supreme Ruler."
"You mean the one who suddenly disappeared after he became the Supreme Ruler and hasn't been seen since then?!" Lev exclaimed.
"To think he was hiding in the Bone Atoll..." Yuan muttered, before continuing, "Alright, we'll kill him for you. That bastard framed Dena for something she didn't do, anyway."
Supreme Ruler Exosso nodded, then fell silent. Without another word he collapsed back onto the throne, his presence completely extinguished.
Yuan collected his bones a moment later and asked, "So, what can we do with this?"

Gutou swallowed nervously at the sight of the Supreme Ruler's bones before responding, "A Bone Demon's bones are exceedingly valuable since it's the source of our powers. As for the Supreme Ruler's bones... it's simply priceless. Any Bone Demon would kill even for one of his bones, much less his entire body.
"So it's valuable, huh?"
Yuan stared at the heap of bones for a moment, then plucked a pinky bone and tossed it at Gutou.
"?!" Gutou hastily caught the bone and proceeded to stare at Yuan in disbelief.
"Consider that as payment for bringing us here," Yuan said.
"Really?!" Gutou shrieked, unable to contain his excitement.
Yuan quietly nodded.
"T-Thank you! Thank you very much!" Gutou bowed to Yuan repeatedly.
Even a tiny pinky bone from the Supreme Ruler could easily start a war in the Bone Atoll and was countless times worth more than what Gutou could earn in his lifetime.
"What should I do with the rest of his bones?" Yuan mumbled before turning to ask Supreme Ruler Dena. "Do you want it?"
"I have no use for it," she said, shaking her head.
"I want it!" An eager voice resounded.
Yuan shifted his gaze to the Demon Annihilation Sword, who had her hands raised.
He wondered why a girl like her wanted the bones for a second before remembering that her true form was the Demon Annihilation Sword and that she could consume demons to strengthen herself.
"You can have it."
Without hesitation, Yuan handed the whole skeleton to the Demon Annihilation, who immediately began chewing the bones as if they were a crispy snack.
Instantly, he could sense her aura surging even higher.
The Supreme Ruler Grant swallowed nervously when he saw this, as a monster was growing even more terrifying right before his eyes.

One would expect the Demon Annihilation Sword to swiftly devour the whole skeleton, but surprisingly, she was taking her sweet time with it, only eating a single piece of bone at a time, as if trying to savor the moment.
While she enjoyed her snack, Yuan turned to ask the others, "Alright. What now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2434 Supreme Ruler of the Demonic Realm
paragraphs: "This didn't go how I expected, especially the fact that Owen is somehow involved," Supreme Ruler Dena said, "but with Supreme Ruler Exosso dead, all we can do is find Supreme Ruler Umbra and hope he's alive—and can explain the situation."
"Then we'll immediately head to Death Paradise," Yuan said.
"What about Bone Atoll?" Lev suddenly asked. "With their Supreme Ruler now perished, who will replace him?"

Supreme Ruler Grant then spoke, "In normal circumstances the Supreme Adviser would assume command if the Supreme Ruler died unexpectedly... unless a successor was already named. But we can assume the Supreme Adviser is dead too, and that we're likely the only ones in the Bone Atoll who know the Supreme Ruler has perished."
Supreme Ruler Dena continued, "If there's no rightful successor, anyone can claim the title. In other words, it's a free-for-all, and the strongest will become the new Supreme Ruler."
"But since nobody knows that the throne is empty..." She pointed at Gutou and said, "He can technically become the next Supreme Ruler if he desires."

Gutou shook his head vigorously and said, "Oh, no! No, no, no! As tempting as becoming the next Supreme Ruler sounds, there's no way in hell I will be able to keep the position for long! It's not like I can keep this a secret forever, either. The moment the rest of the world finds out the truth, I will become nothing but a vulnerable prey, hunted by everyone in the Bone Atoll!"
Supreme Ruler Dena shrugged and casually said, "In that case, I'll become Bone Atoll's next Supreme—"
She suddenly halted her speech and turned to look at Yuan with a profound smile on her face.
"Actually, why don't you become their next Supreme Ruler?"
"What?" Yuan pointed at himself with a dumbfounded face. "Me? Can a human even become the Supreme Ruler?"
"A human...?" Gutou stared at Yuan in shock and doubting, wondering if he'd heard correctly.
"We won't know for sure until you try. Since you can technically turn into a demon, it's worth giving it a shot."
Yuan pondered for a moment before nodding his head.
"You know what? Why not? How do I become—try to become the Supreme Ruler?" he then asked.
"You'll need to participate in the Supreme Ruler Ritual," Supreme Ruler Dena answered as she swept the entire castle with her divine sense.
"Follow me, I'll take you to the location."
Yuan nodded and began following her.
Lev and the others also followed.
Some time later they entered a spacious chamber where a large pile of bones lay arranged in a circle with a solitary bone totem rising from its center.
'Fuck... are we really going to do this?' Supreme Ruler Grant wondered inwardly.
To let a human become a Supreme Ruler would be an immense humiliation to their entire world and race, but he was in no position to protest against it.
'No... I'm sure the Demon God would not allow such a thing to happen!' He then convinced himself.
Supreme Ruler Dena proceeded to explain the process to Yuan.
"Stand in front of the altar and repeat the incantation after me."
After taking a deep breath, Supreme Ruler Dena recited the incantation aloud, "Demon God..."
Even though Supreme Ruler Dena was still reciting the incarnation, Yuan could not hear her voice, as his consciousness was no longer in the room with them.
Shortly after Yuan stood before the altar, his consciousness was summoned to a different realm, where the Demon God was present.
"What do you think you're trying to do?"
The Demon God asked Yuan.
He calmly shrugged, "Don't look at me. This wasn't even my idea. If you're not going to let me become the Supreme Ruler, then just say so and I'll be on my way."
The Demon God fell silent, almost as if wondering about it.

Soon, he spoke, "The residents of my world believe that only those chosen by me can become the Supreme Ruler. In truth, I have no control over such a thing... or rather, it would be more accurate to say that I have no desire to intervene with the world. If you want to become the Supreme Ruler, then so be it."
"Seriously?" Yuan muttered as he wore a surprised expression on his face.

Given his history with the Demon God, he never imagined he would be permitted to become a figure of absolute authority in this world. After all, it would be like allowing someone who once tried to kill you to become a general in your own army.
"Are you sure you won't regret it later?" Yuan remarked.

"Hahaha! Regret? What is there for me to regret? It's not like I am handing over my world to you! And don't think you're allowed to do anything just because you're the Supreme Ruler. If you dare try to destroy my world, I'll kill you."
Yuan raised an eyebrow and asked, "I thought you swore to never intervene with your world?"
"That rule only applies to the residents of my world. You, who came from another world, clearly doesn't belong in that category."
"What about the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, who is feasting in your seas? The same goes with the Everlasting Crimson Dragon, who is causing major disturbances in your territory?"
"Snitching on your friends, huh? I wasn't expecting this from you," the Demon God mocked.
Yuan shook his head.
"I am only using them as examples. And I already know you're allowing them to act. If not, you would've killed them long ago."
"Indeed. Not only are they aware, but they act within the laws of my world. As long as they do nothing that drastically disturbs it, I will not intervene," said the Demon God.
"What they're doing doesn't count as drastic in your eyes?" Yuan was speechless.
Then, without warning, the Demon God returned Yuan's consciousness to the Weeping Ossuary.

<You have acquired the title 'Supreme Ruler of the Demonic Realm'!>
<You have learned the skill 'Demon God's Inferior Authority'!>

sentences.text: "This didn't go how I expected, especially the fact that Owen is somehow involved," Supreme Ruler Dena said, "but with Supreme Ruler Exosso dead, all we can do is find Supreme Ruler Umbra and hope he's alive—and can explain the situation."
"Then we'll immediately head to Death Paradise," Yuan said.
"What about Bone Atoll?" Lev suddenly asked.
"With their Supreme Ruler now perished, who will replace him?"
Supreme Ruler Grant then spoke, "In normal circumstances the Supreme Adviser would assume command if the Supreme Ruler died unexpectedly... unless a successor was already named.
But we can assume the Supreme Adviser is dead too, and that we're likely the only ones in the Bone Atoll who know the Supreme Ruler has perished."
Supreme Ruler Dena continued, "If there's no rightful successor, anyone can claim the title.
In other words, it's a free-for-all, and the strongest will become the new Supreme Ruler."
"But since nobody knows that the throne is empty..." She pointed at Gutou and said, "He can technically become the next Supreme Ruler if he desires."
Gutou shook his head vigorously and said, "Oh, no!
No, no, no!
As tempting as becoming the next Supreme Ruler sounds, there's no way in hell I will be able to keep the position for long!
It's not like I can keep this a secret forever, either.
The moment the rest of the world finds out the truth, I will become nothing but a vulnerable prey, hunted by everyone in the Bone Atoll!"
Supreme Ruler Dena shrugged and casually said, "In that case, I'll become Bone Atoll's next Supreme—"
She suddenly halted her speech and turned to look at Yuan with a profound smile on her face.
"Actually, why don't you become their next Supreme Ruler?"
"What?" Yuan pointed at himself with a dumbfounded face.
"Me?
Can a human even become the Supreme Ruler?"
"A human...?" Gutou stared at Yuan in shock and doubting, wondering if he'd heard correctly.
"We won't know for sure until you try.
Since you can technically turn into a demon, it's worth giving it a shot."
Yuan pondered for a moment before nodding his head.
"You know what?
Why not?
How do I become—try to become the Supreme Ruler?" he then asked.
"You'll need to participate in the Supreme Ruler Ritual," Supreme Ruler Dena answered as she swept the entire castle with her divine sense.
"Follow me, I'll take you to the location."
Yuan nodded and began following her.
Lev and the others also followed.
Some time later they entered a spacious chamber where a large pile of bones lay arranged in a circle with a solitary bone totem rising from its center.
'Fuck... are we really going to do this?' Supreme Ruler Grant wondered inwardly.
To let a human become a Supreme Ruler would be an immense humiliation to their entire world and race, but he was in no position to protest against it.
I'm sure the Demon God would not allow such a thing to happen!' He then convinced himself.
Supreme Ruler Dena proceeded to explain the process to Yuan.
"Stand in front of the altar and repeat the incantation after me."
After taking a deep breath, Supreme Ruler Dena recited the incantation aloud, "Demon God..."
Even though Supreme Ruler Dena was still reciting the incarnation, Yuan could not hear her voice, as his consciousness was no longer in the room with them.
Shortly after Yuan stood before the altar, his consciousness was summoned to a different realm, where the Demon God was present.
"What do you think you're trying to do?"
The Demon God asked Yuan.
He calmly shrugged, "Don't look at me.
This wasn't even my idea.
If you're not going to let me become the Supreme Ruler, then just say so and I'll be on my way."
The Demon God fell silent, almost as if wondering about it.
Soon, he spoke, "The residents of my world believe that only those chosen by me can become the Supreme Ruler.
In truth, I have no control over such a thing... or rather, it would be more accurate to say that I have no desire to intervene with the world.
If you want to become the Supreme Ruler, then so be it."
"Seriously?" Yuan muttered as he wore a surprised expression on his face.
Given his history with the Demon God, he never imagined he would be permitted to become a figure of absolute authority in this world.
After all, it would be like allowing someone who once tried to kill you to become a general in your own army.
"Are you sure you won't regret it later?" Yuan remarked.
"Hahaha!
Regret?
What is there for me to regret?
It's not like I am handing over my world to you!
And don't think you're allowed to do anything just because you're the Supreme Ruler.
If you dare try to destroy my world, I'll kill you."

"That rule only applies to the residents of my world.

"Snitching on your friends, huh?

"Indeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2435 Super Bone
paragraphs: "Yuan? What's wrong?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked him when he became as still and silent as a statue even though she'd already finished reciting the incantation for the Supreme Ruler Succession Ritual.
Yuan blinked a few times before turning to look at her and responded, "Don't worry, nothing's wrong. I have already acquired the title Supreme Ruler."
"What? Really? You didn't even recite the incarnation," she remarked.
He confirmed with a slight nod, "Yes, I have even spoken with the Demon God."
"You mean you received the Demon God's message?" Supreme Ruler Grant said, not wanting to believe Yuan had a real conversation with the Demon God.
"Something like that," Yuan shrugged, not even going to bother with correcting him.
"If you've really become a Supreme Ruler, you should be able to use Power of Authority now," said Supreme Ruler Dena.
<Demon God's Inferior Authority activated>
"You mean this?" Yuan said as a crimson symbol glowed on his forehead.
"Wow... you actually became a Supreme Ruler..." Lev stared at him with a dumbstruck face.
He never expected to be in the direct presence of a Supreme Ruler, much less three at once.
'A human... being the Supreme Ruler? What has our world become?!' Supreme Ruler Grant cried inwardly.
"Now that we are done here, let's head to Death Paradise," Yuan said a moment later.
He turned to Gutou and asked, "Can you bring us to its borders?"
"I will bring you wherever you want me to, even if it's the other side of the world, esteemed Supreme Ruler!" Gutou instantly replied with a serious expression.
"Of course, I won't need a single bone from you," he added.
"Sounds good. But before we leave..."
Before they left the Weeping Ossuary, Yuan went through the entire castle to make sure they didn't leave anything behind, such as the previous Supreme Ruler's treasury.
But unsurprisingly, even after looking through every nook and cranny, he was unable to find a single treasure.
"I guess I shouldn't have expected to find anything in a place made of literally nothing but bones..." he sighed out loud once they returned to the throne room.
"That's odd," Gutou suddenly remarked.
Yuan looked at him with a raised eyebrow and asked, "Why would you say that?"
"Because Supreme Ruler Exosso wielded a famous weapon known as the Super Bone."
Yuan's expression stiffened upon hearing the name.
"Super Bone...? Who the hell gave it such a terrible name?" he asked.
"That would be the Supreme Ruler himself."
After a moment of silence, Yuan shook his head, "Regardless, it's not in the castle—"
Yuan's entire body abruptly stiffened as he sensed something amiss.
He turned to look at the throne where Supreme Ruler Exosso had perished and muttered, "That wasn't there before I became the Supreme Ruler."
"What do you see?" Lev inquired, as he was unable to sense anything himself.
Yuan activated Demon God's Inferior Authority and focused his attention on the throne.
Then, without a word, pointed at it.
A moment later, a slit opened up at the center of the seat, and the surface collapsed inward, revealing a small portal within.
"I'll be damned..." Yuan immediately thrust his arm into the portal and drew out a fist-sized piece of bone that fit his grip perfectly, as if it had been crafted for his hand.
<You have acquired 'Super Bone'>
[Super Bone]
[Grade: Celestial]
[Quality: Peak]
[Description: A treasure forged from the corpse of a Bone Leviathan, enforced with Supreme Ruler Exosso's bones."
"This is the treasure? What's a Bone Leviathan?" Yuan mumbled aloud.
"Bone Leviathan?! That's the most terrifying sea devil you can find within the Bloody Expanse! At least, within the Bone Atolls' territory." Gutou explained in a scared voice.

He continued after a brief pause, "Nobody has successfully been able to hunt a Bone Leviathan except Supreme Ruler Exosso since the beginning of time. In fact, it was such a feat that made him into the Supreme Ruler."
"Is that so?"
Yuan looked at the bone in his grasp and channeled his spiritual energy into it.
In the next instant, it began to swell and reshape, transforming into a sword.
"What's with that shape? It's supposed to be much longer," Gutou suddenly commented.
"Longer? Like a spear?"
The second Yuan imagined a spear in his mind, the Super Bone transformed again, turning into a spear.
"A shapeshifting treasure, huh? That's pretty neat. However, I have no idea what special power it contains," he said, as not even the system had much information about it.
Gutou then spoke, "I couldn't tell you, either. Nobody has actually seen the Supreme Ruler use it in action."
"I'll figure it out later," Yuan said as he tossed the treasure into his spatial ring.
"Let's go. To Death Paradise."
They left the Weeping Ossuary shortly later with Gotou guiding them.
A few years later...
"We will arrive at the Death Paradise in three months," Gutou said.
"Honestly, this is my first time being so close to Death Paradise."

"Because of the phenomenon, huh?" "We call it the Decaying Poison. It's so powerful that even the previous Supreme Ruler couldn't endure it..." After a brief pause, Gotou asked, "I must ask, how do you intend on dealing with the poison? Surely, you're not going to Death Paradise without any preparations, right?"
"That is exactly what we're doing..." Lev sighed.
Gutou came to an abrupt halt and stared at them in disbelief.
"Seriously?"
"Seriously."
"I'll figure something out," Yuan said, breaking the awkward silence.
"He'll figure something out." Supreme Ruler Dena confirmed.
Meanwhile, Supreme Ruler Grant and Lev remained silent.
"Whatever you might do... good luck..." Gutou said before resuming their journey. After all, he had no plan on entering Death Paradise with them, so it was none of his problem.
A few days later, Supreme Ruler Dena spoke out loud, "Something is coming."
"This overwhelming presence...! It can only belong to one being!" Gutou trembled at the approaching presence.
"A Bone Leviathan!" he exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2436 Death Paradise
paragraphs: "A Bone Leviathan, huh? To think we'd actually come across one," Supreme Ruler Dena calmly remarked.
"The Bone Leviathan rarely appears, and there have only been a dozen sightings since we learned of its existence!" Gutou explained, his voice edged with panic.

The only thing keeping him from fleeing was the presence of the two Supreme Rulers. If he knew Supreme Ruler Grant's true identity, he likely wouldn't be trembling at all, much like Lev, who had barely reacted to its appearance.

Moments later, the Bone Leviathan came into view. As its name suggested, it was a long, serpent-like sea devil composed entirely of bone, its form resembling an enormous human spine, each segment like a grotesque vertebra.
Seeing the Bone Leviathan, Yuan was reminded of the Flying Leviathan.
'Am I cursed to keep encountering their species or something?' he wondered inwardly.
He retrieved Number One Under Heaven and prepared to confront it, but Supreme Ruler Dena stepped forward and said, "Let me fight it."
She was curious about its strength after hearing that only Supreme Ruler Exosso had been able to slay one.
"Be my guest."
Yuan moved back, putting away his sword.
Without another word, Supreme Ruler Dena shot forward to confront the Bone Leviathan.

Seeing someone as tiny as her charge in without fear, the Bone Leviathan felt only disdain, and if it could make facial expressions, its face would surely be twisted into a mocking smile at her recklessness.
Once she was close enough, Supreme Ruler Dena's crimson hair shot forth, coiling around the Bone Leviathan and instantly sealing its movements.
Then, she began to squeeze, steadily increasing her strength.
The Bone Leviathan thrashed, trying to break free, only to be stunned when it couldn't snap even a single strand of her hair.
Minutes later, it could no longer endure the crushing force and shattered into countless fragments.

Supreme Ruler Dena gazed at the Bone Leviathan's shattered remains with a puzzled expression, then fell silent, hovering in place as though waiting for it to regenerate. However, minutes passed by without the slightest sign of recovery, and its scattered bones had already sunk out of sight into the crimson sea below.

She turned to look at Gutou with a slight frown and complained, "You call that weak thing the most terrifying sea devil in the Bone Atoll? What an exaggeration. It couldn't even withstand half of my strength."
Gutou's jaw dropped, falling so far down that it nearly touched the surface of the sea below.
"The Bone Leviathan wasn't weak! You're just absurdly powerful!" he cried out loud.
"What a disappointment," she sighed as she returned to them.
"W-What about its corpse? Its bones are priceless!" Gutou asked her without averting his gaze from the spot where the Bone Leviathan's corpse had sunk into.
"I don't care about it. You can have it if you want," she shrugged.
Without hesitation, Gutou dove into the crimson water.
Moments later, he resurfaced with the Bone Leviathan's corpse—and several sea devils clinging to him, their jaws clamped viciously into his flesh.
He would be a fool not to retrieve the Bone Leviathan's corpse, as this was only the second time one had ever been successfully hunted.
"Can I really have it?" he asked Supreme Ruler Dena in a nervous voice.
Instead of answering him, Supreme Ruler Dena turned to ask Yuan, "Do you want it?"
"Not really," he said with a slight shake of his head. "It seems like a durable material, but it's nothing to go crazy about, and I already have a treasure made from the same material."
Supreme Ruler Dena nodded before responding to Gutou, "You can keep it."
"Thank you! Thank you! Thank you!" Gutou repeated these two words a dozen times like a broken record.
They resumed their journey shortly later, and a few months later, they arrived at their destination.
"We've arrived," Gutou said as he came to a complete halt, his gaze staring toward the horizon, where it looked like night had fallen.
Meanwhile, at the Bone Atolls and even on the Crimson Continent, the sky remained crimson even at night, only getting slightly darker at night.
"I'm getting chills just looking at it," Lev remarked as his body literally trembled uncontrollably.
"Let me take a look at it first," said Yuan. "The rest of you stay here until I figure out the situation and whether I can safely bring you guys with me."
"I know you're human, but what if it's also poisonous for you?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked with a slightly worried face.
He smiled and calmly replied, "I am immune to poison, so even if it's poison, I will be fine."
Without another word, he left them to approach Death Paradise.
"I'll come with you," said the Demon Annihilation Sword.
Knowing that she was a treasure and not truly living, Yuan had no objections and allowed her to follow him into the Death Paradise.
Soon, Yuan arrived at the border, being only a few inches away from Death Paradise.
"Let's see what we have here..."
He extended his arm, pushing it into Death Paradise's territory.
Instantly, Yuan could feel a numbing sensation.
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has activated>
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has begun to refine 'Demon God's Ordeal'>
Yuan raised his eyebrows at the notification.
'Demon God's Ordeal? It's not a natural phenomenon?' he thought to himself.
<Eternal Constituion(Incomplete) has refined 'Demon Godms Ordeal'>
<Your Demonic Awakening has strengthened!>
Just by staying inside Death Paradise for a few minutes, Yuan's Demonic Awakening improved.
He turned to the Demon Annihilation Sword and asked her, "Do you feel anything?"
"No," she replied as she continued chewing on Supreme Ruler Exosso's bones.
"You're really taking your time with those bones, huh? How much do you have left?" Yuan asked.
The Demon Annihilation Sword showed him the rest of her supply—a single index finger.
"Go tell the others that I will be staying here for a few days to see if anything else happens," he then said.
She nodded before flying back to the group.

chapters.title: Chapter 2437 A Small Experiment
paragraphs: "My master said he'll be staying in there for a few days to test the waters," said the Demon Annihilation Sword the moment she returned to the others.
Gutou then spoke, "Umm... do you still need me? If not, I'll return home."
Lev then said, "Why don't you wait for Yuan to return before leaving? Don't worry, we won't tell you to come into Death Paradise with us."

Gutou nodded, and they patiently waited for Yuan to return. In the meantime, they fought off the Sea Devils that attacked them. Or more specifically, Lev dealt with the Sea Devils while the others watched.
Of course, nobody asked him to be the guard, but he didn't want to feel like pointless luggage and volunteered to fight.
As for the Sea Devils that he couldn't deal with, Gutou would help out, as he was a True God.
One might assume that remaining within the water would shield the Sea Devils from the Demon God's Ordeal, but even they were not spared from the phenomenon.
Fortunately, very few Sea Devils dared to venture so close to Death Paradise, and they would only encounter two to three of them a day.
Meanwhile, Yuan continued to strengthen his Demonic Awakening through Demon God's Ordeal. Of course, he wasn't completely focused on cultivation and also tried to understand it.
'The Demon God's Ordeal... it completely kills one's blood. No wonder it's so deadly to demons...'
Yuan finally understood why demons couldn't survive it despite their regeneration, as this phenomenon directly seals their power.
Although it may seem as though demons possess limitless blood, in reality, they are merely duplicating it, and their bodies generate new blood at a rate several times faster than that of humans.

Their blood also possesses an innate self-duplication ability, automatically replicating when it senses imminent destruction, almost like a passive skill. Because of this, attempting to destroy it is futile unless one can annihilate every last trace of their blood in an instant, or seal their passive skill, exactly what the Demon God's Ordeal does.
As for why Yuan wasn't being affected... In truth, the phenomenon definitely affected him, so it was constantly destroying his blood.
However, Yuan's regeneration was not ordinary, and after achieving Transcended Renewal, it was able to bypass even Demon God's Ordeal.
'In a sense, this power is similar to Demon Sealing Aura, but instead of sealing their blood, it directly destroys them.'
Suddenly, Yuan suddenly felt lighter, as if his mind was ascending, and a second later, he entered a trance-like state... or what cultivators called enlightenment.
As the creator of Demon Sealing Aura, nobody in this world understood such powers better than him.
A few days later—
<Your understanding of Demon Sealing Aura has transcended>
Yuan opened his eyes, and a profound light flickered within.
He unleashed some of his Demon Sealing Aura, and the same energy coming from Demon God's Ordeal emanated from it.
"With this power, I no longer need to completely overwhelm the demons or use Eternal Essence to kill them..." he muttered with a smile on his face.

Although Yuan wanted to cultivate his Demonic Awakening more, the process was painfully slow, and he anticipated that he'd need to cultivate hundreds of years before he would see any real improvement.
Thus, he decided to leave for now and return to the others.
"How was it?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked when Yuan returned to them.
He proceeded to explain his discovery with them.
"The phenomenon is not natural but caused by the Demon God?!" Suprem Ruler Grant cried out loud, his voice full of disbelief.
"That's impossible! Why would the Demon God create something harmful to his own creation and put it here?!"
Yuan shrugged, "How would I know? If you're curious, you should ask the Demon God himself."
"I...!" Supreme Ruler Grant immediately fell silent.
"So, do you think we will be able to follow you into Death Paradise? Or is it impossible after all?" Lev suddenly asked.

Yuan pondered for a moment before responding, "Although the poison is strong, it won't immediately kill you. At your level, you'll be dead in a few weeks. At Dena and Grant's level, they will definitely be able to survive long enough for us to do whatever we need to do.
"So I have to stay behind, huh?" Lev sighed, looking disappointed that he couldn't follow them into Death Paradise, unaware that he no longer feared danger, even welcoming it.
"You are more than welcomed to stay at my island until they return," Gutou suddenly offered Lev a place to stay.
Lev nodded, "Thanks. I'll do just that then."
However, Yuan said a second later, "I might be able to shield you from the poison."
"Really?!" Lev's eyes immediately started glowing with hope.
"Come with me. I want to test it out first."
Lev nodded and eagerly followed Yuan into Death Paradise to participate in his experiment.
"So this is Death Paradise, huh? I never even imagined myself being anywhere near this place, yet here I am..." Lev muttered.
"How does it feel?" Yuan asked him.
"Well, I can feel myself slowly dying, if that's what you meant," he responded in a somewhat joking tone.
"Let's wait a few days before we start the experiment."
"Alright."
Yuan proceeded to spend an entire week examining Lev's condition, watching his health deteriorating at a rapid rate.
"This is my first time seeing a demon looking sick," Yuan remarked. "How are you feeling now?"
"Like shit," Lev sighed. "I feel incredibly weak and sluggish, as if I am wearing mountains as a vest. Are we going to wait longer before you do anything?"
"No, we can begin now."
Yuan placed a hand on Lev's shoulder and closed his eyes.
"I am going to seal your blood now," he said.
"Wait, what are you—?"
Before Lev could even finish his sentence, Yuan used Demon Sealing Aura on his blood.
Lev's entire body stiffened, feeling like he'd turned into a statue without actually turning into stone.
After sealing Lev's blood, Yuan spent the next few minutes analyzing it.
"Looks like sealing your blood won't stop it from being destroyed by the poison..."
Yuan unsealed his blood and tried something else, encasing Lev in the Demon Sealing Zone.
Unfortunately, that did not work, either.
A few days and multiple more experiments later—

"Looks like it's impossible to stop the poison from destroying your blood." "I guess it's impossible for me to follow you into Death Paradise, after all." Lev shook his head with a bitter smile. "Well, it's not like it's a life or death situation, so I don't have to follow you. Just remember to pick me up after you're done."
Yuan narrowed his eyes and said, "Actually, I have one more method, but it might be a little crazy."
"What do you have in mind?" Lev asked, his interest piqued.
"If we cannot stop your blood from being destroyed, we can replenish it... with my blood.
"What?!" Lev cried out loud.
"However, I must warn you that I cannot guarantee it will succeed. Hell, it might even kill you. I am making this suggestion purely because of my own curiosity," he admitted.
Lev swallowed nervously and fell silent.
Eventually, he responded with an excited smile, "I want to try it, even if it might kill me!"
"Risking your life just to follow us when you don't need to. You'be become bold, Lev. Reckless, even."
"Considering what I have experienced with you, it's only normal. Also, I learned from the best."
Yuan chuckled.
"Then let's begin."
The next moment, Yuan pointed a finger at Lev and created a ball of blood on his fingertip.
"Ready?"
"Ready!"
Yuan unleashed his blood, shooting it directly at Lev.
Once it penetrated his flesh and entered his body, Yuan used Blood Manipulation to spread it throughout his veins and the rest of his body.
Lev clenched his teeth as veins bulged throughout his entire being, looking like he was experiencing cramps in every inch of his body.
"Ahhh!" Lev released a defeaning roar, but it wasn't from pain.
Rather, he was feeling the opposite of pain as an overwhelming amount of energy that he has never felt before surges within him.
"What unfathomable prowess! I have never felt this powerful before!" Lev laughed out loud.
Suddenly, his appearance began to change, and his crimson skin and hair slowly turned as white as a piece of white paper.
"What the...?" Yuan watched Lev transform with wide eyes.
Ding!
Suddenly, a notification appeared before him.
<'Lev' has evolved after receiving your blood!>
<'Lev' has accepted your blood!>
<You have turned 'Lev' into a Demonic Servant!>
<You can now transfer your blood to your Demonic Servants indirectly, granting them incredible power briefly!>
Yuan wore a shocked expression after realizing he had inadvertently turned Lev into his servant.

However, he was the only one surprised by this outcome. Lev had already known this would happen the moment he accepted Yuan's blood. In fact, within the Demonic Realm, it was common knowledge that when a demon consumed a significant amount of another's blood, it was tantamount to pledging servitude to them.
Such an act was known as a ritual—the Blood Servant Pact—and because it was rarely performed, Yuan had never heard of it.
He hadn't even considered the possibility of turning Lev into a servant, especially since he had given Supreme Ruler Dena far more of his blood without any such outcome.
Of course, consuming someone's blood and directly accepting it into one's body were entirely different matters, but such minor detail tends to be overlooked.

chapters.title: Chapter 2438 Demonic Servant
paragraphs: "I wasn't expecting much when I accepted your blood, but to think it would evolve my bloodline and boost my power this much!" Lev laughed out loud, his cultivation now at the 4th level False God after accepting Yuan's blood.
Yuan looked at him with a raised eyebrow and remarked, "You're awfully excited for someone who just turned into a servant."
"Is it so weird? I agreed to be your servant without any guarantees, you know?" He replied.
"Huh? You knew you'd become my servant after accepting my blood?"
"Why do you look so puzzled? Don't tell me you gave me your blood without knowing about this?" Lev stared at him with a dumbfounded face.
Yuan nodded and admitted, "I won't lie. I had no idea it'd turn you into my servant."
"Oh..." Lev immediately lowered his head, looking disappointed.
"So you wouldn't have given me your blood if you knew? I mean, I knew it was too good to be true—that someone as powerful as you would ask a nobody like me to be your servant."
Yuan shook his head and said, "That's not it. I would've asked you properly if I knew."
"You mean you don't mind having a coward like me as your servant?" Lev's eyes widened, looking somewhat dazed.
"Although you were definitely one when we first met, you've changed a lot."
"But we've just met..."
In Lev's eyes, even spending a few decades together was no different than meeting only a few days ago.
"It may seem short to you, but in my eyes, we've known each other long enough. If you don't want to be my servant, just say so, and I'll release you... if that's even possible."
"No way!" Lev hastily shook his head in response, even distancing himself from Yuan. "Please allow me to be your servant! I promise I will not disappoint you!"
Yuan nodded and said, "I can keep giving you my blood indefinitely as long as you are my servant, so you'll be able to traverse Death Paradise without any issues."
Some time later, they returned to the others.
"What's with that appearance?" Supreme Ruler Dena immediately inquired about Lev's transformation.

Lev rubbed his nose in a prideful manner and opened his mouth, but before he could speak, Supreme Ruler Dena approached him and remarked while sniffing the air around him, "Why do you smell like Yuan?"
"I accepted his blood and performed the Blood Servant Pact, which resulted in my bloodline growing stronger and my evolution," Lev explained.
Supreme Ruler Dena stared at him with a stunned expression on her face, as did Gutou and Supreme Ruler Grant.
"You... performed the Blood Servant Pact with Yuan...?" Supreme Ruler Dena mumbled in a low voice, sounding a little in disbelief.
"Give me some of your blood," Supreme Ruler Grant suddenly said.
"What? Why?"
"I want to examine it."
Lev looked at Yuan for his permission, who responded with a nonchalant shrug, basically saying he doesn't care.
Lev proceeded to give a drop of his blood to Supreme Ruler Grant.
"What the hell is this?! Your bloodline is comparable to a noble!" Supreme Ruler Grant exclaimed in shock a moment later.
"What?!" Lev cried out loud after hearing this, looking just as shocked as Supreme Ruler Grant, if not even more.
In the Demonic Realm, having a noble-grade bloodline was akin to being a Demon Emperor in the Nine Heavens, with Supreme Rulers being Ancient Demons.
"But I was born with an ordinary bloodline..." Lev swallowed nervously.

Lev was born as a Lower Demon, the lowest ranking demon. However, his bloodline evolved and is now comparable to a Demon Emperor after accepting Yuan's blood. This much growth was unprecedented. "For your bloodline to have advanced this much... it's honestly terrifying." Supreme Ruler Grant turned to Yuan, his gaze filled with dread.

Yuan could now, in essence, create as many Demon Emperors as he wished simply by sharing his blood. With such power, he could effortlessly raise an army of Demon Emperors and seize dominion over the entire Demonic Realm.
Meanwhile, a very different thought flashed through Supreme Ruler Dena's mind as she wondered what might happen if someone like her—a Supreme Ruler—were to accept his blood.

When Yuan saw Supreme Ruler Grant's worried face, he smiled and said, "I know what you're thinking. However, I have no interest in raising an army of demons. That being said, if you piss me off, I might do it just to spite you."
Supreme Ruler Grant trembled at such words, and he quietly swore inwardly that he'd never offend Yuan.
"Um... may I shamelessly ask if I can also be your servant?" Gutou suddenly asked with an awkward smile on his face.
Yuan looked at him and said, "I'll think about it."
"Thank you!" Gutou immediately bowed.
"What about me?" Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly asked.
"What? You must be joking," Yuan said.
However, when he turned and saw her serious face, he immediately became perplexed.
"I am not joking," she calmly said.
"You're a Supreme Ruler, you know? And I know you're not the type of person who'd willingly lower your head to another, regardless of their identity."

Supreme Ruler Dena shook her head and replied, "I don't know where you got that information since I have never said such a thing. While it's true that I have never once considered being beneath someone, it's simply because there is nobody even close to being worthy of my admiration."

"In fact, you're the first person to ever earn my admiration and respect, and that was ages ago when you were Tian Chenyu. If it's you right now, I don't mind lowering my head for you, not to mention how much stronger you'll get in the future."
Everyone there stared at Supreme Ruler Dena with their mouths agape, as they've never thought she was capable of uttering such words.
After a long moment of silence, Yuan cleared his throat and spoke in a stiff voice, "I will... think about it."

chapters.title: Chapter 2439 Entering Death Paradise
paragraphs: 'He'll think about it?! That's insane!'
Everyone there turned to look at Yuan with wide eyes, clearly in disbelief by his response.
If someone as powerful as Supreme Ruler Dena offered to be their servant, they'd accept in a heartbeat. Yet, for some reason, Yuan did not do such a thing, even saying he'd only consider it.
However, due to personal reasons, none of them said anything.

Supreme Ruler Grant didn't want Yuan to become even more ridiculous with Supreme Ruler Dena at his beckoning, while Lev wanted to enjoy being Yuan's only servant for a little longer, Moreover, he'd immediately be outranked by her.
"Fine..." Supreme Ruler Dena responded in a somewhat disappointed tone.
"Anyway, let's talk about how we're going to find Supreme Ruler Umbra before we enter Death Paradise," Yuan then said.
"Don't look at me because I have never been to Death Paradise," Supreme Ruler Grant said.

Supreme Ruler Dena then spoke, "I have briefly visited Death Paradise several times out of curiosity, but I have not once encountered a single individual during my visits. I have met Supreme Ruler Umbra a few times, but it was always at the tripoint like Supreme Ruler Grant."
"You've not met a single individual? Just how small is their population?" Yuan remarked with a pondering expression.
Gutou then spoke, "This is just a rumor, but I've heard that it's likely there are fewer than a hundred people living in Death Paradise."
"If we consider their environment, it's not surprising they have so few people," Lev said.
"So what should we do? Wander Death Paradise until we hopefully encounter someone?" he then asked.
"That could take forever," Supreme Ruler Grant said. "And we don't have unlimited time in that place."
Yuan pondered for a moment before retrieving a certain scale from his spatial ring and speaking into it.
"Hey, you got some free time?"
Not even three seconds later, a familiar figure emerged from the sea surface to greet him.
"Have you already got someone you want me to kill?" Primal Sovereign of the Seas asked after answering Yuan's summoning.
"Nope," Yuan immediately shook his head. "I was just wondering if you can find someone for me. I'm looking for the Supreme Ruler of Death Paradise."
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas stared at Yuan with a dumbfounded face for a moment before responding, "Do I look like a freaking search dog to you?!"
Yuan silently shrugged, not willing to respond to his question.

"I gave you that scale so you could give me a target, not so you could summon me on a whim and order me around like a servant..." the Primal Sovereign of the Seas sighed. Despite its irritable tone, it wasn't truly enraged.

The Primal Sovereign of the Seas' body visibly stiffened at Yuan's words.
"Your blood...?" It muttered in a low voice, unable to hide the smile that was slowly creeping onto its round face.

When the Primal Sovereign of the Seas realized it was smiling, it quickly adjusted its expression to become nonchalant and spoke, "I have just scanned the entire sea within Death Paradise, but I was unable to find the individual you're looking for. After all, I can only sense what's within or touching my water. Even if they're an inch away from the surface of the sea, I won't be able to sense them."
After a brief pause, it continued, "With that being said, I was able to sense someone. This individual appears to be cultivating on a pond six million, nine thousand, and fifty miles north of here."
"That's good enough," Yuan said as he drew out three drops of his blood and offered them to the Primal Sovereign of the Seas.
"That's it? Three measly drops? Do you not see how magnificently vast this majesty is? How could I possibly be satisfied with so little?" The Primal Sovereign of the Seas shook its head.
"If you expect me to give you blood in proportion to your size, you might as well devour me whole," Yuan sighed. "Three drops. Take it or leave it.
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas snickered before somewhat begrudgingly accepting Yuan's stingy offer.
Of course, it wasted no time and immediately consumed all three drops of blood at once.
"Th-This taste is...!" The Primal Sovereign of the Seas trembled, its eyes widening in shock and disbelief. Then, its massive body collapsed into the sea.
Moments later, it resurfaced while shouting, "How magnificent! Utterly sublime! I have never savored anything so exquisite in all my existence!"
It fixed Yuan with a ravenous gaze and muttered, "I can't help but wonder how much better it would taste if you'd given me several more drops..."
Yuan shook his head, then revealed a detail that left the Primal Sovereign of the Seas utterly speechless and deeply regretful.

"The taste won't change even if I gave you a mouthful. In fact, a single drop would have given you the same experience, so you basically wasted two, as you could've stretched them into three separate meals."
"No way!!!" The Primal Sovereign of the Seas screamed in agony as it toppled back into the water, sending massive tsunamis surging in all directions.
A moment later, its eyes slowly peeked out of the water as it mumbled, "Would you be so kind as to give me two more—no... just another drop of blood?"
Yuan smiled inwardly after seeing the Primal Sovereign of the Seas getting addicted to his blood, as he could use this to his advantage in the future.
"Sorry, but I'm tired now. Maybe later," he said, pretending to look exhausted.

The Primal Sovereign of the Seas instantly realized what Yuan was doing and sighed, "Fine. If you ever need my help again, don't hesitate to contact me. However, besides that one favor I owe you, I won't become your personal assassin, so don't even consider it."
"I'll keep that in mind," Yuan replied with a smile.
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas didn't say anything else and silently disappeared into the crimson sea again.
Some time later, Yuan and the others entered Death Paradise, following the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' direction to the unknown individual it sensed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2440 Demon of Death Paradise
paragraphs: "W-Wait!" Gutou suddenly called out to them right as they started leaving.
"What about me? Do I have to enter Death Paradise with you?"
Yuan shook his head and said, "Your job has ended the moment you led us here. You can return home now. Thanks for your help."
"I see..." Gutou nodded, and after a moment of silence, turned around and flew away, sighing inwardly that they didn't even attempt to ask him to follow them.
Time passed swiftly, and after traveling for six million miles with Void Manipulation, Yuan and the others slowed to a halt when they sensed an unfathomably powerful aura in the distance.
They were still in the Bloody Expanse, surrounded by crimson water and a night sky.
"What a powerful presence!" Supreme Ruler Grant was the first to comment on it.
Even though this aura clearly belonged to an Absolute God like him, its presence was several times stronger than his own.
"I may be wrong, but this individual seems to be on par... if not even stronger than her..." Lev spoke in a nervous voice as his gaze pointed at Supreme Ruler Dena, who remained as calm as ever.
"How should we approach them?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked.
However, before she could receive a response, the overwhelming aura vanished into thin air, and the presence completely disappeared half a second later.
After a moment of silence, an unfamiliar voice resounded right behind them.
"Three who bear the Demon God's Authority, a tool, and one insignificant being," the voice remarked, its tone laced with intrigue. "What an odd gathering."
Supreme Ruler Grant and Lev were startled by the voice and hastily flew away while Yuan, Supreme Ruler Dena, and the Demon Annihilation Sword calmly turned around to face the voice.

Hovering just behind them was a tall, strikingly beautiful woman with a bountiful figure and ghostly pale complexion. Her pitch-black hair flowed freely behind her, and her eyes—dark as abyssal depths—lacked both emotion and light, like twin black holes that swallowed all they beheld.
Though she appeared human, there was something about her presence that clearly transcended one.
"We're here to speak with Supreme Ruler Umbra, do you know where we can find him?" Yuan asked her.
The woman's void-like eyes shifted to Yuan, and a small smile tugged at her lips as she responded, "Are you human? One that isn't from this world."
Yuan was not surprised by her question and calmly replied, "Yes, I am."
The woman closed her eyes and released a low sigh, "How long has it been since I last saw a human? Ever since the Great Cataclysm, I suppose."
"The Great Cataclysm?" Yuan raised an eyebrow at this unfamiliar term.
He turned to Supreme Ruler Dena, only to find her equally unresponsive to the term, suggesting she had no idea what it meant either.
"What is the Great Cataclysm?" Yuan decided to ask the woman.
The woman remained silent for a moment before speaking, "It's been so long since I've had visitors... it would be a shame if you left so soon."
Hearing such ominous words, Yuan prepared to enter battle at any second.
However, the woman continued, "Let's play a game. If you win, I'll tell you everything you wish to know—including Umbra's whereabouts."
"And if you win?" Yuan asked.
"If I win...
She slowly raised a finger and pointed it at him.
"You will remain here... and accompany me for eternity."
Yuan raised an eyebrow. "That hardly seems fair. If we win, you merely answer a few questions. But if we lose, I forfeit my freedom—my life—to you?"
"So what?" the woman replied indifferently. "The strong dictate the rules."
"I admit that you're pretty strong, but we won't know—"
Supreme Ruler Dena opened her mouth to speak, but before she could even finish her sentence, the woman unleashed her aura again.
An unfathomable pressure instantly enveloped their area—one that was several times stronger than what they sensed before.
"This is insane!" Lev cried out loud. Although he had been uncertain whether the woman surpassed Supreme Ruler Dena in strength, that doubt had now completely vanished, and he was certain she did.

"For an incomplete being to reach your level of strength is indeed impressive," the woman said calmly. "However... even if you spent your entire life trying, you would never come close to touching my shadow."
"An incomplete being...?" Supreme Ruler Dena frowned at the woman's choice of words, wondering why she used such a term.
"You know nothing despite carrying the Demon God's Authority? Well, I can't blame you for the Demon God's incompetence."
Supreme Ruler Grant's eyes widened with shock when he heard the woman openly scoff at the Demon God, something that was unthinkable in the Crimson Continent.
"To call the Demon God incompetent... that's blasphemous!" Supreme Ruler Grant subconsciously shouted.
"Hm?" The woman shifted her attention to him.
Suddenly, she vanished without a trace, only to reappear directly before Supreme Ruler Grant.

"You should consider yourselves fortunate," she said calmly, her gaze cold. "Had you encountered the others instead of me, they would have torn you apart without a word for being the Demon God's dog."
"Demon God's dog? We're Supreme Rulers!"
"What's the difference?" The woman shrugged.
"But you also have a Supreme Ruler. Umbra." Yuan suddenly pointed out.
The woman looked at him and smiled, "Enough with the chatter. If you want me to answer any questions, you will need to win my game."
"And if we refuse to play?"
"Then I'll kill all of you," she calmly said.

Despite the woman's arrogant claim, Yuan couldn't say with certainty that he could defeat her. Her aura was simply that overwhelming—perhaps even on par with the Dragon God's eldest daughter at her full strength.
However, even if he could defeat her, it would likely take all his effort and a tremendous amount of time.
In such a situation, he'd rather avoid an unnecessary fight and see what kind of game she wanted to play.
"Alright. What is this game that you want to play?" Yuan asked.
The woman then said, "You will have to choose one person out of your group to participate. For the game itself... you simply need to endure a trial."
"I will do it," Yuan said without hesitation.
However, the woman slowly shook her head and said, "No, this trial won't work on you or that tool. The participant must be originally from this world."
Yuan frowned at her words.
"You're telling me that I cannot participate in a game where my own life is at stake? This is beyond unreasonable."
"What other choice do you have?" The woman chuckled, clearly proud of herself.
Yuan sighed but said nothing.

Although the situation appeared unfavorable, it wasn't truly dire. Even if they lost the game, he had no intention of remaining in Death Paradise for the rest of his life, and if they proved unable to defeat this woman, he could always call in the favor owed to him by the Primal Sovereign of the Seas.

"What does the trial entail?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked. The woman suddenly swept her slender arm through the air, and at her gesture, the air—or more precisely—the poison within it, surged toward her.
Everyone stared in bewilderment, as none of them had expected her to be able to manipulate the poison itself.
"The participant must accept this and survive. Quite the simple game, right?"

"How is that a game?" Yuan said as he stared at the overwhelming amount of Demon God's Ordeal gathered around the woman with a deep frown on his face. "You're basically just asking one of them to die."
"Anything can be a game if you put your mind to it," she calmly replied. "That being said, if they survive this game, they will be greatly rewarded."
'Rewarded...?' Yuan thought to himself.
"Um... I can participate."
Lev suddenly spoke aloud.
Yuan turned to look at him and asked, "You'll die, you know? This is nothing more than a death sentence."

"That's precisely why I am stepping up. If anyone has to be sacrificed here, it should be me. It's a pity since my life had just changed for the better," Lev responded with a bitter smile on his face.
"Or, we can just make him do it." Supreme Ruler Dena said while pointing at Supreme Ruler Grant.
"What?! I am not going to sacrifice myself for you, even if you kill me!" he cried out loud.
"I am just joking," Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly said, dumbfounding them.
With a slight turn of her head, she looked at Yuan and continued, "Let me do it."
"But—"
"I have no intention of sacrificing myself," she interrupted Yuan, who had just opened his mouth.
"Since your life is on the line, I can't entrust it to anyone else. Moreover, out of everyone here, I have the highest chance of surviving that much poison."
Yuan fell silent at her logical reasoning.

'There's no need to risk your life like this. Let's fight her. If we cannot defeat her, we can just have the Primal Sovereign of the Seas to kill her for us,' Yuan then said to her through voice transmission.

However, Supreme Ruler Dena shook her head and replied, 'I am not only doing this for you. That woman looked down on me—belittled me. I will win this stupid game of hers and make her swallow her own words.'
After a moment of silence, Yuan turned to ask the woman, "She will participate, but before we begin, can you give us some time to prepare for the game?"
"Since it will prolong your presence here, I will allow it," she calmly nodded.
The next moment, Yuan approached Supreme Ruler Dena and extended an arm toward her.
"Will you accept my blood?" he asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 2441 True Origin of Demons
paragraphs: Supreme Ruler Dena stared at Yuan, her eyes widening in surprise. Though she had offered to become his servant of her own accord not long ago, being asked by him now felt entirely different.
She opened her mouth only to close it without a response, repeating this several times, as if dumbstruck by it.
Supreme Ruler Grant and Lev stared at her with puzzled faces, wondering why she was suddenly hesitant on accepting Yuan's blood when she'd asked for it recently.

After a moment of silence, Supreme Ruler Dena closed her eyes and sighed, "If I am going to prove myself, I must do it alone, or it'd be pointless. I also don't want to hear any excuses from her later, so I cannot accept your blood now."
Yuan fell silent for a brief moment before a small smile tugged at his lips.
"For some reason, I knew you'd say something like that," he said, not surprised by her rejection in the slightest.
"Although it's a reckless—even foolish thing to do, I respect your resolution."
Supreme Ruler Dena silently nodded before turning to the woman.
"I am ready to play your game," she said.
"Good luck, little girl."
The woman extended her arm toward Supreme Ruler Dena, and at her command, the overwhelming mass of poison surged forth, instantly engulfing her petite figure.
"Ahh!"

Supreme Ruler Dena immediately screamed in agony. While the poison normally caused no pain when absorbed gradually, this was an entirely different matter, as she had just been forced to endure over a thousand years' worth of the Demon God's Ordeal in a single instant.
For Lev, who could only survive a few weeks in Death Paradise before his evolution, this amount would've instantly killed him... thousands of times, at that.
As for Supreme Ruler Grant, who could easily survive a few hundred years, it would also instantly kill him over a dozen times at once.
Supreme Ruler Dena's screaming lasted only a few seconds before she fell silent, as if she'd perished.
"Did she die already?" The woman wondered aloud in a somewhat disappointed voice. "I had a little expectation for her, considering her talents as an incomplete being.
Soon, the last traces of condensed poison vanished into Supreme Ruler Dena's body.
Her body went limp, and she began to fall from the sky like a lifeless doll.
Seeing this, Yuan went to catch her body.
Upon examining her body, he was relieved to know that she was still alive. However, the poison also hadn't been fully consumed, so her life was still in danger.
"She's still alive? I guess I had underestimated her a little," the woman suddenly remarked. "But let's see if she can make it to the end."
"Why are you calling her incomplete?" Yuan asked her.
The woman stared at him in silence for a brief moment before responding, "I guess I can entertain you for a bit since you'll be staying with me for an eternity soon."
Then, she continued, "The vast majority of people in this world haven't yet fully completed their transformation, hence why they are incomplete."
"And judging by your sense of superiority, I can assume that you are a complete demon, right?" Yuan asked.
The woman offered a silent smile.
Yuan suddenly recalled his encounter with Demon Emperor Carnage, along with the mention of the so-called 'Ancients.'
Demon Emperors had once been believed to stand at the pinnacle of their race, yet that was far from the truth. Above them existed the Ancient Demons, known in the Demonic Realm as Supreme Rulers.
However, even they were not the true apex. Beyond them were the Ancients—beings fundamentally different in nature, and the undisputed peak of the demon race.
Even Supreme Ruler Dena, who was hailed as the strongest demon in history, wouldn't be able to hold a candle to a true Ancient.
"Are you what they call an 'Ancient'?"
Wanting confirmation, Yuan asked the woman.
"Is that what they call us these days?" The woman responded with nonchalance. "We were once known as Transcendents, perfect beings who have passed God's trial."
"God's trial? Are you referring to the Demon God?"
"That's right," she replied. "That unhinged god who is the only being above us Transcendents—and the one who brought about the Great Cataclysm."
Unmasked hatred and rage flashed within the woman's eyes as she mentioned the Demon God and the Great Cataclysm.
"What is the difference between a demon and a Transcendent? Aren't you just a demon with a stronger bloodline?"
"Hahaha!"
The woman suddenly burst into uncontrollable laughter, her voice echoing wildly as if she had just heard the most absurd joke.
"Just a demon with a stronger bloodline? You really know nothing about this world, huh? Well, I can't really blame you since most people in this world don't know their own origins, either."
The woman stopped laughing and stared at Yuan with a serious expression.
"Listen carefully, human from another world," she said, her voice turning cold and grim. "I am nothing like a demon."
"Demons are merely humans who failed to ascend—imperfect beings, incomplete... failures."
An arrogant smile touched her lips as she continued, "I, on the other hand, am still human—one who surpassed humanity itself. I am a transcendent... a perfect human!"

Yuan's eyes widened at the revelation that demons were originally human. However, it wasn't entirely unexpected. As he'd come to understand them more, he had noticed subtle hints, such as their humanoid forms, and how those with purer bloodlines bore an even closer resemblance, some nearly indistinguishable from humans.
"Then—"
Just as Yuan opened his mouth to speak, Supreme Ruler Dena, who had remained as still as a corpse, suddenly jolted awake.
A violent surge of power erupted from her body, unleashing a shockwave that blew Yuan away.
"Oh?"
The woman muttered under her breath, her gaze sharpening as it settled on Supreme Ruler Dena, who hovered just slightly above the sea surface, her face devoid of all expression.
However, the woman frowned a moment later.
"Something isn't right..." she mumbled.

sentences.text: Supreme Ruler Dena stared at Yuan, her eyes widening in surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 2442 The Great Cataclysm
paragraphs: "Something is wrong? What is wrong with her?" Yuan questioned with a frown after hearing the woman's ominous words.

The woman narrowed her eyes and replied in a puzzled tone, "As I explained earlier, demons are humans who failed to ascend in the past, and every human born afterward also becomes a demon, as that lineage now flows through their blood. However, it is possible for later generations of demons to ascend if they consume, and survive, the Demon God's Ordeal."

"With that being said, success is exceedingly rare, and pretty much everyone just dies. These days, no one even dares to attempt it, given how many have perished. In time, the Demon God's Ordeal's true purpose was forgotten, its name reduced to that of a deadly phenomenon that simply slaughters demons."

"As for that little girl... she consumed enough Demon God's Ordeal to ascend. At least, that was how much I had to endure to become a transcendent. But despite enduring all of it, she hasn't transcended yet."
"What does this mean?" Yuan asked.
"This is my first time seeing this, but if we think logically, it simply means that she needs to consume even more of Demon God's Ordeal!"
With an intrigued smile on her face, the woman suddenly waved her arm, sending even more Demon God's Ordeal toward Supreme Ruler Dena.
"Let's see how much she'll need to transcend... or die!" she laughed madly.
However, Yuan suddenly moved in front of Supreme Ruler Dena, blocking her from the Demon God's Ordeal and absorbing it himself.
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has activated!>
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has refined Demon God's Ordeal!>
<Your Demonic Awakening has improved tremendously!>
"What do you think you're doing?" The woman frowned at his unexpected actions.
"I should be saying that to you," Yuan calmly replied. "Since she endured the Demon God's Ordeal and survived, she's already won your game, regardless if she's ascended or not."

The woman silently glared at him for a moment before speaking again. "You're right. She has technically won the game, and I'm not denying her victory. However, now that her ascension has begun, it cannot be halted. Otherwise, she'll become a Forsaken or die, so we have no choice but to see it through to the end."

Without another word, the woman gathered even more of the Demon God's Ordeal and forced it into Supreme Ruler Dena. This time, Yuan did not stop her and silently watched her small body become enveloped by it again.
"Ahhh!" Supreme Ruler Dena began screaming again, her voice raw with agony.
However, unlike before, she didn't stop screaming.
The woman also continued to pour Demon God's Ordeal into Supreme Ruler Dena's body without stopping.
"What's going on? She's absorbing the Demon God's Ordeal like crazy!" The woman exclaimed with an excited expression on her face.
Yuan and the others watched with clenched fists and wide eyes, each second stretching into an eternity.
One minute... three minutes... six minutes...
After ten full minutes of enduring the Demon God's Ordeal, an unfathomable aura suddenly erupted from Supreme Ruler Dena's body, sending a powerful ripple sweeping across the entire Demonic Realm.
Seeing this, the woman immediately froze and turned her full attention to Supreme Ruler Dena, swallowing nervously in anticipation.
"How many years of Demon God's Ordeal did she endure? A hundred thousand years? No, it has to be much more than that!" she muttered in a dazed voice, quietly comparing herself.

Moments after Supreme Ruler Dena's aura erupted, her hair began to writhe with a life of its own, coiling around her body and wrapping her in a cocoon that was similar to what Yuan saw before she was woken up by him in the Deprived Crimson Valley.
Time passed quickly, yet even after many minutes there was no change in the cocoon, nor any sign that she would be emerging anytime soon.
"What's happening? Has she succeeded in her ascension?" Yuan asked the woman.
"No, but she's in the final stage. Once she emerges—if she does—she'll become a transcendent," she replied.
"How long will it take?"
"Hard to say," she shrugged. "But it took me several million years."
"That long?!" Yuan exclaimed after hearing this.
"In the meantime, you can ask me your questions," the woman suddenly said. "..."
Yuan decided to set Supreme Ruler Dena's situation aside for now and focus on wringing every last bit of information he could out of the woman.
"Let's start from the very beginning," he said. "You said that every demon was once human. How long ago was that? And what happened that caused them to turn into demons?"
"It happened so long ago that no one in this world could tell you the exact time, but it has definitely been over a trillion years," she answered calmly.

"As for what caused the transformation, it was an event we call the Great Cataclysm. At first, it spread like a disease, turning the infected's skin red before killing them. We initially believed it to be a natural disaster, but we—the Transcendents—eventually discovered it had been deliberately wrought by the Demon God, the overseer of this world."

"Anyway, those killed by the disease would return to life about a week later, but without their memories or former selves, reduced to mindless monsters that attacked and devoured others like wild beasts," she continued.

"In the beginning, they were easy to kill and could be stopped by destroying their head or heart. But as time passed, they evolved and grew stronger, even gaining the ability to regenerate from any non-lethal injury."

"Before we knew it, these beings had grown so powerful they could regenerate even from decapitation or a crushed heart, becoming effectively unkillable. However, they also ceased to be mindless, and those who returned from death began to retain their memories. Eventually, the infected stopped dying altogether and instead simply transformed into what you now know as demons."

"Of course, that didn't stop the humans from hunting them. But since demons were immortal and people continued to become infected somehow, their numbers continued to grow, and they eventually formed their own factions and society, becoming ever more powerful."
"The humans and demons clashed nonstop for hundreds of years, and then—"
The woman paused for a brief moment before continuing, "—the Great Cataclysm happened, changing the entire world forever."
