chapters.title: Chapter 2443 The Great Cataclysm(2)
paragraphs: "The disease, which had appeared only sporadically for countless years, suddenly infected the entire world at once," the woman said in a grim voice. "Panic spread, chaos followed, and the world as we knew it came to an end. This is the Great Cataclysm."
"However, not everyone transformed into the red-skinned demons that now make up the majority of our kind. Some turned grey, others blue, and a few even retained their human appearance."

After a brief pause, she continued in a sorrowful voice, "It wouldn't have been as bad if everyone turned into demons. Unfortunately, that was not the case, as the majority of the human population perished during the Great Cataclysm, and I watched as my entire family died one by one before me."
Yuan silently listened to her story with a pondering expression on his face.
"After the Great Cataclysm ended and everyone in the world either became a demon or died, an unfamiliar voice rippled throughout the world, giving a brief explanation of what had occurred."
"The Demon God?" Yuan asked.

The woman nodded. "That was the Demon God's first appearance—his introduction to the world. It was then that he revealed we were his creation, and that he had elevated us into what he called superior beings."
"Of course," the woman continued in a sighing voice, "the Demon God deemed most of us failures, claiming that only a select few had truly succeeded in ascending. I... was one of those few."
"Did the Demon God reveal the reason behind his actions?"
The woman shook her head.
"No, and that was the last time we ever heard from him again... at least until Supreme Rulers became a thing."

After hearing her full story and learning the true history of the Demonic Realm, Yuan finally understood why the woman appeared to despise the Demon God who, for whatever reason, turned every human into monsters incapable of dying normally.
"I understand how demons came to be, but what about the Forsaken?" Yuan asked after a moment of silence.

"They were originally just called 'demons,'" the woman replied. "But over time, we adopted that name for ourselves, as there was little difference between us—aside from our ability to retain control over our emotions and actions far better."

"Eventually, the world forgot its true history. 'Demon' became our identity, while the original ones came to be known as Forsakens and are treated as sick demons that must be kept away from the healthy."
"What about Abominations?" Yuan then asked. "They look nothing like demons.
"Abominations...?" The woman looked at Yuan with a confused face, almost as if she was hearing this name for the first time.
"You know... those massive, fat and ugly demons?"

"Oh... you mean those monstrosities. They are neither human nor demon, but artificial beings created by some madman in the distant past, for reasons that remain a mystery. They're mostly relics now—repulsive monsters of a bygone era and pretty much extinct in this world," she said, shaking her head in disgust.
"Artificial beings?" Yuan mumbled.

This was his first time hearing a clear explanation of the Abominations' existence, as no one had known their true origin when he'd asked as Tian Chenyu. Most had simply assumed they were mutated demons—Forsakens who had offended the Demon God so deeply they were punished with such a hideous form.
However, this wasn't Yuan's first time hearing about artificial beings. He just didn't know Abominations also fell into such a category.
Some time later, Yuan asked, "Alright, now tell me about Supreme Ruler Umbra and where we can find them."
"Supreme Ruler Umbra?" the woman suddenly chuckled, almost as if he'd just told a joke.
"There is no Supreme Ruler Umbra," she said a moment later, leaving everyone dumbfounded.
"What? If you're going to lie, at least make it believable!" Supreme Ruler Grant shouted. "I have met Supreme Ruler Umbra several times, yet you dared to claim he doesn't exist?"
"By Supreme Ruler Umbra, do you mean him?"
The woman suddenly raised her hand and, with a snap of her fingers, conjured a figure out of thin air.

"T-That is—?!" Supreme Ruler Grant's eyes widened, looking utterly bewildered. "Supreme Ruler Umbra doesn't actually exist. He's just an illusion we created for our own convenience, and, most importantly, for fun," she revealed with a playful smile, "After all, nobody in this place would be willing to accept the Demon God's Authority."
"Then who was it that I spoke with before? You? Or the others?" Supreme Ruler Grant asked with a deep frown on his face.
"Since we can all use 'Supreme Ruler Umbra', it could've been any of us. However, I definitely have never spoken to you before."
Yuan then asked, "Exactly how many of you are in Death Paradise?"
"Take a guess," she said.
"A few hundred?" "Hahaha! A few hundred? We wouldn't be bored out of our minds if we had so many Transcendants!" she exploded with laughter.
Then, she extended a hand at Yuan and raised three fingers.
"Including myself, there are only three Transcendants left now," she calmly said.
Yuan fell silent with a stunned look on his face for a moment before speaking, "You make it sound like there were more in the past."
"Because there were, but not much more. Enough to count with two hands."
"What happened to them? Did they leave this world?"
"Leave? If only such a thing was possible," she sneered before revealing in a cold tone, "They all died... killed."
Yuan raised an eyebrow.
"They were killed? By whom? Don't tell me they fought against themselves or something along that line."
"Of course not. They were killed by the only existence in this world who can do so—the Demon God."
"What?" Yuan immediately became puzzled.
"The Demon God? Why would he kill his own creation?"
The Demon God has always been adamant about not interfering with his own world, and slaughtering his own creations would be a direct contradiction to that.
The woman shrugged and calmly explained, "Because we attacked him."
"You what?!" Yuan exclaimed, his eyes wide with disbelief.

The Demon God has always been adamant about not interfering with his own world, and slaughtering his own creations would be a direct contradiction to that.
The woman shrugged and calmly explained, "Because we attacked him."
"You what?!" Yuan exclaimed, his eyes wide with disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 2444 Selena
paragraphs: "You guys actually attacked the Demon God?" Yuan stared at the woman in astonishment, as he thought that he was the only human to have fought against Eternals before.

"It was a pathetic attempt," the woman shook her head, looking somewhat ashamed. "Not only were we unable to hurt the Demon God, but we couldn't even get close to him. Meanwhile, he killed half of us without any effort. The only reason I, and the other two, were able to survive was because we ran away, and the Demon God didn't pursue us."
"However, he did punish us for baring our fangs at him by imprisoning us in this place."
"By this place, do you mean Death Paradise?" Yuan asked.
She nodded.
"We have been stuck in this place ever since then, unable to do anything but... simply exist without a real purpose."
Hearing the woman's story, Yuan was reminded of the Heavenly War of Immortals and Gods, where countless opponents of the Celestial Emperor had been cast into the Shadow Realm to slowly rot away.

"I already have a good idea why, but I still want to hear it from you. Why did you fight the Demon God?" Yuan suddenly asked. "Simply put, for revenge," she replied coldly. "That bastard experimented on us, turned us into monsters against our will, and plunged our entire world into absolute chaos. But more importantly, he killed my family."
"Revenge, huh?" A faint smile tugged at Yuan's lips as he saw the raw hatred and anger still burning in her eyes, reminding him of Tian Chenyu's past self.
He then turned to look at Supreme Ruler Dena, who was still in her cocoon form.
"I still have some questions."

He then asked the woman, "Do you know someone named Owen? He's the 10th Supreme Ruler of the Crimson Continent. 'Supreme Ruler Umbra' should've spoken to him before, and he's the sole reason we even came here in the first place."
The woman shrugged, "I haven't used 'Supreme Ruler Umbra' before, so I cannot tell you. However, the other two might."
"Can you tell us where we can find them?"
"They are—"
The woman abruptly closed her mouth mid-speech and smiled.
"Rather than just telling you, why don't I bring you to them?" she suddenly suggested.
"Don't worry, I don't have any ulterior motives. I just want to chat with you a little longer," she quickly added, assuring him.
Yuan had no reason to refuse, especially since it was much more convenient, so he nodded.
"Okay."
"Do you want to go now?" she then asked.
"We can do that," he said.
"By the way, what is your name?"
"I thought you'd never ask," she smiled and said, "My name is Selena."
"I'm Yuan."
"Follow me, Yuan."
Selena said as she turned to a certain direction and started moving toward it.
Yuan quickly followed her while carrying Supreme Ruler Dena. Supreme Ruler Grant and Lev also chased them shortly later.
"What is your world like, Yuan?" Selena started inquiring Yuan about his world as they traveled.
"I came from the Nine Heavens, but I actually originate from another world."
"A third world?"
"Well, they are technically the same world. After a certain incident, the Divine Heaven—what we now call Nine Heavens—was split into ten pieces, and I am from the smallest one.
"Why is it called the Nine Heavens if it was split into ten parts?" Selena questioned in a puzzled voice.

"Because one of the worlds was extremely small—akin to an ant compared to the other nine, and it even drifted far, far away. Hell, most people in the Nine Heavens weren't even aware of my world until recently."
"Tell me about your small world first," Selena then said, staring at Yuan like a child during a bedtime story.
Yuan nodded and began to speak of Earth, describing its structure, its societies, the shapes of its buildings, the varieties of food, types of entertainment, and every other detail that came to mind.

Meanwhile, Selena listened with a smile on her face the entire time. After countless years confined to Death Paradise, these glimpses of another world—one where humanity still thrived—were endlessly captivating to her, and even the smallest and most boring details were entertaining.
Once Yuan ran out of things to say about Earth, he moved on to the Nine Heavens. Yet despite their vastness compared to Earth, he felt there was somehow less to say about them.
Still, he spoke of the places he'd visited, the kinds of magical beasts he'd encountered, and even fragments of their history, including the Heavenly War of Immortals and Gods.
Of course, he didn't shy away from revealing to her their history with demons—how they invaded the Nine Heavens and wrought unspeakable horrors, enslaving humans and treating them as mere livestock.

"I've heard about it," Selena said after hearing about it. "How the Crimson Continent tried to get rid of the Forsakens by throwing them into a gateway, that is. However, I was unaware of the consequences or that they'd stopped doing it long ago."

After a moment of silence, Selena remarked, "Although he wasn't directly responsible, the Demon God had a hand in it. After all, he created the Forsakens. So, if you want to blame someone, you should blame the Demon God."
"I did, hence why I fought him," Yuan calmly revealed.
"You what?!" Selena exclaimed, her face almost exactly the same as Yuan when he learned the Transcendants had also fought the Demon God.
"How the hell are you still alive?" she then asked, looking absolutely bewildered.
Yuan smiled and said, "Honestly, he could've killed me if he wanted to. However, for some reason, he decided to spare me in the end."
"I understand why he'd spare us, his own creation, but you, a human from another world? Truly baffling," she mumbled.
Time continued to pass, and after a decade of nonstop journey, Selena suddenly slowed down and said, "We've arrived."

Yuan and the others came to a complete halt at her words, and they immediately tried to sense the Transcendent's presence. Yet, they were unable to sense anything even after expanding their divine sense to their limits.

chapters.title: Chapter 2445 Angela
paragraphs: "Where is the Transcendent? I don't sense anyone," Yuan remarked after spending a full minute trying to find the Transcendent.
However, Selena didn't respond to him, and when he looked at her, she was looking straight up in the sky.
Yuan followed her gaze, and before he could say anything, a shadowy silhouette descended from the sky, landing directly on Selena.
"It's been a while, Selena!" A female's voice resounded, but it sounded irritated, as if someone had intruded into her home.
Selena raised an arm to block the incoming figure, who had descended with her leg extended, intending to axe kick her.
"I never thought you'd visit my territory on your own accord, much less bring so many guests!"
"It's been a while, Angela," Selena greeted in a calm voice despite being sneak-attacked.
"It sure has been a while. How long ago did we last meet? A hundred eighty billion years ago?"
"You've been keeping track?" "Of course! What else is there to do?" Angela laughed aloud.
Yuan watched their seemingly friendly conversation with a raised eyebrow, his eyes directly on Angela, who was another tall and slender beauty, albeit slightly shorter and skinnier than Selena.
Her face was also a little smaller than Selena, but it was noticeably sharper, giving her a naturally aggressive face.
However, beside these differences, they were identical, from their black hair color, ghost-like skin, and even abyssal eyes.

"So... about this weird group..." Angela remarked as she finally turned her attention to Yuan's group, starting with Supreme Ruler Dena's odd appearance and ending with Lev, who was the least interesting to her.
"What kind of game is this?" she asked a moment later, assuming Selena was playing one.
"We've already played, and I lost," Selena replied with a casual shrug.
"You lost?" Angela stared at her in stunned silence for a moment before she burst out laughing.
"Hahaha! You lost to the Demon God's dogs? That's hilarious and embarrassing!"
Selena ignored her mockery and asked, "What do you know about a demon named Owen?"
"Owen? Why are you interested?" Angela asked with a profound smile. "I am looking for him," Yuan said.
"Huh?" Angela suddenly frowned in an unpleasant manner.
"Who gave you permission to speak to me, you dog?"
Angela's demeanor abruptly shifted, and she glared at him with killing intent.
Seeing her sudden and drastic change, Yuan recalled what Selena said earlier—how they were lucky to encounter her because the others would've killed them on sight.
"Hey, Selena, if you're going to bring your animals into my territory, you should have disciplined them first."
"They're not my animal, though."
"What?"
Angela turned to Yuan and the others again, but her gaze had changed. It was sharper now, laced with danger and open disdain.
"Who gave you lot the permission to enter Death Paradise?" she questioned.
"Do you own this entire place?" Yuan questioned back.
"What...?" Angela's eyes widened at Yuan's response, as if bewildered by his audacity.
Yuan continued, "As far as I am aware, this entire world belongs to the Demon God, so why must I ask you permission? Perhaps you're working directly for the Demon God?
Selena also stared at Yuan in disbelief.
"Hey..." she began, but Angela suddenly exploded in fury, her aura surging skyward and piercing the heavens.
"I'll kill you!"
Without warning, Angela lunged at Yuan with fury.
Despite the situation, Yuan remained utterly calm and even sneered aloud, "Your emotional control is pathetic. Are you sure you're an Transcendent and not a Forsaken?"
"DIE!"

Angela lashed out at Yuan, unleashing a tremendous surge of Demon God's Ordeal that crashed down on him and sealed him within—a quantity far greater than what Supreme Ruler Dena had endured for her own trial.
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has activated>
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) has begun refining Demon God's Ordeal>
Seeing her master attacked, the Demon Annihilation Sword moved on instinct, hurling herself toward Angela.
Angela only sneered in disdain and swatted at her with a casual strike, clearly underestimating her and treating her as nothing more than an insignificant fly.
"I am going to devour you!" The Demon Annihilation Sword declared as she swung her sword, unleashing a tremendous amount of Demon Sealing Aura.
"What is this power?"
Angela was taken aback by her Demon Sealing Aura that felt similar to Demon God's Ordeal yet fundamentally different.
She tried to control it like she does with Demon God's Ordeal but failed, forcing her to destroy it instead.
"What an interesting toy..." Angela muttered, staring at her hand, where a faint sting could be felt. "It's been a while, so let's have some fun!"
Angela and the Demon Annihilation Sword clashed, their blows making the air shudder and the very fabric of space crack around them.
Meanwhile, Selena and the others focused their attention on Yuan.
"Although he's human, he's from a different world and fundamentally different from us... Will the Demon God's Ordeal even work on him?" Selena wondered aloud in a low voice.

Inside the cloud of Demon God's Ordeal, Yuan nearly lost consciousness from Angela's attack. Although he could've dodged or blocked the attack, he purposefully chose not to, as he saw it as an opportunity to train.
<Demonic Awakening activated>
After consuming a certain amount of Demon God's Ordeal, Yuan automatically entered his demon form.
"What?!" Selena's eyes widened with shock after seeing Yuan's transformation for the first time.
"How is he able to take on that appearance?!" Selena cried out loud, wondering if the Demon God had caused the Great Cataclysm in other worlds.
However, if that were the case, Yuan would've mentioned it when he told her about the history of Nine Heavens.
"And it's not just his appearance, either! His presence... even his scent has become the same as a demon! Did he really turn into one?!
Angela, who was locked in a fierce battle with the Demon Annihilation Sword, sensed Yuan's impressive aura and shifted her attention to him.
"That aura... it's similar to ours, but he's clearly not one of us... What the hell is he?"
Since Angela had paid them only the bare minimum attention, she had no idea that Yuan was human.

After his Demonic Awakening activated, Yuan quickly returned to his senses, and he could feel something had started to change in him. However, he'd already refined all of the Demon God's Ordeal that Angela forced upon him.
"More... give me more!" Yuan turned to Angela and demanded with a wide smile on his face.
"What?"
Angela frowned, but before she could even comprehend Yuan's demands, he lunged at her and attacked.
"Is that all you can do? With that pathetic amount of Demon God's Ordeal, I barely felt it." Yuan suddenly started provoking her.
"You bastard!"
Without thinking, Angela instinctively launched even more Demon God's Ordeal at Yuan, who gladly accepted all of it.
"Hahaha! More! I want more!" Yuan laughed like a madman as he devoured the Demon God's Ordeal like a black hole.
"What the hell?!" Angela's eyes widened with disbelief, and she continued attacking him with Demon God's Ordeal.
"Why isn't he dying or ascending?! He'd already consumed over a million year's worth of Demon God's Ordeal! That amount could easily create a dozen Transcendants!"
Yuan continued shouting, "Not enough! Not even close!"
He suddenly turned to look at Selena and said to her, "Why don't you help her out and send some more Demon God's Ordeal my way?"
"This crazy—!"

Selena forcefully pushed aside her bewilderment and immediately began directing even more Demon God's Ordeal toward Yuan, a wide smile on her face as she watched, immensely entertained by the whole situation.
"Angela, I know you can do more than that!" Selena said to her a moment later.
"Sure thing—" Angela subconsciously responded but quickly froze with a dumbfounded expression. "Wait a damn second! Why the hell am I listening to you?!"
Despite her words, Angela pushed herself to her limit, sending as much Demon God's Ordeal as she could toward Yuan.
"Hahaha!"

Yuan laughed nonstop, his voice echoing in all directions. "This feels amazing! More! Give it all to me!" Lev stared at Yuan with a stunned look on his face, wondering aloud, "Did he really go crazy?"
"I'm surprised that he's still alive," Supreme Ruler Grant mumbled.
In just a few minutes, Yuan had endured over ten million years worth of Demon God's Ordeal.
Yet, he still seemed nowhere close to ascending.
"What am I even doing? Why does it feel like I am helping him instead of killing him?" Angela eventually realized something was amiss and questioned aloud.
"You're thinking too much," Selena replied. "Don't you want to kill him? Just keep at it and he'll die sooner or later... probably."

Time slipped by, and after several more minutes, Selena and Angela finally stopped—not because Yuan had died, nor because he had ascended. "There's no more Demon God's Ordeal!" Angela shouted when she realized they'd completely exhausted the energy in the area.
"Wow... I didn't even know such a thing was possible..." Selena remarked with a stunned face.

chapters.title: Chapter 2446 Helena
paragraphs: "More! I want more! Why are you stopping?!" Yuan roared out loud when the Demon God's Ordeal stopped flowing toward him, looking like an addict who just ran out of supply.
"There's nothing we can do since all of the Demon God's Ordeal in this area has already been consumed by you," Selena remarked.
"Huh?"
Yuan's Demonic Awakening suddenly deactivated, and his demeanor returned to normal.
He looked around with a somewhat puzzled face, almost as if he wasn't aware of what had occurred.
Then he inspected his body. Although it felt stronger than before, it wasn't drastically different, nor was there anything new.
"You haven't completed your ascension yet," Selena said after seeing his actions.
Yuan raised an eyebrow and asked, "Will it be fine? I thought one could not stop their ascension midway."
"Hard to say. You may be human, but you came from a different world, so things might be different for you."
"What did you just say? He's a human from another world?" Angela's eyes widened in disbelief after hearing this information from Selena.
"B-But he's clearly a demon!"
Selena shook her head, "Unfortunately, I cannot explain that phenomenon."
"Hey, will the Demon God's Ordeal replenish itself?" Yuan suddenly asked them.
"Yes," Selena replied. "But it will likely take a tremendous amount of time. It'd be faster if we went to another area, where the Demon God's Ordeal is still abundant."
"Then what are we waiting for? Let's head to..." Yuan halted his sentence when he remembered something.
"Oh, right."
He looked at Angela and continued, "Do you still want to fight? I would prefer it if we didn't, but I don't mind entertaining you for a bit. After all, you did help me cultivate."
"Who... who the hell was trying to help you?! I wanted to kill you for disrespecting me!" Angela shouted while pointing a finger at him, her arm slightly shaking from anger.
Yuan shrugged. "You started it by treating us like insects. Even if you despise the Demon God, taking your anger out on others is nothing more than childish."
"What did you just say?" Angela frowned, her killing intent reemerging."
"My, what's going on here?"
Suddenly, a new voice resounded.

"Helena!"
Selena and Angela called out her name simultaneously. It was another Transcendent—the third and final one in the entire Demonic Realm.
"What are you doing here?" Selena asked.
"I could ask you the same thing," said Helena. "I was in the area and noticed the commotion, so I decided to check it out. Never expected to see you here, Selena."
Helena bore similar facial features to the other two, but her physique was noticeably bulkier and full of muscles.
Seeing how much they resembled each other, Yuan couldn't help but wonder if they were sisters, or if it was a characteristic of Transcendents.
"How long have you been watching?" Angela inquired.
Helena showed a smile as her gaze shifted to Yuan.
"Right before Selena joined in on the fun," she calmly replied.
"So, what were the two of you doing? And is he really a human from another world?"
"They're here to look for a demon named Owen," Selena said.
"Owen?" Helena raised an eyebrow, then turned to Angela. Their eyes met, and for an instant it was as if they were silently acknowledging some shared secret.
"I guess you both know something about Owen," Selena remarked after seeing their reaction. "So, what have the two of you been doing behind my back?"
"Behind your back? That's something you can only say if you were involved from the beginning," Angela sneered aloud.
"Right? And it's not like we're purposefully avoiding you, either. Whenever we meet, it's because we went to visit you. You've never visited us on your own accord... ever."
Selena sighed at their words and replied, "It's not like I am purposefully avoiding you, either. This is just who I am."
"So, what do you know about Owen?" Yuan finally spoke, asking them.
"What? Even if we know Owen, why should we tell you? It's none of your business," Helena sneered.
"You're right. It's none of our business. However, we intend to kill him once we find him, so if his death inconveniences you—"
"Wait a second. You're trying to kill Owen? Why?" Angela interrupted with a deep frown on her face.
"Sorry, but it's none of your business." Yuan shook his head, refusing to answer.

"No, it is our business," Helena quickly said. "We have an agreement with him, and that would fall apart if he dies, so we need him alive. I don't care why you want to kill him, but it's not going to happen... at least not until we're done with him, so forget about it."
"And how long would that take?" Yuan then asked.
"Hard to say. However, now that we know you're trying to kill him, we cannot allow you to leave until we're done with him, so you'll have to stay here until then. If you refuse... we'll kill you."
Yuan fell silent.
He could likely handle one Transcendent, but two would be pushing even his limits. And it wasn't as though he could rely on Lev or Supreme Ruler Grant to deal with the other.
Moreover, Supreme Ruler Dena's situation was still dubious.

'I doubt Selena would help me fight her own allies...' Yuan sighed inwardly. 'If anything, she might turn on me instead—no, it's almost certain she would. After all, she wanted me to stay with her forever if we lost the game.'
After pondering for a moment, Yuan spoke, "Whatever you need from Owen, I doubt I won't be able to assist you. Hell, I might even do it better than him, so why don't you tell me about it?
"You? Help us?" Angela suddenly chuckled.
"Unless you can contact the Demon God, there's nothing you, a foreigner from another world, could help us with!" Helena shouted.

Yuan raised an eyebrow at their words, thinking to himself, 'So it has something to do with the Demon God, huh? Does this mean that Owen is in contact with the Demon God? No... that's unlikely... So is he lying?'
Seeing the surprised look on Yuan's face, Angela continued laughing, "Look at your dumbfounded face! You're all talk!"
A smile tugged at Yuan's lips as he responded, "But I didn't even say anything."
He continued, "Although it might not be easy to contact the Demon God, I can definitely do it."
"What?"
Not just Helena and Angela, but even Selena expressed surprise at his claims.
"That's nothing but empty talk!"
Yuan remained calm and asked, "The reason you want to contact the Demon God... are you trying to leave this place?"
Helena and Angela's expression and body visibly stiffened.
"Why do you look so surprised? Who would want to stay imprisoned for eternity? I certainly wouldn't," he shrugged.
"I don't know what Owen said to you, but I doubt he has the power to free you from this place."
"But you do?" Angela sneered with a suspicious face.
"I can't guarantee you that I will be able to free you from this place, but I can try, and you'd definitely have better chances with me than that fraud Owen."
"We've known Owen for billions of years, but we've only met you today, and you want us to trust you over him? Laughable!" Helena snickered in disdain.

Yuan then asked them, "In that case, why don't you tell me about your business with Owen? What did he promise you? What does he want in return?" "He promised us that he'd help us regain our freedom," Angela said. "As for his methods... he didn't tell us, saying that it wouldn't work if he revealed it to us because the Demon God is always watching."
Yuan raised his eyebrows and asked, "And you're not worried about plotting against the Demon God so openly? That seems... quite contradictory."
"We're not plotting against the Demon God, though." Helena said. "We just want to regain our freedom. If the Demon God has an issue with it, he will intervene. If not, that means he's allowing it."

"So, the two of you are plotting to regain your freedom... without me?" Selena suddenly asked. When they turned to her, they were met with a calm expression. But looking closer, they could see a flicker of anger slowly surfacing in the depths of her eyes.
"W-We were planning on telling you!" Angela hastily said, a hint of nervousness in her voice.
"Really?" Selena asked in a low voice.

"Really!" Helena nodded. "We were going to tell you once we were certain about everything because we didn't want to get your hopes up! There's no way we would leave you here alone, even if you never visit us."
Selena nodded, "Alright."
The rising anger in her eyes vanished the next second.
Seeing this, the other two sighed in relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 2447 Weird Energy
paragraphs: "So, what does this Owen want from you in exchange for freedom?" Selena asked the two a moment later.
"He asked for some of our blood," said Helena. "Despite his outrageous request, we are willing to overlook it if it means regaining our freedom."
"Did you already give him your blood?" Selena raised her eyebrows.

"Of course not. We're not foolish enough to give him our blood before we are certain that—," Angela said. "Actually..." Helena suddenly interrupted, "I was with Owen just before coming here, and I gave him some of my blood."
"You what?!" Angela looked at her with wide eyes.
"I know what you're thinking, but I didn't give it to him for nothing," Helena said as she raised an arm and continued, "I don't know what he did, but I was able to partially leave Death Paradise."
"Is that true?!" Angela exclaimed, her voice full of excitement.
Helena nodded, "I was able to extend my arm outside of Death Paradise for a full minute."
"That's... great!" Angela said.

Due to the Demon God's punishment, none of them were able to stick even a single hair outside of Death Paradise, so an entire arm was definitely a significant improvement. Yuan raised an eyebrow at their words and asked, "What did Owen do to help you, exactly?"
"He gave me some weird energy," she said. "Weird energy?" Yuan raised an eyebrow.
"Can I examine this energy?"
"What?" Helena frowned with a look of disgust on her face.
"Are you crazy? There's no way I'd let you examine my body. Even if I did, that energy is long gone."
"Hmm..." Yuan narrowed his eyes.
He suddenly raised an arm with his palm pointing to the sky, unleashing some Eternal Essence.
"Is this the energy you gained from him?"
"T-That's—!" Not just Helena, but Selena and Angela expressed surprise, clearly recognizing Eternal Essence.
"Why can you wield that power?!"
The three of them suddenly moved away from Yuan and entered into battle stances, their expressions etched with vigilance and fear.
Although it had been countless years since they fought with the Demon God, they'd never forgotten the power he used to completely defeat them, even killing several of their comrades.
"Answer me! Why can you wield that power, Demon God's dog!" Helena roared, her aura oozing with immense killing intent.

Yuan withdrew his Eternal Essence and spoke, "Do you think this power is exclusive to the Demon God or something? Sorry to tell you, but he's not the only one who can wield it. In fact, there are dozens of beings out there with this power."
"What the hell are you trying to say?" Angela frowned.
"Are you stupid? I already told you. The Demon God isn't the only existence in this universe that can wield this power, as it is not exclusive to him."
"Then what is that power? And who else could wield it?" Selena asked.

"This power is called Eternal Essence, and it can only be wielded by existences known as 'Eternals'. They are god-like beings that live in the boundless void beyond the sky of this world. Of course, the one you know as Demon God is simply one of many Eternals out there."
"There are... many more Demon Gods out there?" Selena shivered just at the thought, looking utterly bewildered and in disbelief.
"Yes, there are many Eternals out there. However, they're not all like the Demon God."
"That doesn't make me feel any better..." Selena shook her head.
"Why are you worried about them? It's not like they're all out to get you." Yuan then said, "Anyway, is this the energy that Owen gave you?"
Angela and Selena turned to look at Helena, who nodded her head after snapping out of her daze.
"Yes... and he claims it's proof that he has direct access to the Demon God, and can even persuade the Demon God to free us..." Helena revealed.
Yuan fell silent, wondering how Owen, a mere demon, could wield Eternal Essence.
"How did Owen infuse Eternal Essence into your body?" Yuan then asked. "Did he directly give it to you?"
Helena shook her head.
"No. It was transferred to me through some needle," she replied.
"So it was given to you indirectly..."

'However, this means another Eternal could be involved in this situation. Why the hell is another Eternal interfering with the Demonic Realm? I would understand if this was the Nine Heavens and they were trying to use Owen to acquire the Absolute Power, but there's no such thing in the Demonic Realm!' Yuan wondered inwardly, as he couldn't comprehend why another Eternal would work with Owen to free the Transcendents.
"What are you thinking about?" Selena suddenly asked Yuan.
"Oh, just that Owen isn't capable of wielding Eternal Essence himself and that he's being assisted by an Eternal."
"You mean an entity like the Demon God is helping Owen? Why would they do such a thing?" "How would I know?" he shrugged.
"Anyway, unlike Owen, whose purpose is still unknown, I, on the other hand, can help you regain your freedom as long as you give Owen to me," Yuan said.
Helena and Angela exchanged glances with each other, clearly debating about Yuan's offer through voice transmission.
A few minutes later, Angela turned to look at Yuan and said, "Since you can wield that power, does that mean you can help us leave Death Paradise now?"
"Well, I can certainly try..."
Angela nodded.
"Then, if you can grant us our freedom now, we will not only allow you to kill Owen, we will even capture him for you."
A smile appeared on Yuan's face as he replied, "Let's do that."
"Then let's do it immediately!"
Without warning, Angela used Void Manipulation on everyone there, teleporting them to the edge of Death Paradise.
"Alright! Inject me with your Eternal Essence and grant me my freedom!" Angela said.
"Before we start, I must warn you that I have never directly injected Eternal Essence into another being and that things might not go as you expect."
"Spare me that nonsense and just do it. What's the worst that can happen?" Angela hastily said, clearly impatient to regain her freedom.
"If you say so."
Without hesitation, Yuan grabbed her wrist and injected some Eternal Essence into her body.
The very next instant, Angela started to scream in pain, her face twisting with agony.
"IT HURTS!" she roared out loud as she yanked her arm from Yuan's grasp.
"AHHH!"
Angela's arm suddenly expanded like a balloon, and mere seconds later, exploded.
"Angela?!"
Selena and Helena cried out loud.
"Bastard! What have you done to her?!" Helena rushed at Yuan and grabbed him by the neck, barely holding herself back from crushing it.
"I did exactly as I said I would—inject Eternal Essence into her body," Yuan responded. "I warned her this might happen, too."
"Bullshit!" Helena roared. "How come I didn't experience anything like this when Owen injected Eternal Essence into my body?!"
"I don't know. It's likely that the Eternal Essence you accepted had been altered, and what I gave her was Eternal Essence in its purest form, something that can only be endured by Eternals."
"Can you let go of my neck now? If I really wanted to harm her, I wouldn't have held back on the amount of Eternal Essence I gave her because I feared something like this might happen."
"L-Let him go..." Angela suddenly spoke in a low voice.
Helena released Yuan and turned to look at her, who had just fully regenerated her arm.
"He's telling the truth. I only felt a drop of that energy enter my body, and I was about to complain about it but was interrupted," she sighed.
Angela looked at Yuan with her back soaked in sweat and continued, "That power is definitely the same power used by the Demon God when we fought him. Since you can use it... are you also an Eternal?"
Yuan shook his head, "No, my situation is unique."
He looked at Helena and said, "If you want me to help you, I will need to examine your body, even if it's likely that the energy Owen gave you is no longer there."
Helena gritted her teeth and nodded, "Alright..."
She extended her arm toward Yuan, who immediately grabbed it and examined her body.
It took some time, but Yuan sensed a tiny trace of Eternal Essence within Helena's body, and just as he'd expected, it wasn't pure Eternal Essence.
"I found it, and I am going to extract that energy right now," Yuan warned her before extracting it.
A moment later, Yuan successfully extracted the energy and consumed it himself.
He closed his eyes and became as still as a statue.
The others watched in silence, not daring to interrupt him.
They expected him to finish in a few minutes, but hours passed without any movement from Yuan.
Hours turned into days, and days turned into weeks.
Finally, after half a year, Yuan opened his eyes.

It's likely that the Eternal Essence you accepted had been altered, and what I gave her was Eternal Essence in its purest form, something that can only be endured by Eternals."
"Can you let go of my neck now?
If I really wanted to harm her, I wouldn't have held back on the amount of Eternal Essence I gave her because I feared something like this might happen."
"L-Let him go..." Angela suddenly spoke in a low voice.
Helena released Yuan and turned to look at her, who had just fully regenerated her arm.
"He's telling the truth.
I only felt a drop of that energy enter my body, and I was about to complain about it but was interrupted," she sighed.
Angela looked at Yuan with her back soaked in sweat and continued, "That power is definitely the same power used by the Demon God when we fought him.
Since you can use it... are you also an Eternal?"
Yuan shook his head, "No, my situation is unique."
He looked at Helena and said, "If you want me to help you, I will need to examine your body, even if it's likely that the energy Owen gave you is no longer there."
Helena gritted her teeth and nodded, "Alright..."
She extended her arm toward Yuan, who immediately grabbed it and examined her body.
It took some time, but Yuan sensed a tiny trace of Eternal Essence within Helena's body, and just as he'd expected, it wasn't pure Eternal Essence.
"I found it, and I am going to extract that energy right now," Yuan warned her before extracting it.
A moment later, Yuan successfully extracted the energy and consumed it himself.
He closed his eyes and became as still as a statue.
The others watched in silence, not daring to interrupt him.
They expected him to finish in a few minutes, but hours passed without any movement from Yuan.
Hours turned into days, and days turned into weeks.
Finally, after half a year, Yuan opened his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 2448 Owen
paragraphs: "So? Did you learn anything?" Helena asked the moment Yuan emerged from his cultivation.
Yuan looked at her and slowly shook his head, "Unfortunately, there was too little for me to extract any meaningful information."
"What the hell? You spent half a year learning nothing?" Helena frowned.
"Well, this power is extremely complex. There's a reason why only Eternals are capable of wielding it, I have only really just begun to study it." Yuan shrugged, defending himself.
Moreover, this was his first time encountering Eternal Essence that wasn't in its purest form. When he fought other Eternals, they would only wield pure Eternal Essence.
'This either means there's an Eternal involved who's on an entirely different level from the rest... or that I've never truly witnessed an Eternal fighting at their full capacity...'
Since most of his fights with Eternals happened near the Nine Heavens, it was natural they wouldn't be able to exert their full power.
'Now that I think about it, when I fought Deemo, the Demon God, it was also near the Nine Heavens because he approached me.'
When he really thought about it, Yuan realized that he'd never fought an Eternal that wasn't near the Absolute Power's influence.
This made him wonder what sort of hidden powers the Eternals might have.
"What now?" Selena asked him.

Yuan looked at Helena and said, "I can question Owen and ask to speak with the Eternal behind him, but that would require his presence, and I doubt you would let me meet him without any guarantees. How tricky."
Selena then said, "Angela, Helena, I think you can trust him."
"Seriously, Selena? You're willing to trust a suspicious alien like him?" Angela muttered with a dumbfounded face.
"Although the time we've spent together wasn't long, it is enough for me to trust him."
Angela looked at Helena, silently asking her what they should do.
Helena fell silent for a long moment before responding, "I am willing to let you meet with Owen if you swear not to attack him."
"Deal." Yuan instantly accepted
"Don't even try to attack him, because the moment I sense even the slightest killing intent from you, I will kill you."
"Relax, if I say that I won't attack him, I won't."
Helena nodded.
"Then I will contact him right now."
She withdrew a communication jade slip—similar in function to those in the Nine Heavens, but forged from different material and bearing a different shape.
"Owen, come meet me," she spoke to him.
A few moments later, she received a respond.
"I know we just had a meeting, but Angela wants to speak with you. Also, don't you dare question me again. If I tell you to meet, we meet," Helena responded to Owen's response, sounding irritated.
After several minutes of silence, Helena spoke into the communication jade slip again, "Owen! How dare you make me wait! I don't care if you're busy, I am your priority!"
Yuan's jaw dropped at Helena's aggression, and he couldn't help but wonder if this was how she usually treated others.
Owen's reply came a few seconds later. As Helena listened, her entire body went rigid and her face went blank, dazed, as though she couldn't believe what she'd just heard.
Suddenly, unfathomable killing intent exploded from her, shocking Yuan and the others.
"HOW DARE YOU! I SWEAR I WILL MAKE YOU WISH YOU WERE DEAD THE MOMENT I GET OUT OF THIS PLACE!" she roared into the communication jade slip, shattering it the next moment with a clenched fist.
"Helena?!" Selena cried out loud.
"What did Owen say to anger you that much?!" Angela hastily asked, as only Helena was able to hear Owen's response.
Helena turned to them and explained, "That bastard Owen has betrayed us!"
"What?!" Angela's eyes widened with disbelief.

"When I asked him to meet, he refused, saying that we're no longer needed! That bastard even dared to tell us to rot in here for an eternity!" Helena's killing intent surged again just recalling Owen's unexpected betrayal.

Angela stared in stunned silence, as though she couldn't believe her ears. Then, just like Helena, she erupted in fury and killing intent. "That bastard Owen betrayed us the moment he obtained our blood!" she snarled, clenching her teeth so hard they shattered, blood spilling from her mouth.

Yuan watched the scene unfold, his brows lifting in surprise. Owen's betrayal itself didn't shock him, as he'd anticipated it'd happened sooner or later. What caught him off guard was how quickly it had come.
'So Owen's purpose was not to free the Transcendents but to acquire their blood? What is he—or the Eternal going to do with their blood?'
"Alien!" Helena suddenly called out to Yuan.
When he shifted his focus to her, she was already standing directly in front of him with a vengeful look on her face.
"Let me guess..." Yuan spoke before she got the chance, and said, "You want me to help you find Owen and kill him because he betrayed you?"
"Kill him? No! That would be too generous and forgiving! I want you to capture him and bring him to us, so we can torture him for an eternity!"
When Yuan met Helena's abyssal gaze, her eyes seemed to swirl like black holes in the void, devouring everything around them.
Although Yuan was tempted to throw out a few snarky remarks just to toy with them, he decided against it, as provoking them in their current fury would be far too dangerous.
"Well, I was already going to find him, regardless. But how am I going to find him in this vast world without your help?"

"Don't worry. While we may be trapped here, we're not useless. Owen may not know this, but we Transcendents can track even every single drop of our blood, regardless of their distance. Even if you scattered a hundred drops of our blood throughout this world, we would be able to pinpoint them with perfect accuracy."
"What a convenient ability. So, where is Owen right now? I'll chase after him."
"You don't need to do that because I can teleport you to him," Helena said with a cold smile on her face.
"That bastard Owen definitely won't be expecting this!"
Yuan turned to look at Lev and Supreme Ruler Grant and said, "I'll go alone. The two of you stay here and watch over Dena for me."
"Yes!" Lev immediately responded.
"Umm... can I go home already?" Supreme Ruler Grant sighed in an exhausted voice despite not doing much if anything during their entire journey.
"Well, someone has to entertain them while I am gone, and I doubt Lev, who has spent most of his life inside the Deprived Crimson Valley, has many stories to tell." Yuan shrugged.
Without waiting for a response, Yuan turned to Helena and said, "Take me to Owen, and I will bring him back for you. However, if you touch my people, you can kiss your revenge goodbye."
Helena silently nodded and used Void Manipulation on him.
Meanwhile, somewhere on a random island in the Bone Atoll, Owen tossed his communication jade slip into the sea, as it had cracked after the other end was destroyed.
"Although they may be powerful, they're useless as long as they cannot leave Death Paradise," he laughed out loud.

"I bet that woman is going crazy with anger right now. Enduring all of their nonsense for so long was definitely worth it. If there's one I regret, it's that I won't be able to witness their reaction."
"Now, I can finally—"
Owen's entire body suddenly went rigid as an ominous feeling twisted in his gut.
He subconsciously turned around to see a handsome man hovering above him like a ghost who appeared out of thin air.
"Who the hell are you?!" Owen cried out loud as his heart skipped a beat.
"It's been a while, Owen." Yuan said with a smile. "You know me?" Owen frowned, trying to recall if they had ever met.
Though it didn't strike him at first, he soon realized Yuan's features looked strangely familiar.
"You don't remember me? Then do you remember Dena?"
Owen's eyebrows raised at the sudden mention of Supreme Ruler Dena.
He spent a good chunk of his life by Supreme Ruler Dena's side as the Supreme Adviser, so there was no way he'd forget about her.
"Wait a second!" Owen's eyes started to widen, almost as if he realized something.
"Y-You! You can't be!"
"Oh? Have you finally recalled?"
Yuan descended onto the island, standing only a few meters away from him.
"You're that Demon Sealer from the other world! Tian Chenyu! But that's impossible!" Owen exclaimed in disbelief, subconsciously walking backwards.
He continued, "The gateway to your world was sealed, and you definitely returned to your world at that time! How did you come back?!"
"Does it really matter how I returned?"
Owen fell silent. Then, with narrowed eyes, asked, "No, it doesn't. However, why are you here? Is it a coincidence? Or are you looking for me?"

The chances of Tian Chenyu returning to their world and coincidentally running into him were slim to none, so Owen quickly assumed he had come for him on purpose. Yet he couldn't fathom why someone like Tian Chenyu would seek him out, as they'd barely interacted in the past.
"You really don't know? Take a moment to think about it," Yuan calmly said.
Owen pondered for a moment before a look of realization flashed across his face.
"Are you here because of Supreme Ruler Dena? If you're looking for her, she's at the Deprived Crimson Valley," Owen said, completely unaware that she'd left that place long ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 2449 Owen(2)
paragraphs: Yuan raised an eyebrow after hearing Owen's words.
'He's not aware that Dena left the Deprived Crimson Valley long ago? I guess he hasn't returned to the Crimson Continent in a long time.'
'Since he doesn't know anything... let's try to extract as much information from him as possible.'

"Dena is in the Deprived Crimson Valley? Isn't that place meant for Forsakens? Why would she be there?" Yuan asked with a puzzled face, acting ignorant of the whole situation and pretending like he'd just returned.
"You really don't know?" Owen questioned with a suspicious look.
"Well, I just came back, and I am kind of lost, as I am still unfamiliar with this world. Fortunately, I ran into you by coincidence... or is this fate?"
'What a pain in the ass...' Owen cursed inwardly.

Although he never had much interaction with Tian Chenyu, since he was always by Supreme Ruler Dena's side, Owen had no choice but to spend several thousand years around Tian Chenyu, so he was familiar with Tian Chenyu's character and how difficult he was in the past.
"So, what happened to Dena for her to be exiled to the Deprived Crimson Valley?" Yuan suddenly asked.
"There's only one... or two reasons why anyone would be sent to that place. Either they've turned into Forsaken or committed a grave crime. In her case, she was sent there for both reasons."
"Dena turned into a Forsaken? That's hard to believe." Yuan said with a frown. "And what kind of crime did she commit?"
"The worst kind of crime a Supreme Ruler could commit—the betrayal and murder of her own people. She killed everyone in the City of Blood after becoming a Forsaken."
Yuan fell silent for a moment before speaking again, "How long ago was this? If Dena killed everyone, why are you still alive? And what are you doing in the middle of nowhere?"
"This happened billions of years ago. I only survived because I was out on a mission when it happened..."
After a brief pause, Owen continued, "As for what I am doing here... that is none of your business.

"None of my business?" Yuan repeated as a cold feeling started oozing from his presence. "Bold words for someone who was nearly beaten to death by me in the past," he said, referring to their first encounter.
Before Supreme Ruler Dena arrived to stop him during his massacre, it was Owen who had tried to stop him first.
Of course, Owen had been beaten to the brink of death by Tian Chenyu, forcing Supreme Ruler Dena to intervene.

Owen laughed out loud, "Don't think you can scare me anymore, Tian Chenyu! I am no longer afraid of you! After Supreme Ruler Dena was exiled, I took her place and became the next Supreme Ruler! Not only that, but I have the backing of powerful beings that you cannot even begin to comprehend!"

Yuan raised an eyebrow and remarked, "Backing from a powerful being? Even though you are a Supreme Ruler? How does that make any sense at all? I thought Supreme Rulers are already the strongest beings in the Demonic Realm."

"Hahaha! This world... no, this universe is much larger than you can imagine! Being a Supreme Ruler may seem impressive at first, but they are nowhere near the peak! Just like you, I was a frog in a well until I was chosen!"
"Chosen? By whom? The Demon God?" "Oh?"
Owen wore a look of surprise on his face.
"How surprising. I didn't think you'd actually guess it on your first try."

Yuan fell silent, baffled by the turn of events. He was fairly certain the Demon God had no involvement with Owen, so it was likely that another Eternal was impersonating the Demon God to manipulate Owen into doing their bidding.
'To think Owen would betray the Transcendents only to be fooled by an Eternal...'
However, as borderline impossible as it was, Yuan couldn't ignore the sliver of chance that the Demon God might actually be involved.
"Why would the Demon God choose you? And to do what, exactly?" Yuan then inquired.
"Once again, that is none of your business."
"You're right. It is none of my business what you do with the Demon God, but I am intrigued, as I have spoken with—and even met the Demon God before."
"What?!" Owen's eyes widened with disbelief at Yuan's words.
"Lies! Why would the Demon God speak with you, much less meet you in person?! Do you have any evidence of your claims?!"
"You make it sound like the Demon God is only allowed to speak to you," Yuan shook his head. "As for evidence... I could ask you the same question."
Without hesitation, Owen retrieved an object from his Spatial Ring and displayed it with a proud grin.
"This! This proves that I am chosen by the Demon God!" Owen declared.
Yuan's eyes widened at the sight of this object, but it was not because he recognized the item. Rather, it was the familiar energy it was emitting.
The item in Owen's grasp appeared to be an ordinary metal coin the size of his palm, but it was exuding what was clearly Eternal Essence.
'That is clearly a treasure, but this is my first time seeing a treasure with Eternal Essence...' Yuan thought to himself.

Then, he recalled something Shiva had once told him—that most treasures within the Nine Heavens were forged by Eternals, and that all of them were incomplete. A finished treasure simply could not exist there, as the Absolute Power would not allow it.
Upon remembering this information, Yuan realized that the treasure in Owen's grasp was very likely one of these complete treasures—a treasure that surpassed Celestial-grade treasures.
"Do you sense the godly energy within this treasure?" Owen suddenly spoke. "This is a power that can only be wielded by God! This is what the Demon God bestowed me!"
After a brief pause, he continued in a grim voice, "With that said, I was instructed to never reveal this treasure to anyone. Since you've already seen it... I have no choice but to kill you now."

I have no choice but to kill you now."

chapters.title: Chapter 2450 Fighting Owen
paragraphs: "Really? Even though I never asked you to show me that treasure and you showed it on your own accord? How unreasonable." Yuan said with a slight frown.
"You asked for evidence, didn't you?"
"I guess so, but you could've decided not to show me. Yet, you did. Do you really want to kill me so badly? Besides our initial encounter, I don't believe I have done anything to offend you."
Owen tightly clenched his fists and trembled, his eyes burning with fury as he glared at Yuan.
"Did nothing to offend me...?" Owen muttered in a suppressed voice.
After a brief pause, he exploded in fury.

"Because of you, the reputation I've built over billions of years was dragged through the mud! I became a complete laughingstock! Even if no one dared say it to my face... I know they were all laughing behind my back!"
"Their mocking gazes... their looks of disdain..." he growled, his voice trembling with rage. "They've haunted me ever since!"
"Is that why you killed everyone in the City of Blood and pinned the blame on Dena?" Yuan suddenly said, catching Owen off guard.
Owen stared at him in disbelief, then his expression twisted further as realization dawned. Yuan had been playing with him this entire time.
"That's right..." Owen muttered.
"That's right! I was the one who killed everyone in the City of Blood! It's their punishment for mocking me!" He burst out laughing like a manic.
"I doubt you simply killed them. From what I heard, everyone in the city vanished, as if they never existed in the first place. What did you do to them?" Yuan inquired.
"Since you're about to die anyway, I might as well tell you," he said coldly. "Besides... I've wanted to get this off my chest for a long time."
Owen retrieved a crimson scroll from his Spatial Ring and held it up for Yuan to see.

"This is the Supreme Immolation Array—an ancient formation capable of converting life itself into power on a massive scale," he revealed. "Every sacrifice made within it becomes fuel for my own strength!"
Yuan narrowed his eyes and asked, "What about Supreme Ruler Exosso?"
"Oh? You also know about that?" Owen said in a surprised tone. "You've been busy."
He continued with a cold smirk, "The same goes for Exosso and his men. I converted all of them into my strength."
"A formation that can sacrifice a Supreme Ruler without him being aware until it was too late? That's quite scary," Yuan remarked.
Owen shook his head.
"To be frank with you, if it weren't for this treasure, it would have been impossible to kill Exosso since he would have noticed it before the formation could be activated."
"And why did you kill them? Did they also mock you?"
"No, I just wanted to acquire their power."
Yuan released a deep sigh before saying, "Did you also acquire that scroll from the Demon God?"
"No, I found this scroll by pure chance."
"Then how and when did the Demon God contact you?"
"I think that's enough questions from you," Owen said as he put away the ancient scroll and the treasure.
"You're not going to use that treasure to fight me?" Yuan asked with raised eyebrows.
"Hahaha!" Owen started laughing again.

"You're overestimating yourself too much, Tian Chenyu! I won't need the treasure to deal with a mere ant like you!" Since Yuan's cultivation was only at the first level of False God, Owen regarded him as nothing more than a joke, hence why he dared to reveal so much, as he was utterly convinced he could kill Yuan without the slightest difficulty.
"With that said, I won't be killing you so quickly. Instead, I will slowly torture you—the cause of my humiliation—to death."
"Good luck." Yuan calmly nodded.
"Supreme Blood Art."
Owen made a grasping motion toward Yuan, and a crimson sphere of blood instantly formed around him, sealing him within.
Inside the sphere, hundreds of spears materialized and pierced through Yuan's body, but none of them would hit his vital organs.
"I guess he really doesn't want to kill me quickly..." Yuan mumbled with a smile on his face.
A surge of Demon Sealing Aura erupted from Yuan's body, blowing away the crimson sphere.
"Demon Sealing Aura... it's been so long since I last saw that vile power," said Owen, a look of disgust twisting his face.
He raised an arm and pointed his palm at Yuan. The next moment, thousands of bone shards shot out of his palm like bullets.
Yuan activated the Demon Sealing Array, forming a wall in front of himself.
However, the bone shards effortlessly shattered the wall and poked many holes into Yuan's body.
"It seems your regeneration has gotten much better than before," Owen remarked after seeing how quickly Yuan regenerated from the damage.
An excited smile tugged at his lips as he continued, "This is great, as it means I won't have to worry about accidentally killing you too quickly."
Yuan closed his eyes for a moment, as if pondering something.
"I guess it should be fine as long as I don't kill you..." he mumbled.
"What?"
Owen raised an eyebrow, but before he could say anything else, Yuan activated Demonic Awakening, entering his demon form.
"What the hell?! That appearance!" Owen cried out loud, his eyes popping out of their sockets from shock.
"This is a new trick I learned recently. Pretty neat, huh?" Yuan smiled, his aura skyrocketing into the heavens.
'What an immense aura! And to think his cultivation is only at the first level of False God! That's ridiculous!' Owen cried inwardly.
"Is this all you've got?" Yuan suddenly asked. "It's not that impressive, considering how many lives you sacrificed."
"Shut the hell up, you rat! Because I didn't want to accidentally kill you too quickly, I have restricted myself to only ten percent of my full strength so far!"
After saying that, Owen's aura surged violently.
